  For example, consider four artificial two-day predictive draws:

                         (80, 120),   (120, 80),   (80, 120),   (120, 80).

Each marginal central 95 percent empirical interval is [80, 120], whereas every path sums to
200. The interval of sums is [200, 200]; adding marginal endpoints gives [160, 240]. If the
observed two-day total is 220, the corresponding draw-wise cumulative effect is always 20.
This finite arithmetic checks the aggregation rule only. It is neither an MCMC experiment nor
a coverage result. Causal banking research proposal project (2026b)

   Relative effects require another distinction. The inspected summary computes draw-wise

and then summarizes those ratios. A ratio of posterior means can differ sharply. With

   The field called p is a one-sided simulation tail-area calculation. The inspected implementa-
tion appends the observed total to the predictive totals and takes the smaller inclusive tail
proportion. For B predictive draws its smallest positive value is 1/(B + 1); the four-draw
construction above gives 1/5, not zero. Its meaning depends on the specified predictive model
and simulation. It is not a design-based randomization probability, a proof that the causal

   Finally, units determine useful aggregation. Brodersen and colleagues distinguish a cumu-
lative flow effect from an average stock effect. Daily additional applications can be summed
over the campaign. An extra USD 10,000 of deposit balance observed on each of three dates is
USD 10,000 at the last date; summing those snapshots produces USD 30,000-days under a
daily exposure convention, not USD 30,000 of new deposits or revenue. Funding value would
need a specified balance-time and margin calculation. The adapter request therefore includes
whether the response is a flow, a stock, a rate or an index, its units and its aggregation rule.

23.4.3    Calendars, failures and a proposed adapter boundary

The source saves the original time labels and then replaces the internal time index with
sequential row numbers. Its own comment notes that this precludes automatic filling of
missing time points. The missing-date tests check that omitted labels remain omitted from
the output. A Friday and the following Monday may therefore be neighboring model steps
in a sparse input. For a bank, business-day dynamics and calendar-day accrual are different
choices. Before fitting, the proposed adapter validates a declared calendar, row uniqueness,
time-zone treatment and period boundaries. Filling omitted rows, carrying forward balances
or aggregating transactions would require an explicit transformation; each can change the
estimand or state evolution. Google CausalImpact maintainers (2026b)
   Constant, entirely missing or insufficiently observed response series cause the selected model
builder to warn and return no fitted model. The wrapper can still return an object with
the CausalImpact class and unavailable inferences. Checking only the object’s class would
misclassify that failure as success. The proposed output boundary instead requires a fitted
model, usable draws and the requested summaries, while retaining warnings and missing-value
reasons. Missing controls, inadmissible periods, failed inference, unavailable relative summaries
and an unsupported scientific request need distinguishable responses. A treatment-affected
donor is a scientific restriction to assess; it is not equivalent to a numerical error. Google

23.5      Fitting weights and target weights
fect’s selected documentation distinguishes weights used in counterfactual fitting from weights
used to aggregate treatment effects. The latter do not automatically implement inverse-
probability or doubly robust confounding correction. A fitting weight changes the optimization
or fitting population; an aggregation weight changes the reported average. The two can be
numerically similar vectors and still represent different operations.fect contributors (2026)
  This distinction is especially important when a bank moves between account-weighted,
exposure-weighted and monetary-loss-weighted effects. If effects τi are reported as
                                                P
                                                   wi τi
                                           τw = Pi       ,
                                                    i wi

then the definition and availability time of wi are part of the target. A realized post-treatment
balance weight can change the population being averaged and may itself be affected by
treatment. The formula alone does not justify its causal interpretation. The interface should
retain the weight’s meaning and clock, including whether it was fixed before action.
214                                                         Causal analysis for a universal bank


   fect also documents restrictions on its parametric bootstrap. Its 2.4.5 manual retains some
language about earlier version roadmaps. Those passages require implementation review before
being presented as verified current behavior. The proposed trial therefore selects an exact
fitting method, aggregation rule and resampling law and checks them together. A successful
counterfactual fit cannot substitute for that complete procedure.
   The resulting panel strategy is plural: evaluate ATT procedures, staged regression,
interaction-weighted event studies, donor weighting and counterfactual factor approaches
for the questions they support. The product may offer a coherent report across them
while preserving incompatible targets and assumptions. Matched comparisons should align
populations, horizons and information, and they should retain a losing method or an
unsupported case instead of forcing every candidate into one ranking.

Agents, language boundaries and
qualification

24.1     A directional suggestion is a proposal
Language assistance can help an analyst translate a business question into variables, explain
candidate diagrams, retrieve documentation and construct a tool request. Those operations
are useful even when a language model cannot identify an effect from the available information.
The software boundary should make that distinction explicit: a model-generated proposition
enters an evidence and review process before it changes the graph used for causal inference.
   The inspected pgmpy LLMPairwise implementation is an instructive concrete example. It
requires exactly two variables and builds its prompt from their names and optional descriptions.
Observed values are not used to orient the edge. The prompt asks the model to choose
one of two directions and the result constructs a graph with one directed edge. There is
no output choice for no edge, a common cause, insufficient information or a retained graph
alternative.pgmpy contributors (2026b)
   This design may be suitable for collecting a narrowly defined directional suggestion. It
cannot by itself answer a broader question about whether two bank variables are causally
connected. “Contact” and “distress” may refer to variables at different times, and a bank
can contact distressed customers while earlier contact also changes later distress. Names
without clocks do not determine the causal question. The project graph-equivalence example
in Chapter 20 also shows that observational ambiguity can remain even with data; a forced
linguistic choice does not resolve that mathematical ambiguity.
   Two implementation details strengthen the case for treating the output as a proposal. The
selected internal cache uses the unordered pair of names as its key. Description, prompt,
provider/model and sampling parameters are not part of that key. If an instance retains this
cache across calls, changed semantics can therefore reuse an old orientation. This is a static
conditional finding about the cache path; the full estimator lifecycle has not been executed.
An integration test must establish when state is retained and verify invalidation against the
actual call contract.pgmpy contributors (2026b)
   The response parser searches first for a digit 1 or 2, then for an A/B token. A sentence
containing such a digit can be interpreted as an orientation even when its meaning is a refusal.
For example, the text “neither option 1 nor option 2 is justified” contains a first matching
digit. The proposed integration should use a strict structured response with explicit abstention
and preserve the raw response. Parser acceptance is a syntactic property; it cannot establish
the truth of the extracted direction.

                                              215
216                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


   The decision for this inspected path is therefore to reject direct use of its raw edge as a
qualified discovery result. An exploratory assistant could still use it after adding a complete
request identity, structured abstention, independent source checks and graph alternatives.
Those changes would need their own review and evaluation. They are proposed remedies, not
already verified upstream or project behavior.


24.2     Evidence and authority must travel separately
An assistant might accurately quote a package manual yet request an operation that the
organization has not approved. It might also request an approved operation for a causally
invalid target. Evidence, scientific applicability and operational authority are separate inputs.
A citation is evidence for a claim in its scope; it is not authority to execute an action. A
successful schema check is evidence that a declaration has the expected shape; it is not evidence
that a business owner certified the declaration.
   The proposed workflow binds a reviewed target and graph declaration to an exact input
identity. The selected operation consumes that declaration, returns typed results and retains
the chain from the question to the assumptions, method and output. Changes to the treatment
clock, target population or diagram create a different scientific request. A cached numeric
result or prior approval should not silently follow those changes.
   Retrieved documentation must be treated as source material. Text inside a manual, repos-
itory or model response cannot grant itself permission to select another tool, change the
target or publish a decision. For the product user, the meaningful consequence is a reviewable
record of which evidence supported which proposition and which person or authorized process
accepted the scientific declaration. Internal file names and routing details are not substitutes
for that explanation.


24.3     One operation across library, CLI and MCP
A reusable causal product can expose a library call, a command-line request and an MCP
tool for the same operation. Their success criterion is semantic equivalence. Given the same
complete request and execution policy, each should preserve the target, graph endpoints,
expression or set topology, numerical units, missingness and refusal state. The transport
should not narrow a PAG to a DAG, replace a disconnected set with a pair of endpoints, or
turn an unsupported request into a zero effect.
   This motivates a narrow integration boundary. A discovery operation returns a graph object
together with the test and search settings needed to interpret it. An identification operation
returns an expression or a typed failure in the supplied model class. An estimation operation
returns its target, uncertainty and numerical diagnostics. A policy-value operation returns
the specified regime and horizon. A consumer can combine these operations only when their
contracts match; the mere availability of a tool name does not establish that match.
   For Tetrad, the initial bridge candidate is a Java process with explicit graph serialization.
This isolates runtime management but adds startup, transfer and error-mapping costs. Its
inspected root POM declares compiler release 21, while the inspected README describes
Java JDK 25+ for bridge use. These are distinct source observations requiring an actual
environment qualification; choosing one by assumption would conceal a deployment uncertainty.
tetrad contributors (2026)
  For the selected R estimators, a process boundary can preserve the native method and
24.4. A matched trial needs scientific and operational failures                              217


dependencies. A direct Python interface can reduce translation for causal-learn and selected
pgmpy operations. For aGrUM, comparing the existing wrapper with native C++ calls can
clarify whether serialization or binding overhead matters for the intended workload. These are
candidate routes. No downloaded package was executed for the inspections reported in this
reader.
  Porting should be justified by a concrete advantage: unavailable deployment environments,
a measured bottleneck, a required result representation or a maintenance constraint. It carries
an obligation to reproduce the complete procedure, including error behavior and uncertainty.
Rewriting only a point estimate while retaining a familiar method name would create a
misleading compatibility claim. Direct adoption also requires a dependency and license review;
a permissive root license does not settle every bundled component.


24.4      A matched trial needs scientific and operational failures
Qualification begins with an exact supported request and a suitable reference. For a graph
operation, independent endpoint fixtures and known graph classes test representation and
algorithm scope. For an estimator, analytically tractable mechanisms or an independently
reviewed implementation test the target and numerical behavior. For a confidence set,
evaluation must retain empty, disconnected and unbounded outputs. For a longitudinal
procedure, a mechanism with action-dependent histories tests whether the intervention was
preserved. Ordinary and difficult cases belong in the same declared trial.
   The measured workflow includes serialization, process startup, dependency loading, fitting,
uncertainty and result publication. A bridge that improves fit time but dominates total
latency with transfer costs may be a poor choice for small requests. Conversely, an expensive
startup may be acceptable for a large repeated analysis if the process lifecycle is controlled. A
comparison should retain both outcomes rather than report only the most favorable component
timer.
   Failure injection tests a different property from statistical calibration. Interrupted input
transfer, worker failure and interrupted publication should not create a partly valid result.
Replay needs immutable inputs and exact predecessor artifacts. If a method uses randomness,
its seed and configuration belong in the request record, while nondeterministic numerical
behavior needs a stated tolerance. A recoverable execution record makes the calculation
auditable; it does not prove its causal assumptions.
   No general preference for a process bridge, a native binding or a port can be established
without these measurements. The current source evidence does support a narrower decision:
evaluate existing implementations first where their contracts fit, preserve distinct outputs and
failures, and reject interfaces that force unsupported scientific meaning without a reviewed
adaptation.


24.5      Commercial comparison and the remaining evidence
          boundary
The commercial comparison must operate at the same level of specificity. For each vendor
edition, the evidence should identify the estimator or graph operation, its supported data and
assumptions, uncertainty and diagnostic outputs, automation interface, license boundary and
dated cost information. A product brochure can establish that a capability is advertised; it
cannot substitute for technical documentation of the method or an actual trial.
218                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


  The selected community Stata package demonstrates why runtime and vendor capability
must be separated. It may extend an organization’s Stata workflow, but that observation does
not establish what the vendor ships, licenses or supports. Similarly, a graphical application
component does not establish a commercial causal-identification engine. Where essential
vendor originals remain unavailable, the capability comparison is unverified; it is not a finding
that the vendor lacks the feature.
   The immediate engineering requirements are nevertheless concrete. Preserve scientific
targets and uncertainty objects, expose method-specific unsupported states, qualify language
boundaries, and evaluate whole workflows under declared assumptions. These requirements
address defects that would otherwise be hidden by a superficially uniform API. Completing
the wider software survey, commercial comparison and bank qualification requires additional
primary sources and trials; this selected review supplies evidence and testable integration
choices for that work.

24.6.3    The first comparison has a graph target and a failure contract

The retained prototype profile concerns complete IID continuous data under explicit linear-
Gaussian, acyclic, causally sufficient, faithful and no-selection assumptions. It uses the fixed
settings specified by the Java adapter contract and retains the banking target, population,
units, sampling unit and information clock. The immediate output is a validated CPDAG. It is
not an intervention estimate, an effect confidence region or a declaration that the assumptions
are true. Latent-variable FCI, FGES, time-series search, background-knowledge constraints
and missing-data procedures require separate profiles. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)
   The independent exact reference gives three Gaussian causal models with the same observed
covariance and the same noncollider chain class. Their intervention responses from the first to
the third variable are zero, zero and 2/5. Thus a unique selected orientation can change a
banking recommendation while leaving the observed law unchanged. An adapter must retain
the unresolved chain rather than silently report one member’s effect. The reference also checks
endpoint direction, isolated variables, unit conversion and changes in scientific context. These
are project calculations, not outputs from a Java executable. (Causal banking research project,
2026w)
  Failure handling is a material selection condition. In the pinned Fisher-Z implementation,
220                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


checkIndependence catches a singular-matrix exception and returns a dependence result with
p = 0. The exception-preserving getResult path permits a different wrapper design. That
wrapper must validate each result, record a failed numerical query and withhold the job’s
graph when its computation did not complete. The inspection establishes source behavior
at one revision; it is not a measured failure rate or a claim that every data set triggers it.
(cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a)
   The stable skeleton search also uses parallel work. Its pair routine catches an interruption,
restores that worker’s interrupt flag and returns from the pair. The parent wrapper therefore
needs a job-level failure state and complete terminal query records before publication. An
independent whole-process time and memory limit complements the engine’s cooperative
behavior. Neither a returned graph object nor an elapsed timeout setting alone proves that
every required query completed. The complete interface, concurrency behavior and failure
propagation remain implementation tests, not benefits already delivered by the contract.
(Tetrad contributors, 2026; Causal banking research project, 2026v; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026r)


24.6.4    Alternatives, costs and a revisable admission decision

The first executable comparison should include the separately reviewed R or Python PC

   Measure environment setup, retained disk footprint, full-request runtime, peak memory,
conversion overhead, analyst corrections and maintenance effort. Failed queries, numerical
failures, cancellations and unsupported requests remain in the account. A computation of
the wrong scientific object cannot win by being fast. No vendor price, bank workload or
analyst-time saving is assigned from the current source inspection.
   Three responsibilities make admission concrete. The adapter maintainer resolves and records
the build/runtime and dependency rights. The scientific reviewer checks the selected profile,
graph-class recognition and matched references. The workflow owner evaluates full-request
failure handling and the actual cost against a usable baseline. These are proposed roles, not
fabricated acceptance by named institutions. Revisit executable admission when the pinned
build, conversion, graph-class, numerical and interruption cases have actual results; reopen the

24.6.5    Choosing an R discovery and effect-set boundary

The preferred R route is a restricted integration of pcalg for Gaussian observational discovery
and singleton linear effects. Its attraction is the connection between a partially directed graph
and a multiset of effects: the product can preserve uncertainty about direction instead of
forcing a unique business answer. The proposal selects this pinned path for local prototype
implementation under the strict contract developed below. Runtime qualification remains
open until the environment and conversion boundary have been exercised; selection does not
claim that the proposed R adapter already works.
24.6. Selecting Tetrad without adopting an unrestricted discovery service                        221


   The selected source is pcalg version 2.7-12, dated 12 September 2024, at CRAN mirror
revision 930fe476875ddc00528dbaacb6f48f2791ab12e3. The bounded history query selects
the most recent mirror commit before the 7 October 2026 cutoff. The reference manual was
generated in May 2026; this later document date does not change the release into a 2026

   PC, its stable and conservative variants, FCI, GIES and IDA are operations or families within

The initial integration selects only the PC/IDA path. The presence of latent-variable and

What an effect multiset would mean for a bank

Let the observed vector contain an offered rate change X, an intermediate customer response
M , and a monetary outcome Y . The initial model is a linear Gaussian structural system with
independently sampled units, no hidden common causes and a distribution faithful to its causal
DAG. The sampling unit could be a customer in a stipulated independent-unit experiment;
repeated customer months cannot be relabeled as independent rows. The graph search
estimates conditional independence structure. Its significance level is a level for individual
tests, not a confidence level for the entire graph or for the effect of a future bank action (pcalg
contributors, 2026).
  For a compatible DAG G, the singleton total effect is the derivative
                                          ∂
                                   θG =     EG [Y | do(X = x)].
                                         ∂x
In the stated linear model it is constant in x. When Y is not a parent of X, it can be calculated
by regressing Y on X and the parents of X in G. If Y is a parent, its total effect from
X is zero. The global IDA construction considers compatible DAGs; the local construction
uses admissible local parent configurations. They need not attach the same multiplicity to
a numerical value. Neither construction turns a frequency in this multiset into a posterior
probability of a graph (pcalg contributors, 2026; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror,
2024b).
  The distinction is visible without fitting a package. Consider the exact covariance matrix,
ordered as (X, M, Y ),                                    
                                         1     0.6    0.48
                                Σ =  0.6 1.36 1.088  .
                                                          
                                        0.48 1.088 1.8704
The partial covariance of X and Y given M is 0.48 − 0.6(1.088)/1.36 = 0. The three DAGs
X → M → Y , X ← M → Y , and X ← M ← Y can each generate this same Gaussian law
with positive independent error variances. Exact rational reconstruction of all three systems
gives total effects 0.48, 0, 0. Global enumeration therefore has multiset [0, 0, 0.48]; the two local
parent configurations of X give [0, 0.48]. Averaging the first would produce 0.16, and averaging
the second would produce 0.24. Neither average is identified as the bank’s intervention effect.
These are exact project constructions and independent references, not results from executing
pcalg (Causal proposal project, 2026b).
222                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


   Suppose X is measured in percentage points and Y in thousands of currency units. The
nonzero derivative becomes 4.8 currency units per basis point, so a 25-basis-point action gives
120 currency units per modeled unit in the forward-chain system. The other systems permit
zero. In general, for X ′ = cX X and Y ′ = cY Y ,

                              Σ′ = DΣDT ,         ′
                                                 θG = (cY /cX )θG .

Both the covariance transformation and the output units must survive an R process boundary.
A correlation matrix alone is insufficient to restore monetary units. Further, naming X an
offered rate is not evidence for its causal position. Justified timing or an intervention can
exclude competing graphs; vocabulary alone cannot. Sampling uncertainty remains a separate
obligation even when a graph class has been correctly represented.


Matrix conventions change causal meaning

An adjacency matrix is not a complete interface specification. In this package, the documented
amat.cpdag convention refers to the row endpoint, whereas amat.pag refers to the column
endpoint. The selected pcAlgo coercion calls wgtMatrix, whose default transposes the under-
lying graph matrix. Thus a consumer that changes the accessor while keeping its old decoder
can reverse every directed edge (pcalg contributors, 2026; pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024b).
  For distinct named nodes i and j, write the ordered pair (Aij , Aji ). The following conventions
must remain separate.

                                                 Pair for an             Interpretation
   Representation         Pair for i → j         undirected edge         requirement
   amat.cpdag from        (0, 1)                 (1, 1)                  Row-endpoint
   the pcAlgo matrix                                                     convention; retain
   coercion                                                              the exact accessor.
   Matrix of the          (1, 0)                 (1, 1)                  Row denotes source;
   underlying                                                            verify the installed
   graphNEL object                                                       graph conversion.
   amat.pag               (2, 3)                 (3, 3)                  Column-endpoint
                                                                         marks; outside the
                                                                         initial effect path.


   A symmetric example cannot detect a transpose. The proposed acceptance fixtures therefore
include a named directed chain and a named collider, each under every permutation of its three
columns. An independently written decoder was checked on 54 representation/fixture/permu-
tation combinations, and 36 deliberate transposes of directed fixtures changed the expected
answer. These checks establish the small reference examples. They do not establish that an
installed R serializer preserves them; that is the later adapter test (Causal proposal project,
2026b).
  The response should retain the original representation, node order, exact accessor and
package revisions alongside named edges. A display may render the graph more conveniently,
but an unresolved edge must stay unresolved. The importer must also retain the origin of
exceptional marks. A pair of twos can encode an orientation conflict in PC and a bidirected
edge in a PAG; equal integers do not establish equal scientific meaning.

Failures must be caught before they are hidden

The selected source makes three failure boundaries especially consequential. First, with
solve.confl=false, relaxed PC can overwrite an earlier edge direction when another collider
or orientation rule conflicts with it. With solve.confl=true, it can preserve conflicting
directions using reciprocal entries of two. The proposed profile therefore uses conservative
PC, stable skeleton search, relaxed orientation and conflict preservation. Such a result may
still fail to be a valid CPDAG. The discovery result can retain this diagnostic, while the
effect calculation must refuse it. The conflict is not evidence of a latent common cause (pcalg
contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).
   Second, a finite conditional-independence p value need not show that every preceding
numerical operation was valid. The inspected pcorOrder uses a pseudoinverse for conditioning
sets of size at least two, replaces a missing partial correlation by zero, and clips its result.
zStat likewise replaces a missing statistic by zero; gaussCItest then evaluates a two-sided
Gaussian tail probability. Disabling NAdelete acts later in the skeleton routine and cannot
recover a failure already replaced inside these functions (pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024b).
  For example, in the invalid correlation matrix with every entry equal to one, the one-variable
conditioning formula gives
                                                1−1·1          0
                                 r12|3 = p         2       2
                                                              = .
                                             (1 − 1 )(1 − 1 )  0

Replacing this undefined value by zero yields a finite p value of one. An independently written
base-R scalar trace reproduces this arithmetic; it also verifies that positive-definite factorization
rejects the input. A separate invalid-degrees-of-freedom example reaches the same finite p
value through the statistic fallback. These are intentionally invalid inputs, already excluded
by a correctly enforced preflight. They demonstrate why checking only the final p value is
insufficient, without establishing a failure for valid, well-conditioned package inputs (Causal
proposal project, 2026b).
   The proposed initial path instead supplies a strict Gaussian test callback through PC’s exist-
ing independence-test interface. It uses checked positive definite submatrices and factorization
solves, preserves degrees of freedom, and refuses rank loss, nonpositive residual variances, non-
finite arithmetic or unacceptable conditioning. It does not silently substitute a pseudoinverse,
clip a failed calculation or choose a new regularization parameter. Numerical tolerances must
be fixed before adapter qualification. This callback is a proposed project component with
its own comparison obligation, rather than a description of unmodified gaussCItest. The
compiled fast skeleton path is outside the initial profile so that it cannot bypass this callback.
   Third, the inspected IDA code replaces all nonzero graph weights by one before checking
graph validity. If validity fails, it emits a message without an immediate stop. A conflict
pair (2, 2) can therefore lose its distinction from an undirected pair (1, 1) before that check.
The proposed adapter must inspect the untouched graph, reject conflict codes, and enforce
a strict CPDAG/extension gate before calling IDA. It must not treat a warning stream as a
structured failure response, or silently orient an edge to make an invalid request calculable
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).


Reuse choice, operating cost and the next experiment

An isolated local R process is the preferred implementation boundary. The request would
contain an operation name, named data or a checked summary, units, sampling assump-
224                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


tions, resource limits and expected source revision. It would not contain arbitrary R ex-
pressions. The initial effect call uses the singleton local method on a verified CPDAG, with
y.notparent=false. The result preserves the multiset and labels graph ambiguity separately
from sampling uncertainty. Broader PDAG constraints, optimal adjustment, joint interventions,
PAG effects and dependent observations require their own contracts. This restriction makes
the first experiment interpretable.
   The package declares GPL version 2 or later, R at least 3.5.0, seventeen imports and
three LinkingTo dependencies. It requires compilation; the selected build file links LAPACK,
BLAS and Fortran libraries. These are dependency declarations, not a resolved runtime
inventory. Separating R into a process helps isolate versions and failures, but does not waive
applicable source, notice or distribution obligations. The actual dependency versions, build
flags, numerical libraries and third-party rights must be recorded for the artifact selected for
distribution (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024b).
   The inspected source includes PC and IDA regression examples, including comparisons
across local/global methods, but some examples are conditional on an extra-tests switch. Their
presence supplies useful candidate fixtures; it is not a passing test receipt. The inspected
NEWS begins with an older 2.7-8 section, and the separate ChangeLog begins in 2010. Neither
provides a complete explanation of the selected release. The build owner should therefore
retain compatibility tests and a revision-change review rather than treating the package date
as a support guarantee. The local inventory contains R 4.1.2 but no installed pcalg or the
inspected key graph/build packages; no package benchmark is claimed here.

24.7      R discovery when borrower risk and selection are hidden
The preceding PC/IDA boundary assumes a causally sufficient system. That assumption is
consequential in a servicing application: private borrower distress can affect both the bank’s
contact decision and subsequent recovery, while inclusion in an observed account panel can
depend on both. A larger regression or a more elaborate graph display does not by itself
remove either problem. The R comparison must therefore ask what information survives
latent common causes and selection, which object an algorithm returns, and which additional
argument would turn that object into a decision.
   The selected implementation is again pcalg 2.7-12 at the preserved September 2024 CRAN
mirror revision. FCI, RFCI, FCI+, conservative and majority variants, and the Joint Causal
Inference options are related operations in this package. They are not six independent software
implementations. The bounded R search also returns methodological papers, a Python software
paper and other-language leads; their presence in a search result does not establish an R
implementation. The following claims concern inspected pinned manuals, implementation
paths and authentic method papers. They do not constitute a complete census of every
R extension or an executed package comparison (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror,
2024a).


What a latent-variable graph says. Let X denote the recorded variables, L unrecorded
variables, and S the variables on which inclusion is conditioned. For an underlying acyclic
causal graph, a maximal ancestral graph can represent the conditional-independence structure
left after marginalizing L and conditioning on S. A partial ancestral graph, or PAG, records
features shared by compatible ancestral graphs. The marks carry information: an arrowhead
at a vertex rules out its ancestry of the opposite vertex and the selection variables under the
stated model; a tail carries an ancestral restriction; a circle leaves an endpoint unresolved. In
particular, selection can make the interpretation of a tail refer to ancestry of selection, rather
than a uniquely established direct causal effect on the other recorded variable. An estimated
PAG is neither a single fully specified structural model nor a numerical intervention estimate
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a; Colombo et al., 2012).
  The distinction is stronger for RFCI. In the definition of an FCI-PAG, an adjacency asserts
dependence for all eligible conditioning subsets of the recorded variables, conditional on
226                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


selection. In an RFCI-PAG the corresponding requirement concerns subsets of the adjacent
sets. This weaker statement can leave additional edges and can represent more than one Markov
equivalence class. The causal endpoint information is sound in the oracle theorem under
faithfulness, but it is incorrect to relabel the RFCI output as the complete FCI equivalence
class. A common serialization class named fciAlgo does not erase this difference. The
proposed artifact must retain the algorithm, version and object semantics as well as the matrix
(Colombo et al., 2012; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).

A bank decision that the observed table cannot settle. Consider a binary contact
action A and binary recovery Y . Three authored mechanisms produce exactly the same strictly
positive observed table:
                                           Y =0 Y =1
                                   A=0      2/5    1/10
                                   A = 1 1/10       2/5
In the first mechanism A is randomized with probability 1/2, and P (Y = 1 | do(A = a)) =
1/5 + 3a/5. Its effect is 3/5. In the second, hidden U is a fair binary variable. Conditional on
U , action and recovery are independent, with

           P (A = 1 | U = u) = 1/10 + 4u/5,        P (Y = 1 | U = u) = 1/8 + 3u/4.

All eight (U, A, Y ) cells have positive probability. Marginalization gives the same displayed
table, but setting A does not alter U or Y : both intervention means are 1/2 and the effect
is zero. Thus an observed conditional contrast of 3/5 is compatible with no contact effect
(Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).
   For the third mechanism, A and Y are independent in the population, with P (A = 1) =
2/5 and P (Y = 1) = 1/3. Inclusion probabilities for (A, Y ) = (0, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0), (1, 1)
are respectively 1/5, 1/10, 3/40, 3/5. Multiplying by the population cell probabilities and
normalizing by P (S = 1) = 1/5 again gives the displayed table. The population effect is
zero; the selected association does not identify the unselected population effect. The selection
graph has A → S ← Y . It has a different interpretation from the hidden common-cause graph
A ← U → Y , even though this observed table cannot distinguish them from the direct-effect
mechanism (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).
   If a recovery is assigned a value of USD 100 and a contact costs USD 20, the three stipulated
population net values are USD 40, USD −20 and USD −20. These are illustrative prices
and mechanisms, not bank measurements. The three values demonstrate unresolved decision
consequences; they are not a sharp identified set over all possible causal models. A useful
product keeps the conflicting explanations and asks which restriction, assignment evidence or
intervention could distinguish them. Selecting the graph whose implied profit is most attractive
cannot supply that missing information (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l).

How the algorithms spend information and computation. FCI begins with an
adjacency search and then considers separating sets that can lie outside a node’s immediate
neighborhood. Its Possible-D-SEP stage can remove edges the initial search retained, after
which orientation rules refine endpoint marks. RFCI omits that global stage and instead
performs additional local tests for unshielded triples and discriminating paths. This is a trade
between computational work and informativeness, not a claim that RFCI finds exactly the
same graph more cheaply on every input. The oracle soundness result requires a faithful
underlying DAG and correct conditional-independence information. Neither a software return
code nor a large nominal sample size establishes these premises (Colombo et al., 2012; pcalg
contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
24.7. R discovery when borrower risk and selection are hidden                                 227


   The high-dimensional consistency result is also specific. It assumes IID copies of the selected
observed law, multivariate Gaussianity, faithfulness, restrictions on graph-neighborhood growth,
and nonzero partial correlations bounded away from a shrinking detection boundary while
remaining bounded away from one. The FCI result uses a stronger restriction on the growth
of Possible-D-SEP sets. Its conclusion uses a sequence of tuning levels; it is not a finite-sample
graph-confidence guarantee at the user’s chosen alpha. Repeated monthly observations on the
same borrowers do not become IID merely because they are supplied to the same function
(Colombo et al., 2012).
   The per-test level should consequently travel as a test parameter, not a confidence attached
to the entire graph. For an explicitly hypothetical family of 100 independent true-null tests at
level .05, the probability of at least one rejection is 1 − .95100 . That elementary calculation
does not describe FCI’s adaptive testing error, but it exposes the unsupported step from a
per-test parameter to a simultaneous claim. Graph uncertainty, orientation ambiguity, model
restrictions and sampling uncertainty need separate treatment before an effect set can receive
a coverage label (Causal banking proposal project, 2026l; Colombo et al., 2012).
   FCI+ supplies a different search strategy. Its method paper bounds the number of oracle
independence tests by order N 2(k+2) for N observed variables and a fixed bound k on node
degree. The result presumes the faithful acyclic model and the stated oracle conditions while
allowing latent variables and selection. Polynomial order at fixed k is not a practical runtime
promise, and the paper notes that sample versions can use larger conditioning sets and lose
power. The proposal should compare FCI+ as an alternative under the same generated regimes,
without translating the complexity result into a bank-scale performance claim (Claassen et al.,
2013).


Options are scientific choices, not cosmetic settings. The pinned implementation
exposes normal, anytime and adaptive-anytime FCI. A finite m.max restricts conditioning-set
size. A distinct parameter, pdsep.max, is checked against the size of a candidate Possible-D-
SEP set: when that size exceeds the limit, the selected code skips the corresponding search. It
does not simply enumerate all subsets up to that order. A job that reaches the limit therefore
needs an explicit restricted-search disposition. A faster answer is not automatically equivalent
to an unrestricted run (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Missing conditional-independence results require equal care. In the inspected Possible-D-
SEP path, NAdelete=TRUE maps a missing test result to one and can remove an edge; false
maps it to zero and retains the edge in that path. This is a software rule, not evidence that
the missing result establishes independence or dependence. The proposed adapter should
retain the missing-test count and reason and apply an explicit admission policy. It should
not silently use either behavior to manufacture certainty. Hard-coded gaps and edges likewise
encode supplied restrictions; their provenance and sensitivity belong in the scientific result
(pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Conservative or majority-rule orientation reduces particular ambiguities but does not imply
full order invariance. The order-independent methods paper distinguishes stable skeletons,
decisions about unshielded triples and the subsequent orientation rules. RFCI can remove
further edges using order-dependent separating sets, so even a stable initial skeleton does not
make its final skeleton fully invariant. The package manual retains this warning. Permuting
the input columns and translating back to the original labels is therefore a useful proposed
diagnostic, not a theorem that the selected route must already pass (Colombo and Maathuis,
2014; pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   Selection and context options must be admitted together. FCI and FCI+ default to allowing
selection bias. Setting selectionBias=FALSE imposes its absence and disables the selected
228                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


selection-related orientation rules. In this pinned implementation nondefault JCI assumptions
require the no-selection setting. A branch or policy-regime label is not automatically an
exogenous, unconfounded randomized context. The proposed workflow must ask why that
context restriction is justified and whether account inclusion is compatible with it. The wider
cyclic and JCI theoretical claims require their own source and method review; this comparison
does not inherit them from an exposed argument name (pcalg contributors; CRAN source
mirror, 2024a).

Two concrete boundary defects change the reuse decision. For amat.pag, the matrix
entry refers to the endpoint at the column variable: one is a circle, two an arrowhead and three
a tail. This differs from the package’s DAG/CPDAG convention. The pinned pcalg2dagitty
implementation has explicit branches for seven nonzero endpoint pairs but omits the two
tail–circle cases. In particular, the documented input
                                                    !
                                              0 1
                                              3 0

represents a tail at the first vertex and a circle at the second. A static trace through this
two-node conversion adds neither an edge nor an isolated node and constructs pag{} before
the parser call. This is a source-level counterexample to unconditional lossless conversion, not
a recorded native parser response. The proposed route must explicitly support both cases
or refuse them before conversion, then verify labels, all endpoints and round-trip identity in
an isolated runtime qualification (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a; Causal
banking proposal project, 2026l).
   FCI+ has a different provenance problem. Its manual describes the general result object as
containing separating sets, but the inspected return constructor places empty lists or vectors
in several diagnostic fields, including separating sets and test counts, with a placeholder
pMax. Empty fields must not be reported as a measured zero-test search or as a complete
explanation of why an edge disappeared. RFCI’s reported initial-skeleton test counts also do not
enumerate all of its later local tests. A scientifically auditable route needs instrumentation of
the conditional-independence interface or an explicit diagnostic-coverage limitation. This work
has inspected those code paths; it has not installed that instrumentation (pcalg contributors;
CRAN source mirror, 2024a).
   A representative-graph conversion cannot repair either scientific uncertainty or missing
provenance. The inspected pag2magAM documentation constructs one compatible MAG, subject
to a restriction on new edges into the requested node and the absence of selection variables.
Its output is a representative used within a specified graphical criterion, not evidence that
the selected graph is the true bank mechanism. In particular, the existence of one convenient
adjustment or effect calculation does not settle all models represented by the original discovery
result (pcalg contributors; CRAN source mirror, 2024a).

A restricted integration path and its alternatives. The preferred addition to the
proposal is an isolated R FCI/RFCI comparison route that preserves PAG versus RFCI-
PAG semantics and all endpoint marks. FCI is the richer reference; RFCI is the explicitly
less informative alternative when the proposed workload makes the full search unattractive.
FCI+ remains a candidate subject to complete diagnostic accounting and matched resource
evaluation. The initial PC/IDA path remains appropriate only when its separate causal-
sufficiency assumptions are defended. The existing Python and Java comparisons offer
independent implementation candidates, but equal algorithm names do not establish equal
defaults, conversion conventions or statistical outputs.
24.8. A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate, preserve the question              229


   Direct adoption of an arbitrary returned graph as a bank decision is rejected. A wholesale
port is also not yet justified: it would inherit a large scientific verification burden, and moving
the same logic into another language would not resolve latent information or selection. The
immediate reuse choice is a narrow adapter with explicit test, search and diagnostic contracts.
The package’s previously inspected GPL declaration and dependency inventory remain relevant
to any distribution decision; this scientific selection grants neither a new licensing conclusion
nor deployment approval.
   The proposed qualification should begin with independently specified independence oracles
and small known graphs, then use generated samples with hidden causes, selection, weak
associations and missing tests. It must retain all requests, budget exits and graph ambiguities;
compare FCI, RFCI and FCI+ on the same declared laws; and separate native numerical
behavior from serialization correctness. Endpoint pairs, isolated nodes, invalid graph types,
column permutations, diagnostic completeness and search truncation need individual fixtures.
Only after those results should a decision study evaluate whether a justified effect or refusal
changes contact policy value. No package execution, finite-sample calibration or accepted R
adapter is claimed by the present source review.


24.8      A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate,
          preserve the question
The proposal selects a narrow pgmpy integration for generating an adjustment candidate
from a supplied, fully observed causal DAG. The project must then verify that candidate
independently before reporting it. This choice reuses a permissively licensed graph library while
preserving a scientific boundary: a successful method call does not prove that the supplied
graph describes the bank, that the requested adjustment identifies the intended effect, or that
a numerical estimator has valid uncertainty. The selection authorizes development of this
limited prototype path; it is not evidence that an adapter has been implemented or executed
pgmpy contributors (2026a); Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The source is pinned to the repository revision beginning 1f6296fc2606, committed on 5
October 2026 and selected by the cutoff-bounded history query. Its project metadata declares
version 1.1.2. Fifteen inspected source, guide, test and licensing files match the selected Git
tree, in addition to their local SHA-256 identities. Source acquisition occurred after the 7
October cutoff. The pin establishes which implementation is discussed; neither a late repository
snapshot nor a recent commit measures maintainer responsiveness or long-term support pgmpy
contributors (2026a).


24.8.1    A guide, a graph type and an implemented method are separate
          evidence

The identification guide presents minimal, variance-optimal and all-set adjustment routes.
The pinned implementation gives a more qualified picture. Its minimal-variance branch raises
NotImplementedError. The minimal branch explicitly requires a single exposure and outcome,
constructs a proper backdoor graph, then obtains a minimal separator. The all-set branch
enumerates subsets of an ancestor candidate set after removing specified causal-path and latent
variables. These operations cannot be combined into a claim that every documented graph
class and every advertised adjustment variant is implemented with the same semantics pgmpy
contributors (2026a).
  The distinction between minimal and minimum matters even without statistical estimation.
230                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


A set is inclusion-minimal when no proper subset remains valid. It is minimum-cardinality
when no valid set has fewer elements. The inspected separator routine greedily removes
dispensable members of an initial set; that does not establish a global cardinality minimum.
Nor does cardinality alone determine estimator variance, data acquisition cost or missingness.
A front end should not translate the option name into the promise “the cheapest or most
precise set of controls” pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   An exact graph illustrates the difference. Let C cause A, B and Y ; let A and B cause X; and
include X → Y . The two inclusion-minimal backdoor sets are {C} and {A, B}. Conditioning
on C blocks both forks; without C, both A and B are needed. A project reference that deletes
dispensable variables from {A, B, C} obtains either answer depending on deletion order. That
computation describes the semantics of greedy minimality; it is not a measured pgmpy output.
For a lending example, one verified common driver may be cheaper to collect than two separate
proxies, but its actual measurement quality and availability still determine whether the smaller
set is useful Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The package’s all-set path is also a bounded algorithmic choice. Enumerating subsets can
require work exponential in the candidate count. Restricting the candidates to ancestors is
meaningful, but a consumer must retain that domain rather than describe the output as all
imaginable observed-variable sets. Variables irrelevant to the target, descendant restrictions and
generalized adjustment criteria introduce different enumeration questions. The first proposed
wrapper therefore excludes both all-set enumeration and the unimplemented minimum-variance
option. It asks for one candidate and checks its stated sufficient criterion pgmpy contributors
(2026a).


24.8.2     A total-effect validator must reject the wrong question

The inspected public validation call first checks the supported graph type and invokes a
graph-role check. The latter checks the presence of exposure and outcome roles. The adjust-
ment validator then tests whether parents of the exposure remain connected to the outcome
conditional on the exposure and proposed adjustment variables. This particular call path does
not independently exclude descendants of the exposure pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   Consider the supplied DAG X → M → Y with X a root. Its exposure has no parents, so
the inspected parent’s-connection predicate is an empty conjunction and evaluates to true,
even if the proposed adjustment variable is the mediator M . The role-presence check does not
reject that assignment. This is a static trace through authentic source, not an installed-engine
experiment. It suffices to show why the project cannot adopt that validation call alone as
its total-effect admission rule. The finding concerns this specific validator and pin; it does
not assert that every identification method returns an invalid set pgmpy contributors (2026a);
Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The financial significance can be derived exactly. Let independent, zero-mean, unit-variance
errors generate
                        X = UX ,     M = 2X + UM ,         Y = 3M + UY .
Under an intervention on X, the derivative of expected Y is 6. The covariance entries are

      Var(X) = 1,   Var(M ) = 5,    Cov(X, M ) = 2,      Cov(X, Y ) = 6,   Cov(M, Y ) = 15.

The coefficient of X in the population regression on (X, M ) is
                                        6 · 5 − 2 · 15
                                                       = 0.
                                          1 · 5 − 22
24.8. A restricted pgmpy integration: verify the candidate, preserve the question             231


Conditioning on the mediator has removed the mediated path. Reporting that coefficient as
the total effect would change the causal question. If X is a one-unit service intensity, Y is
dollars over the agreed horizon and the common linear law is stipulated for 1,000 accounts, the
authored gross response scenario is 6,000 dollars, compared with zero under the misreported
coefficient. This is generated arithmetic, not bank ROI, a binary-treatment guarantee or a
measured customer response Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The proposed first path consequently requires a conservative pre-action backdoor contract.
A candidate set must contain observed variables distinct from exposure and outcome, include
no descendants of the exposure, and d-separate exposure and outcome in the graph with
outgoing exposure edges removed. This is a sufficient contract for the selected DAG setting.
It is intentionally narrower than generalized adjustment over all supported graph classes. An
otherwise useful generalized set outside the contract receives an unsupported-scope disposition;
it is not declared scientifically impossible. The separation between a restricted sufficient
criterion and complete identification is part of the result’s meaning.
   Two project-owned graph calculations support the proposed verification boundary. One
tests separation after ancestral moralization. The other enumerates simple skeleton paths,
checks noncollider conditioning and checks whether colliders have conditioned descendants.
They agree on 26,064 queries across all 543 labeled DAGs on four nodes, including every
ordered exposure–outcome pair and every subset of the remaining nodes. The check helps
detect mistakes in the small reference implementation; it is not a proof for arbitrary graph size,
an upstream pgmpy test run or a statement about statistical discovery from finite samples
Causal banking research project (2026ac).


24.8.3    A selected DAG can conceal unresolved direction or a failed extension

Static discovery remains a separate reuse decision. The pinned PC class supports original,
stable and parallel variants; its defaults include parallel execution, test level .01, a maximum
conditioning-set size of five and a partially directed return. In the fitted method, the names
pdag and cpdag follow the same return branch. The dag option calls a conversion selecting
one orientation. The option spelling alone cannot establish a complete equivalence class,
whole-graph confidence or causal identification under hidden confounding. The source declares
causal sufficiency, acyclicity and faithfulness; particular conditional-independence tests add
their own assumptions pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The default conditioning cap can stop search before all possible separating sets have been
considered. Test selection, data types and expert constraints must therefore be retained
alongside the graph. A per-test threshold of .01 is not a .99 confidence level for every edge or
the downstream effect. Required and forbidden edges introduce external information; their
provenance must survive any business-language or agent-assisted formulation step. A graph’s
attractive rendering cannot supply that provenance pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The PDAG implementation contains a particularly clear conversion boundary. Its to_dag
routine warns when it cannot find a consistent extension preserving directed edges and v-
structures, then orients remaining edges arbitrarily while avoiding cycles. The result can
therefore be an acyclic graph with different v-structures. The to_cpdag route first obtains an
extension when undirected edges exist, so it cannot be used as an independent certificate that
the input represented a valid equivalence class pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   A four-node chordless undirected cycle supplies an exact refusal fixture. There are sixteen
orientations of its four edges; two form directed cycles and fourteen are acyclic. Every acyclic
orientation has a sink with two nonadjacent parents and therefore introduces an unshielded
collider. Consequently none preserves the undirected graph’s absence of specified colliders.
232                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


The project enumerates all fourteen acyclic cases to check this small argument. An arbitrary
DAG returned after a warning would answer a different graphical question; simply confirming
acyclicity would miss the change Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The initial integration therefore consumes an already supplied DAG rather than an automat-
ically completed discovered graph. Future discovery integration must preserve typed directed
and undirected edges, isolates, separating sets, constraints, warnings and the exact selection
procedure. Named-edge conversion is preferable to guessing direction from an unlabeled
binary matrix. An incomplete or nonextendible graph must remain an explicit scientific or
computational limitation, with no fallback to a conveniently oriented causal story.


24.8.4    The permitted prototype path and its failure contract

The proposed operation accepts one exposure and one outcome in a fully observed acyclic
graph, with unique string node identifiers and an explicit node list. It initially caps the graph
at twelve nodes as a conservative wrapper design choice; that number is not measured engine
capacity. Latent, bidirected, selection, undirected and ambiguous-edge inputs are outside
this path. It constructs a fresh pinned DAG with explicit roles and requests the minimal
adjustment candidate. The original graph remains available for comparison Causal banking
research project (2026ac).
   After a successful return, the wrapper must verify unchanged nodes, edges, exposure and
outcome roles; validate candidate membership and timing; exclude exposure descendants; and
run the independent graphical check. Success then means a candidate satisfying the specified
criterion relative to the supplied graph. It carries no numerical effect, confidence interval or
certification of the graph’s real-world truth. An empty valid set is a meaningful result, whereas
a null or failed return is a different disposition. A failure to find a set by this method must not
become a claim of global causal nonidentifiability Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   Exceptions, warnings, unsupported variants, altered graph structure and resource limits
are retained with their causes. They do not become an empty adjustment set or zero effect.
The same graph, target identity and disposition must cross library, CLI and MCP boundaries.
Implementation acceptance will require actual pinned-engine calls on named confounder,
mediator, collider, isolate and permutation fixtures, together with invalid graph and failure
cases. The exact references developed here provide oracles for that work; no pgmpy runtime
or adapter call was performed Causal banking research project (2026ac).
   The minimal path’s attraction is limited but practical: pgmpy can propose a graph-based
candidate while the project’s independent sufficient check guards its meaning. It is not
necessary to copy the whole library or port its graph stack to another language to obtain
this benefit. A reference-only role remains appropriate for presently unverified discovery and
estimation branches. Minimum-variance adjustment is rejected at this pin because the branch
is unimplemented. Generalized adjustment, latent graphs and data-driven direction selection
are deferred to separate source and semantic reviews pgmpy contributors (2026a).


24.8.5    Licensing, dependencies and ownership make reuse concrete

The pinned MIT license permits use, modification and distribution subject to preservation
of its copyright and permission notice and contains a warranty disclaimer. That permission
does not replace dependency-license review. Project metadata requires Python from 3.10 up
to but excluding 3.15 and declares twelve mandatory dependencies, including NumPy, SciPy,
NetworkX, pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels, scikit-base and Hugging Face Hub. Optional
groups separately include Torch, graphical tools and LiteLLM. Declared version floors are not
24.9. A scoped causal-learn reuse decision                                                  233


a resolved reproducible environment pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The proposed graph service should use an isolated, locked environment and only the necessary
path. Owners must retain source and dependency identities, notices, conversion fixtures and
resource measurements. An upgrade requires rechecking API names, graph representations
and failure behavior as well as rerunning accepted fixtures. The inspected revision includes
adjustment tests for observed, latent and M-graph cases, which are useful maintenance evidence;
their presence does not imply that those tests were executed here or that all targets and graph
classes are qualified pgmpy contributors (2026a).
   The LLM pairwise class is also a separate capability within the same repository. Its
description states that it uses variable names and text descriptions, not the observed data

a reviewable business formulation but do not inherit the evidence of a CI-based discovery
algorithm. This selected graph operation has no live-model dependency. A future language-
