  These conventions are documented or implemented in the inspected versions (mschauer/-
CausalInference.jl contributors, 2026; JuliaDynamics/Associations.jl contributors, 2026;
262                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


sepehr78/RecursiveCausalDiscovery.jl contributors, 2025; CausalDisco/flopsearch contributors,
2026; Biwei-Huang/Generalized-Score-Functions-for-Causal-Discovery contributors, 2020;
bayesnet/bnt contributors, 2019). The table does not define a universal convention for every
function in a package. For example, BNT’s K2 routine returns a selected DAG with a different
contract from its PC routine. The proposed interchange object must therefore carry method,
version, graph class, variable identities and endpoint meaning. It must distinguish a weighted
structural model from an unweighted graph even when their matrix dimensions agree.


24.17.3     Julia: composability requires checking the actual dispatch

CausalInference.jl 0.19.4 provides a useful starting point for a Julia backend. Its inspected
PC entrypoint accepts a conditional-independence callback and defaults to the stable skeleton
path. It returns a CPDAG in the reciprocal-arc representation. Gaussian GES exposes
a different computation: forward insertion and backward deletion continue while a score
improvement is available. The selected function returns a graph, score improvement relative
to the empty graph, and timing information. Its default penalty is 0.5, which should not be
confused with the explicit values used in examples or with another library’s score normalization
(mschauer/CausalInference.jl contributors, 2026).
  The covariance-based local score makes this distinction precise. With n rows, k parents,
penalty multiplier λ, and residual variance Cp , the inspected expression is

                       s = − 12 {n[1 + log(max(0, Cp ))] + λ(1 + k) log n}.

For a nonsingular parent covariance block, Cp is computed by subtracting the explained
covariance contribution. A larger value is preferred by the search. If Cp = 0, however, the
displayed logarithm is not a finite number; the zero clamp is not a positive numerical floor.
The adapter should diagnose constant variables, deterministic relationships, singular parent
systems and nonfinite scores before using a chosen graph in a funding decision. A perfect
numerical fit can signal degeneracy, not overwhelming causal evidence. Score comparison
across engines also requires matching centering, penalties, constants and the exact returned
quantity.
  Associations.jl offers a broader composition of association measures, independence tests and
graph algorithms. That flexibility is useful when the banking variables are nonlinear, but it does
not make arbitrary compositions valid. The PC documentation requires nondirectional pairwise
and conditional measures and specifically warns against inserting transfer entropy into this
generic symmetric skeleton procedure. The selected check_input contains the direction check
only as commented code. The proposed wrapper must enforce the compatibility condition itself
and record which measure and test were admitted(JuliaDynamics/Associations.jl contributors,
2026).
   Defaults also need source-level attention. The PC constructor uses maxdepth, while the
docstring presents max_depth. The local-permutation constructor defaults to ten neighbors,
although its documented signature says five. It exposes the number of shuffles, random
generator and a temporal exclusion window. These are concrete parameters of the proposed
statistical experiment. A temporal window alone does not prove that a resampling scheme
gives valid uncertainty for repeated accounts, common market shocks or a changing assignment
process. The parameter, sampling unit and relevant null law must be reviewed together.
   The selected skeleton removes an edge when the returned p-value exceeds α. This is a
procedural choice made by the algorithm. Failure to reject independence is not proof that
the variables are independent, especially with small samples or high-dimensional conditioning
sets. Likewise a finite orientation-sweep limit can leave the graph less fully oriented than an
24.17. Discovery beyond the principal language interfaces                                     263


unrestricted run. A result should disclose the restriction and retain the partially resolved
object, rather than infer a unique graph from the fact that an execution completed.
   RecursiveCausalDiscovery.jl 0.2.0 gives a narrower alternative. Its README lists RSL-D as
implemented while marking MARVEL, L-MARVEL and ROL as future work. Its boundary
initialization tests every pair conditional on all other variables. That initial conditioning
problem can be statistically difficult even when a later recursive search reduces the number of
tests. The selected implementation also falls back to a smallest-boundary variable when it
finds no removable variable. The output alone does not reveal that the intended removability
condition was successfully established (sepehr78/RecursiveCausalDiscovery.jl contributors,
2025).
   A specific dispatch issue must be resolved before relying on separate boundary and search
tests. The matrix overload accepts a distinct mkbd_ci_test argument but forwards ci_test
in its place when converting to the table path. Source inspection therefore does not support
the claim that both overloads honor the supplied boundary test. The README’s Julia
requirement and the broader manifest declaration also differ. These findings justify retaining
the package as an experimental comparison, with explicit overload and environment checks.
They do not establish that recursive methods in general are unsuitable.
   The three Julia families have inspected MIT grants. That makes a proposed integration
easier to pursue subject to the notices and dependency terms, but creates no statistical warranty.
The preferred first step is a restricted Julia process with a frozen package environment, explicit
table orientation and graph decoder. Reimplementing every graph method in the common
library would add mathematical and maintenance obligations before demonstrating a consumer
need for the port.


24.17.4     Rust: a native implementation still needs a statistical contract

FLOP/flopsearch 0.3.0 already connects a Rust numerical search to Python and R. Its selected
interface accepts observations by rows, a BIC penalty and a termination choice. It documents
a CPDAG matrix with directed entries one and unresolved entries two. This offers a plausible
alternative to building a new Rust foreign-function interface merely because the core is native
(CausalDisco/flopsearch contributors, 2026).
   The stopping contract needs closer treatment than the word “timeout” suggests. The
selected configuration requires exactly one of a restart count, a timeout or manual termination.
The Python stub states that at least one local search runs to a local optimum. In the inspected
Rust loop, the shown abort check is conditional on being beyond the first restart; it exits an
inner search loop. The surrounding restart loop and delegated numerical calls require further
qualification before the product can promise a strict elapsed deadline. A proposal adapter can
impose an outer worker deadline, but must then say whether interruption returns a validated
best-so-far graph, a checkpoint or only a failed request. It cannot imply that the library’s
timer already provides the desired service guarantee.
   The same entrypoint uses a thread-local random generator, while the selected public
configuration exposes no seed. This limits the replay contract that can be promised from that
interface alone. A frozen binary and dataset are insufficient to establish identical stochastic
output. Before a matched benchmark, decide whether the adapter can bind the random state
or must compare declared output distributions over registered repeated runs. The inspected
MPL-2.0 grant also requires a distribution-specific review of covered source and notices; using
an existing wrapper does not remove that obligation.
  The static DirectLiNGAM path in varlingam-rs 0.1.0 presents a different issue. Its coefficient
assignment is explicitly B[target, predictor], consistent with the column-vector convention
264                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


used above. It selects an ordering, uses a sparse predictor-selection step, and refits retained
predictors on their original scale. The README advertises matching accuracy and substantial
speedups, but those statements are not independent evidence for the proposed banking
workload(edy-os/varlingam-rs contributors, 2026).
   The inspected ordering optimization constructs entropy summaries once. Subsequent itera-
tions update residual data, yet the root-scoring helper ignores its data argument and uses the
cached summaries. There may be a mathematical argument for a particular cached formula-
tion, but it has not been established by reading the performance claim or this helper alone.
The appropriate next comparison freezes the intended algorithm, inspects the optimization
argument and delegated numerical helpers, and tests matched cases where the evolving residual
distribution matters. It would be premature either to assert algorithmic equivalence or to
declare every cached strategy incorrect. The recommendation is to defer default adoption and
retain this as a candidate for focused review. Its inspected MIT or Apache-2.0 choice resolves
one part of reuse, not the algorithmic question.
   why-rs 0.2.1 supplies a particularly clear reason to inspect code beneath an algorithm name.
Its selected PC propagation method implements one rule and explicitly leaves the second and
third rules for future addition. Its independence calculation has hardcoded normal critical
values for α = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10; every other supplied value receives 1.960. The recursive partial-
correlation calculation returns zero when its denominator is zero. These are source-level findings
about the pinned path, not claims derived from executing a Rust benchmark(jwhogg/why-rs
contributors, 2025).
   For example, a two-sided normal reference test at α = 0.02 would use Φ−1 (0.99) ≃ 2.32635.
At a stipulated statistic of 2.2, that reference does not reject independence, whereas the
inspected fallback 1.960 does. Under an exactly standard normal reference law, the latter
threshold has rejection probability approximately 0.05, not 0.02. This scalar calculation
demonstrates a parameter mismatch; it does not estimate an empirical false-positive rate for a
whole discovery procedure (Causal banking proposal project, 2026p). Returning zero for a
degenerate partial correlation can similarly turn an undefined calculation into an independence
decision. The proposed common adapter should preserve numerical failure as a distinct
outcome.
   Together these findings justify rejecting this particular PC implementation as the reference
discovery engine. They do not require rejecting its graph modeling or structural simulation
ideas, which would need their own inspection. A language with strong memory-safety features
does not supply missing orientation rules or validate a statistical reference law.


24.17.5     MATLAB: reference value and reuse rights are separate

Causal Explorer 1.5 documents a broad family of discovery and variable-selection methods.
Its PC manual specifies variables by columns, domain counts for discrete variables, and
mutual-information, G2 or Fisher-z choices. The saved release states P-code compatibility
with MATLAB R2017b. These details make it a useful documented comparator, but neither
they nor a public repository establish an unrestricted source-code dependency (mensxmachi-
na/CausalExplorer_1.5 contributors, 2019).
   The accompanying license restricts the grant to noncommercial educational and research
use by an academic recipient on a single-user system, without permission to redistribute or
create derivative works. The manual’s “public domain” wording cannot by itself resolve this
conflict. Under the saved grant, the proposed commercial library should reject direct adoption
and porting of this distribution. Separately obtained rights could change a later decision. The
proposal can already compare the documented capability against alternatives whose reuse
24.17. Discovery beyond the principal language interfaces                                    265


terms support the intended route. No MATLAB execution, current platform compatibility or
agreement to those terms is implied by this comparison.
   The generalized-score GES reference provides readable MATLAB search and scoring code.
Its selected criteria are negative cross-validated likelihood or negative marginal likelihood,
with separate paths for multidimensional variables. The search seeks decreases in this criterion.
This differs in sign and meaning from the maximized Gaussian score described for Julia; the
raw numerical values are not a common ranking of engines. Its output uses one for a directed
edge and minus one for an unresolved edge, adding another reason to decode by method
identity (Biwei-Huang/Generalized-Score-Functions-for-Causal-Discovery contributors, 2020).
   The inspected cross-validation score forms dense T × T kernel and centering arrays for T
observations, computes data-dependent bandwidths, and slices contiguous validation folds.
One dense double-precision array alone takes approximately 8T 2 bytes before workspace,
copies and other arrays. This storage account follows from the array dimensions; it is not a
measured peak-memory benchmark. Contiguous slices do not automatically constitute a valid
forward-in-time banking evaluation. Training can include observations later than the held-out
block, and the displayed preprocessing is computed before that block is sliced. A proposed
dependent-data study must explicitly decide what is known when, how kernels are constructed
and what the score is intended to validate.
   The top-level GES rights also remain unresolved. The saved repository tree contains a
redistribution notice for an embedded kernel-test component, but that grant does not establish
permission for all surrounding code. The immediate choice is to retain this methodological
comparison and defer redistribution or porting. A clean new implementation would still require
an inspected mathematical specification, independent verification and a reason to maintain
it alongside existing engines. Merely translating MATLAB syntax would not resolve those
obligations.
   Bayes Net Toolbox provides a useful older reference for how distinct search contracts coexist
inside one toolbox. Its K2 entrypoint places variables in rows and observations in columns.
It greedily adds parents from predecessors in a user-supplied ordering, with Bayesian or BIC
score options. Thus the ordering supplies directional restrictions that the procedure does not
learn. If a funding analyst orders quoted rate before retained funding, the algorithm’s inability
to return a reverse parent is partly a consequence of that input, not evidence against the
reverse causal explanation (bayesnet/bnt contributors, 2019).
   The selected BNT PC function instead accepts a conditional-independence callback and
returns a partially directed adjacency with negative one for a directed edge and symmetric
positive ones for an unresolved edge. Data orientation, algorithm output and coefficient
interpretation are three separate conversions. Tests that verify only the number of rows or
edges will miss a semantic reversal. Its BNT license file explicitly uses the GNU Library
General Public License version 2; its name ending in license.gpl.txt is insufficient to
characterize every component of the larger collection. Preserve the actual grant, review
bundled components, and test a selected modern environment before recommending adoption.
An old documentation date establishes neither current maintenance nor current failure, and
historical price references should not enter the investment account as contemporary quotations.


24.17.6     JavaScript: support the analyst without inventing an effect

DAGitty’s JavaScript core is a plausible component for constructing and analyzing a proposed
banking graph. Its selected adjustment interface accepts DAG, PDAG, MAG and PAG types,
reads source and target nodes, and handles adjustment and selection information. The browser
interface and R frontend expose the same underlying family of graph operations (jtextor/dagitty
266                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


contributors, 2024). This is valuable for reviewing a claim such as “adjust for the customer’s
prior relationship score.” It does not prove that the supplied arrows correspond to the bank’s
assignment process.
   The intended integration therefore keeps graph authoring, graph analysis and data-based
discovery separate. An analyst can propose alternative diagrams, attach an observation clock
and identify whether an adjustment query has an answer under each diagram. The proposed
numerical service can then report what estimation would require. The JavaScript graph must
retain its class and endpoint marks through those steps. Rendering a PAG as a DAG to simplify
an interface would give the analyst a stronger assumption than the source result supports. The
inspected GPL-v2 terms and dependency notices require an appropriate distribution design;
process separation alone does not establish exemption from those terms.
   The selected expert-in-loop JavaScript demo illustrates a more subtle boundary. Its
pillai_test fits random forests for two variables on the conditioning variables, predicts on
those same rows, computes residuals, and obtains canonical correlations. Its effectSize field
is the sum of squared canonical correlations, followed by an F -reference calculation. The display
logic can combine that statistic with an arrow from the supplied graph(ankurankan/2025-
causal-discovery-webapp contributors, 2025).
   A squared canonical correlation is an association statistic. It is dimensionless and does not
provide the sign or monetary units of the funding response above. Attaching an arrow to it
does not turn it into ∂E[F | do(Q)]/∂Q. Nor does the inspected formula establish a calibrated
null distribution after fitting flexible residual models on the same rows. A serious integration
would need a stated statistical target, an argument or measured calibration for the actual
fitting procedure, and appropriate held-out or cross-fitted alternatives. The product can use
the interface idea for discussing disagreements while declining to display the statistic as a
banking treatment effect.
   The package metadata declares ISC, while the selected tree does not supply a complete top-
level grant sufficient for this review. Its test command is a placeholder that exits unsuccessfully.
Neither fact proves that the interaction idea is unusable; both prevent treating a successful
package installation or a license field as a completed adoption assessment. The recommended
next use is a separately designed graph-review interaction, with any numerical comparison
delegated to an admitted scientific method.


24.17.7     An integration sequence that preserves useful alternatives

The proposed first implementation should admit a small set of mathematical operations. One
Julia PC/GES path can test the independence and score-search boundary; FLOP can test
an existing native engine behind an R/Python interface; DAGitty can test graph review
and adjustment. Each has a concrete reason to be considered. The unqualified Rust paths,
unresolved MATLAB rights and browser residual statistic need not block those independent
experiments. They remain explicit alternatives or rejected current choices, with the condition
that would change the decision.
   A common adverse-fixture suite should verify both input and result meaning. The funding
construction supplies a weighted DAG whose transpose changes the effect, an unresolved
chain with several compatible effects, and graph mark conventions that cannot be read as
coefficients. Other fixtures should include constant variables, singular covariance, a caller-
supplied nondefault significance level, changed variable order, a limited conditioning depth and
an interrupted search. Each engine must preserve an undefined calculation or unsupported
request as such. Agreement on a convenient regular dataset is inadequate if the adapter silently
turns these cases into a definite causal answer.
24.18. Latent discovery beyond the principal language interfaces                              267


   Matched comparison must then separate four families of assumptions. Constraint methods
depend on their selected independence tests and graph premises. Score methods depend on
likelihood or surrogate criterion, penalties and search restrictions. Functional methods rely on
the declared structural and disturbance restrictions, including the non-Gaussian conditions
developed earlier. Continuous optimization methods impose a numerical acyclicity condition in
addition to their statistical objective. The selected other-language sources do not complete the
census of functional or continuous methods; the earlier Python comparison supplies concrete
alternatives without implying that a Julia or Rust equivalent is absent. No implementation
family should inherit another’s causal qualification solely because both return a matrix.
   Only after these semantic checks should a bounded prototype compare runtime, memory,
failed requests and the consequences for an actual decision rule. Freeze the source and
environment identities, data units, baselines, stopping criteria and failure account before final
evaluation. These requirements define a proposed comparison; the source inspections and exact
examples here do not claim to have executed it. The investment choice is therefore specific:
integrate a few well-understood paths, preserve useful alternatives, and spend on porting
only when an identified consumer or measured bottleneck makes that additional responsibility
worthwhile.


24.18      Latent discovery beyond the principal language interfaces
A lender may observe that an intensified contact policy accompanies higher repayment.
Unrecorded borrower distress can influence both contact allocation and repayment, while the
analysed records may include only accounts that reached a particular servicing channel. A
discovery component must distinguish unmeasured common causes, conditioning on selection
and an unresolved causal direction. A common matrix interface is useful only if it carries those
distinctions into the intervention query.
   Julia, Rust, MATLAB and JavaScript offer different parts of this workflow. The selected
implementations below include an FCI path, a functional-model method, a recursive skeleton
learner, a latent-measurement model, a tuning layer and graph analysis. They are not
interchangeable implementations of one estimand. The bounded repository survey retained
the earlier language leads and added five targeted searches. The Rust and MATLAB latent
searches returned only the first twenty of 640 and 74 results; other queries contained mirrors
and unrelated matches. The search index was accessed after the 7 October 2026 cutoff, while
inspected implementation claims use earlier pinned source revisions. These limits preclude
a complete historical census or a claim that unrepresented languages lack suitable software.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026aj)


24.18.1     Julia FCI: preserve the graph before improving the interface

CausalInference.jl exposes FCI through an independence-test callback and through table
interfaces for Gaussian and conditional-mutual-information tests. Its result is a marked graph.
For vertices i and j, the property on the stored arc from i to j describes the endpoint at j; the
reverse arc stores the endpoint at i. A tail–arrow pair, two arrowheads and two circles therefore
have different meanings even though the container has two arcs in each case. A process adapter
should serialize the ordered endpoint pair and graph type explicitly. Interpreting two stored
arcs as two causal directions would invent feedback. (mschauer/CausalInference.jl, 2026)
   The implementation supplies useful components: an initial skeleton, a possible-separation
search, orientation rules and an option controlling the additional orientation rules. The selected
tests include a graph with hidden variables and a selection example that closes over the selected
268                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


node in its oracle. Those tests show what the authors intended to exercise. They are not a mea-
sured finite-sample coverage guarantee for the proposed lender. (mschauer/CausalInference.jl,
2026)
   Several operational details need to enter a prospective qualification. The possible-separation
and selected orientation searches request at most one hundred shortest paths per endpoint pair.
A claim that all relevant witnesses have been considered needs an argument for that cap, an
explicit restricted regime, or a different search. Separating subsets are materialized as power
sets; a path cap does not make subset enumeration cheap. The initial skeleton call also omits
the keyword arguments that the later independence calls receive. A selection argument passed
only through those keywords can therefore give the two stages different questions. Binding the
intended selection law inside one tested callback is a concrete way to avoid that discrepancy,
subject to comparison with an independent oracle. (mschauer/CausalInference.jl, 2026)
   Graph presentation is another boundary. The inspected plotting preparation creates one
display edge and assigns styles for several endpoint combinations, but has no explicit branch
for two arrowheads. The raw result and the upstream tests can contain that combination. A
new adapter should consume the raw endpoint properties and refuse an unsupported display
conversion. This is a static source finding; no rendered Julia failure has been observed here.
The root MIT notice makes a narrowly reviewed integration plausible, but dependency notices,
an installed Julia environment, bounded resource behavior and matched graph tests remain
necessary. Rewriting the algorithm in another language would add obligations without resolving
these semantic questions. (mschauer/CausalInference.jl, 2026)


24.18.2    A Rust RCD label does not establish equivalence to the published
           method

The original RCD paper specifies a linear acyclic model X = BX + ΛF + E, with mutually
independent non-Gaussian external influences. Its procedure repeatedly learns ancestor sets,
distinguishes parents from indirect ancestors and then identifies unresolved confounded pairs.
Its stated target does not identify the direct relation between a pair that shares a latent
confounder. This is a stronger distributional regime and a different output contract from an
arbitrary latent-graph procedure. (Maeda and Shimizu, 2020)
   The inspected varlingam-rs path instead starts with a DirectLiNGAM adjacency, examines
residual dependence only for pairs without a direct coefficient above 10−10 , and proposes to
refine the adjacency by reducing the coefficients of those flagged pairs. Its dependence score
combines absolute correlation with an entropy-based contrast. The threshold is described as
a p-value in a configuration comment, but the returned quantity is not a calibrated p-value.
The reported pair confidence is the capped score. Connected groups of flagged pairs receive
latent effects computed from averages of those scores, rather than estimated coefficients of an
identified latent-variable model. The inspected basic test prints a result without asserting that
the stipulated confounded pair was recovered. (edy-os/varlingam-rs, 2026)
   The refinement rule has a useful exact implication. Let bij denote an initial coefficient,
let ϵ = 10−10 , and let cij be a flagged-pair score. A pair is considered for refinement only if
both directions have magnitude at most ϵ. Refinement multiplies those entries by 1 − cij /2.
Therefore every entry whose initial magnitude exceeds ϵ is unchanged throughout the loop.
With exact zero entries, the proposed correction multiplies zero by a factor and leaves it zero.
Stopping when the number of flagged pairs is unchanged does not establish convergence of a
causal objective; the declared coefficient-convergence tolerance is not used in this path. This
reasoning concerns the inspected formulas, without claiming that the upstream engine was
executed. (edy-os/varlingam-rs, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ai)
24.18. Latent discovery beyond the principal language interfaces                                269


  Consider a declared banking mechanism with independent centered variables U, EA , EY ,
each of variance one:

                             A = U + EA ,       Y = 12 A + 2U + EY .

   Here A is contact intensity and Y is a recovery deviation measured in hundreds of dollars.
The common cause U is hidden borrower state. Since var(A) = 2 and cov(A, Y ) = 3, the
population regression coefficient is 3/2. The effect of increasing A by one unit is 1/2. At
an imposed intervention cost of USD 80, the corresponding net values are USD 70 from the
associational calculation and minus USD 30 from the structural intervention. The projection
permits both a directed effect and a latent common-cause relation; retaining a directed
coefficient alone is insufficient. If an adapter receives 3/2 as an initial substantive coefficient,
the inspected refinement rule cannot change it. This last statement is conditional on that
input, not a claim that DirectLiNGAM was run and returned it. (Causal banking proposal,
2026ai)
   The proposal should reject this path as a default qualified RCD backend and defer porting it.
The published method remains a substantive alternative, alongside a graph-class method when
its assumptions are appropriate. A revisit requires an explicit algorithmic correspondence
or a clearly different method claim, an inspected numerical dependency closure, meaningful
recovery tests and a registered comparison including the failures above. The Rust package’s
MIT/Apache notices do not resolve the scientific discrepancy or the remaining dependency
review. (edy-os/varlingam-rs, 2026; Maeda and Shimizu, 2020)


24.18.3     MATLAB contributes several distinct kinds of latent analysis

The selected L-MARVEL implementation returns a skeleton, separating sets and conditional-
independence counts. Its recursive removal logic uses estimated Markov boundaries; the
supplied initializer tests each pair conditional on all other variables. The example evaluates
skeleton precision and recall. These outputs can support a discovery pipeline, but the selected
entrypoint does not return a fully oriented PAG or an intervention effect. (Ehsan-Mokhtarian/L-
MARVEL, 2026)
   The matrix is initialized with −1 for unresolved entries. If no removable variable is found,
the routine exits its loop; unresolved entries must not be silently converted to present or absent
edges. One removability subtest uses the fixed significance argument 0.8, even when the main
call uses 0.01. The independence helper inverts a sample correlation matrix and combines
a Fisher transform with a Student distribution function, without an explicit singularity or
positive-degrees-of-freedom guard in the inspected function. These concrete choices require
an explained test contract and adverse cases, including nearly collinear risk measurements
and too few accounts for the conditioning dimension. The root MIT notice is useful, while
embedded helper attributions and the MATLAB numerical/toolbox environment still require
review. The appropriate route is an optional skeleton component after those checks, not a
silent replacement for FCI. (Ehsan-Mokhtarian/L-MARVEL, 2026)
   The GIN reference implementation addresses latent measurement structure. It takes variables
in rows, centers them, finds clusters of observed variables, and orders latent variables. That
layout differs from the samples-in-rows interface of the selected L-MARVEL code. Its inspected
condition test derives a contrast from a singular-value decomposition of a cross-covariance
block and tests the contrast against other measurements using a bundled kernel independence
routine. The default ordering path delegates to a mutual-information helper; the alternative
independence-test path is not the default. Neither cluster labels nor an estimated order
270                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


identify a monetary effect without a further model and query. (fengxie009/GIN-Condition-for-
Estimating-Latent-Variable-Causal-Graphs, 2026)
   A small algebraic diagnostic clarifies one implementation risk. Suppose Y1 = U + E1 ,
Y2 = U + E2 and Z = U + EZ , with mutually independent centered components of variance
one. The cross-covariance vector is (1, 1)⊤ . The nonzero vector ω = (1, −1)⊤ satisfies
ω ⊤ cov(Y, Z) = 0, and its contrast Y1 − Y2 = E1 − E2 is independent of Z by construction.
               P
Nevertheless, i ωi = 0. The selected source treats a zero sum of the contrast coefficients
as a trivial solution. A zero sum is not a zero vector; the example has squared norm two
and contrast variance two. A real SVD returns a normalized vector subject to rounding,
so the runtime outcome requires an actual fixture rather than an assumption about exact
floating-point equality. The diagnostic still identifies the invariant the proposed adapter
must check. (fengxie009/GIN-Condition-for-Estimating-Latent-Variable-Causal-Graphs, 2026;
Causal banking proposal, 2026ai)
   The complete pinned GIN tree contains component notices for the bundled kernel code but
no inspected repository-wide grant covering the whole method. The component notice cannot
be promoted into permission for every file. Full theorem support, the delegated ordering and
independence routines, applicable rights and a qualified environment remain unresolved. Retain
the package as a reference candidate and defer direct adoption or porting. Its missing scientific
and dependency evidence is explicit, rather than treated as an exception to the proposal’s
source standard. (fengxie009/GIN-Condition-for-Estimating-Latent-Variable-Causal-Graphs,
2026)
   OCT addresses yet another problem: tuning discovery configurations. Its MATLAB driver
delegates FCI-family searches to a separately supplied Tetrad jar; the README requests
version 6.8.1. This is a wrapper relationship, not independent corroboration from two discovery
engines. The code retains both a PAG and a selected MAG, and the latent converter
distinguishes circles, arrowheads and tails using codes 1, 2 and 3. Its ordinary converter, by
contrast, maps several different paired endpoints to the same symmetric binary entries. The
graph type must determine which conversion is permitted. (mensxmachina/OCT, 2026)
   OCT’s selected tuning function uses ten row folds, fits predictive models to estimated
Markov-boundary variables, and compares prediction information with a sparsity comparison.
In the MAG branch it uses a selected MAG produced from the PAG. A good prediction
score does not prove the selected MAG or its effect query correct. Random row folds also
require reconsideration when banking records share borrower histories or calendar shocks. The
proposed reuse is the explicit configuration-and-comparison pattern, with a dependence-aware
split and retained class uncertainty. The root GPLv3 text, commercial MATLAB requirements,
historical Java dependency and uninspected tuning helpers make whole-workflow adoption
conditional. (mensxmachina/OCT, 2026)


24.18.4    JavaScript graph analysis is a separate component

DAGitty’s JavaScript core can analyse supplied graph and query objects, including selected
adjustment operations on DAG, PDAG, MAG and PAG types. It can therefore help an analyst
inspect a diagram or compare admissible adjustment choices after discovery. Its function call
does not establish the diagram from repayment data. The selected validator explicitly leaves
proper MAG and PAG validation as unfinished work, while performing some checks such as
the absence of semidirected cycles. An affirmative result from that validator cannot alone
certify every graph invariant required by the proposal. (jtextor/dagitty, 2026)
  An internal PAG-to-PDAG transformation maps unresolved endpoint classes to ordinary
edge classes for downstream graph operations. A transformation may be useful inside a justified
24.19. Commercial discovery: compare the retained graph before the interface                  271


calculation without being an acceptable export of the original causal knowledge. The service
should retain the input graph, its endpoint marks, the query and the transformation’s purpose;
it should not return the transformed object as a newly learned unique DAG. The selected
tests include PAG and conditioning examples, providing useful prospective fixtures. The root
GPLv2 text requires a distribution-specific review before reuse; a browser or process boundary
does not itself settle those obligations. (jtextor/dagitty, 2026)
   Selection needs its own diagnostic beside latent-confounding examples. Let A and Y
be independent fair binary variables, and retain records only when S = 1{A = Y }. In
the full population the causal effect of intervening on A is zero. Among retained records,
P (Y = 1 | A = 1, S = 1) = 1 and P (Y = 1 | A = 0, S = 1) = 0. A lender analysing a
channel selected jointly by allocation and repayment can therefore encounter a large conditional
association with no treatment benefit. This declared mechanism tests whether the interface
retains the selection rule; it does not establish a general finite-sample discovery guarantee or
satisfy every algorithm’s faithfulness assumption. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ai)


24.18.5     A practical reuse portfolio

The immediate design can use one typed graph contract with distinct skeleton, equivalence-
class, selected-graph and latent-measurement outputs. Endpoint pairs, separating sets where
available, test settings, variable order, selection declarations, unresolved entries and resource
limits belong in that contract. An effect request should either receive an identification argument
for its stated graph information or an explicit unresolved result. A successful serialization or
predictive score cannot supply that argument.
   For the next public or generated prototype, Julia FCI and a previously reviewed FCI
implementation can be compared through exact conditional- independence oracles before
sampling error is introduced. L-MARVEL can enter a separate skeleton comparison. DAGitty
can contribute graph analysis subject to its validation boundary. OCT supplies a tuning design
to examine, with its Tetrad backend counted once. The inspected Rust RCD path and GIN
code require the particular scientific, numerical and rights repairs above before adoption. This
portfolio gives each component an attainable next test while preserving the alternatives when
a component cannot satisfy its contract.
   The unanswered coverage questions remain concrete. The bounded search leaves additional
Rust and MATLAB pages, previously identified measurement-error, triad-constraint and
ETIO implementations, and other language registries to inspect. The L-MARVEL and GIN
scholarly originals and remaining dependency paths are necessary before inheriting their full
scientific guarantees. None of the selected packages has been executed in this review, and no
banking accuracy, latency or return on investment is inferred. Those limitations restrict the
proposed claims and adoption decisions; they do not prevent source-grounded architecture and
inexpensive diagnostic work. (Causal banking proposal, 2026aj)


24.19      Commercial discovery: compare the retained graph be-
           fore the interface
Commercial Bayesian-network systems already address substantial parts of the workflow that
a new causal product would have to build. The relevant comparison includes interactive model
construction, structure and parameter learning, background restrictions, model exchange and
programmatic inference. The proposal should specify which of these services it would reuse
and which scientific contract it would add. A common command-line or MCP interface alone
272                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


would not establish an advantage over an existing modeling environment.
  The following comparison uses inspected vendor technical documentation. The GeNIe
manual declares version 5.0.R2, built on 23 November 2024; the SMILE programmer’s manual
declares version 2.2.4.R1, built on 27 April 2024. The public URLs were retrieved after the 7
October 2026 literature cutoff, so those headers identify the declared manuals without proving
their exact historical bytes at the cutoff. The inspected BayesiaLab pages are mutable and
do not consistently pin the technical discussion to a numbered release. Their findings are
consequently dated documentation observations. No vendor executable, commercial trial or
paid service was run for this comparison (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024g,j; Bayesia, 2026d).
   GeNIe exposes both a PC route and a Bayesian Search route. The PC manual documents
a default significance level of 0.05, maximum adjacency of eight, and no time limit by
default. It allows continuous data under a multivariate Gaussian assumption and returns a
pattern for further inspection. The manual’s suggested histogram and scatterplot checks are
useful exploratory diagnostics; they cannot establish the full joint distribution or the causal
assumptions. Its Bayesian Search discussion instead describes score-guided hill climbing with
restarts, a BDeu-related sample-size parameter and a structural prior. A seed of zero uses
the processor clock, so it is not a fixed reproducibility seed. These are different procedures to
configure and compare, even though they share a graphical application (BayesFusion, LLC,
2024f,d).
   The pattern editor is a particularly important capability. Its documentation explicitly
discusses an equivalence class and permits inspection of unresolved arcs. It also documents a
Create DAG command that randomly chooses directions for unresolved arcs while producing an
acyclic graph. That command can be useful for constructing a representative Bayesian network,
but the choice does not add observational evidence for the selected directions. The proposed
product must preserve the pre-conversion pattern and label any selected representative. It
should not describe GeNIe as necessarily forcing a single graph: the documented pattern
workflow is itself a useful alternative (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024e).
   Consider the funding law in Section 18. Its three Gaussian models share the same covariance
but imply effects of either zero or 0.48 thousand currency units per percentage point. A
proposed interface that keeps only a randomly chosen representative could report either zero or
120 currency units per customer for the 25 basis point action. The difference would come from
the extra orientation choice. This is a project counterexample to a lossy integration design; it
is not an observed GeNIe estimate or a claim that the vendor’s documented interface conceals
that choice. A matched trial should inspect the pattern, the conversion and the returned effect
separately (Causal banking research project, 2026g).
   BayesiaLab supplies another relevant alternative. Its structural-learning overview describes
heuristic search and an MDL score used to compare learned networks. The EQ page explicitly
describes search over equivalence classes. That makes class-aware search a documented
competitor capability, rather than a novelty the proposed library can claim simply by retaining
ambiguous graphs. A score optimized over graph structures still does not validate the banking
assignment mechanism or supply an intervention-effect confidence region. Those are additional
scientific questions (Bayesia, 2026d,b).
   The EQ page also documents a consequential distinction among restrictions: fixed arcs
are treated as ordinary arcs, whereas forbidden arcs and temporal indices are taken into
account. A workflow that marks a bank-supplied edge as fixed must therefore inspect the
selected algorithm’s actual meaning for that setting. A generic required_edges field cannot
be mapped to a similarly named graphical control without a behavioral check. The same
page’s description of efficiency is a vendor claim, not a measured runtime result or a proof of
finding the global optimum in this proposal (Bayesia, 2026b).
24.20. What a commercial engine boundary would have to preserve                             273


24.20      What a commercial engine boundary would have to
           preserve
SMILE is the proprietary C++ engine underlying GeNIe. Its programmer’s manual describes
compiled platform distributions and wrappers for Java, Python, R, .NET and COM. These are
access paths to an engine, not independent discoveries of five competing causal implementations.
Their individual interoperability still needs review. The C++ manual does not, by itself, verify
that every wrapper exposes every endpoint type and error state (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024j).
   The DSL_pc::Learn reference returns a DSL_pattern and a success or error code. A progress
callback can interrupt learning, in which case the documented return is DSL_INTERRUPTED.
The time limit is checked after an iteration, so the documented setting is not evidence of a
strict external wall-time guarantee. A resource-bounded wrapper should retain interruption
as an incomplete computation and enforce its own lifecycle contract if a hard deadline is
required. Stopping the process cannot make the unfinished graph a completed scientific answer
(BayesFusion, LLC, 2024m).
   Graph conversion also requires care. The DSL_pattern reference declares absent, undirected
and directed edge types, indexed by the dataset’s variable order. Its conversion to a network
assumes that the dataset and pattern coordinates correspond. GeNIe’s graphical pattern
documentation uses a richer visual description, including colored and double-headed arcs.
These pages alone do not establish a complete equivalence between every graphical mark and
the C++ representation, or a standard CPDAG/PAG serialization. Before reuse, the adapter
needs named-node fixtures that distinguish a collider, an unresolved path, a deliberately
transposed matrix and a permuted dataset. It should preserve any unresolved mapping as an
unsupported conversion (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024l,e).
   Bayesia’s programmatic offering needs a different distinction. Its API overview separates
development and production configurations, and it describes a stateless REST service for
inference with an existing Bayesian network. That description does not establish that the same
REST service performs structural discovery. The overview also describes Java configurations
and production licensing by the number of simultaneously loaded model instances. Its table
distinguishes customer-hosted Java models from the described REST service’s hosted model
location. An integration proposal must select the actual interface and operation before
estimating deployment cost or data movement. A label such as “Bayesia API” is too broad for
either conclusion (Bayesia, 2026a).

24.22        License, version and trial questions that remain open
SMILE’s licensing documentation separates development from deployment. Academic use
is restricted to the described academic research and teaching context; other development
use requires a commercial license. Server and end-user deployment are separate licensing
categories. A free evaluation download therefore cannot be treated as authorization for
embedding and redistributing the engine. The source is proprietary, so the immediate reuse
candidate is a licensed engine boundary; the inspected material does not provide an open-source
implementation to port (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024k).
   BayesiaLab Professional’s licensing page describes a locally installed desktop application,
purchase or rental, and single-user or floating-token choices. This is consistent with a separately
described hosted inference API: desktop installation and web-service deployment are different
products. The API overview describes online license validation and simultaneous-instance
limits. Exact edition, workload, support and deployment terms need to accompany a cost
comparison. No negotiated price, infrastructure cost or saving has been measured here, and
the proposal has not accepted commercial terms (Bayesia, 2026c,a).
  The present evidence supports a concrete next experiment: compare one native open-source
PC path with the documented GeNIe/SMILE pattern path, using the same generated iid law
and supplied background restrictions. Preserve unresolved effects, coordinate changes, inter-
ruption and failed requests. Evaluate BayesiaLab EQ separately as a score-based alternative,
24.23. Commercial latent-variable methods and the banking question                          275


with its own restrictions and selected interface. The output would answer whether each chosen
route preserves the agreed service and what complete workflow effort it requires. It would not
rank all vendor methods by one point-estimate error.
   The landscape remains incomplete. HUGIN technical material was not recovered in the
bounded acquisition, the attempted SAS technical locations were unavailable, and the Math-
Works search request was denied. Those are source gaps, not findings of missing product
capabilities. Further commercial platforms, dated editions and their exact methods require
their own primary review. Public documentation can advance these comparisons now; a paid
trial is justified only after a particular unresolved behavior or cost could change the proposed
choice. The evidence supports a restricted comparison of the documented alternatives and
further source review before any wider claim.


24.23      Commercial latent-variable methods and the banking
           question
A relationship manager can observe borrower risk that is absent from the analyst’s table. The
same risk can influence a rate concession and the subsequent credit loss. A commercial system
that offers latent variables is therefore a relevant alternative, but that phrase covers several
different services. An analyst may specify a measurement model and estimate its parameters;
a clustering procedure may construct unobserved customer classes; a discovery procedure
may retain causal relationships compatible with hidden common causes; or a randomized
experiment may identify an effect for an unobserved compliance class. The proposed product
needs to choose among these services using the decision and information available to the bank.
   This comparison examines the declared GeNIe manual family 5.0.R2, mutable BayesiaLab
and Netica help, the Stata latent-class example carrying a 2025 copyright and release-19 data
reference, SAS/STAT 14.1 CALIS documentation, and Chapter 7 of the guide linked by Mplus
as Version 8. These are specific documentation observations. The public copies were acquired
after the 7 October 2026 literature cutoff; their headers and links identify editions without
establishing every page’s exact bytes at that cutoff. No commercial executable was run, and
documentation of one path cannot establish the presence or absence of every other method in
the vendor’s ecosystem. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024g,h; Bayesia, 2026k; Norsys Software Corp.,
2026b; StataCorp LLC, 2025; SAS Institute Inc., 2026; Muthen and Muthen, 2026b)


24.23.1    The object that must survive a discovery interface

For causal discovery with unmeasured common causes, a learned latent class is different from
an equivalence class of causal graphs. In the no-selection ancestral-graph construction reviewed
by Zhang (2008, Section 3), a maximal ancestral graph represents marginal independence
and ancestral relations among observed variables. A directed edge records ancestry in the
underlying causal DAG; it need not exclude additional hidden confounding. A bidirected edge
records the absence of ancestry in either direction and the presence of a latent common-cause
path. It does not identify a particular borrower-risk factor, its dimension, or its measurement
equation.
   A partial ancestral graph, or PAG, represents a Markov equivalence class of these graphs.
Its invariant tails and arrowheads are shared across the class, while a circle records an
unresolved endpoint. Under the stated Markov, faithfulness and graph assumptions, conditional-
independence information can constrain this object. A fitted mixture component or a posterior
probability of customer membership is a different mathematical output. Neither can replace a
276                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


circle endpoint merely because its label contains the word “latent.’ ’ The cited construction
excludes selection; Zhang explicitly notes that selection requires a broader ancestral-graph
class and additional rules. A loan-book analysis conditional on approval must retain that extra
question. (Zhang, 2008, pp.1442–1445)
   The proposed library consequently needs separate representations for a supplied latent-
variable model, a fitted measurement or mixture model, a discovered graph class and an
identified intervention query. Parameters, class probabilities and graph endpoints have different
meanings. The separation also determines the correct baseline: a commercial mixture fit
should be compared with the same mixture specification, while a proposed PAG operation
should be compared with a discovery method under the same latent and selection assumptions.
The presence of a diagram is insufficient to make these comparisons interchangeable.


24.23.2    A good observational fit can leave the lending effect unresolved

Let A be a centered concession and Y a centered subsequent loss. Consider two Gaussian
structural models with independent disturbances. In the first,

and therefore the same centered bivariate Gaussian distribution. Nevertheless, replacing the

second. The second model’s observational regression slope remains 3/5; it describes risk-related
assignment, not an intervention response. These two models establish nonidentification within
any proposed model class containing both. They do not enumerate every compatible model
or establish that the full identified set contains only two effects. (Causal banking proposal
project, 2026k)
   For an explicitly illustrative monetary scale, let one concession unit equal one percentage
point and one centered-loss unit equal one thousand currency units per borrower. A 25 basis
point action then changes expected loss by 150 currency units under the first model and
zero under the second. The equality of the observed likelihoods cannot choose between those
recommendations. Increasing the observational sample or selecting the better optimizer cannot
resolve an equality of distributions. The calculation is exact project algebra with stipulated
units, not a fitted bank estimate or a vendor result. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026k)

with independent proxy noise of variance s. There is still no causal effect of A on Y . Given

With s = 1, adjustment reduces the observational slope from 1/2 to 1/3, but the causal effect
remains zero. Only the stipulated error-free limit removes this particular source of confounding.
This example does not rule out identification from appropriately designed multiple proxies
or a justified measurement model; it shows why the mere availability of an inferred score is
insufficient. If the score is trained using post-offer outcomes, its information clock needs an
additional review. (Causal banking proposal project, 2026k)


24.23.3     Existing engines for supplied models and latent classes

GeNIe’s parameter-learning documentation starts with an existing network whose structure
is already defined. Its EM procedure can learn parameters with missing observations and
explicitly discusses random initialization when latent variables are present. The source states
that parameter learning leaves structure fixed. It also makes a consequential distinction: its
continuous multivariate-Gaussian EM implementation described on that page does not allow
missing values. The proposal cannot infer that every data-type/missingness combination is
supported from the general EM label. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024h)
   The structure-learning introduction describes a separate interface over selected data columns.
In that declared manual, the routines accept categorical variables; PC additionally accepts
jointly Gaussian continuous variables. Mixed categorical/continuous structure learning requires
discretization, and the manual states a missing-record restriction with an exception for the
Naive Bayes routine that constructs its prescribed structure. These are documented restrictions
of the selected interface, not a claim about all current BayesFusion products. An initial reuse
route is therefore a supplied discrete latent network with an explicit observation model and
parameter-fitting contract. Its fitted parameters must not be advertised as a discovery result
that has resolved hidden confounding. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024i,h)
   BayesiaLab supplies substantive latent-representation alternatives. Its Data Clustering
documentation creates a new factor node whose states are clusters. The ordinary construction
uses a Naive Bayes structure with the factor as parent of the manifest variables, random
initialization, and EM updates based on posterior class probabilities. Conditional independence
of the manifest variables given the class is part of that representation. The documented Multinet
alternative combines a Naive structure with class-specific maximum-weight spanning trees and
hard class assignments during its alternating procedure. Thus the vendor offers more than a
single generic clustering option; the representation and assignment policy belong in a matched
comparison. (Bayesia, 2026k)
   Its heterogeneity option changes the objective toward segmentations that increase a stated
mutual-information index with the target. That can be useful for describing different customer
groups. An increase in that index is neither an estimate of treatment-effect heterogeneity
nor evidence that the induced factor blocks every confounding path. The adjacent Variable
Clustering tool groups nodes using Arc Force, offers a dendrogram, and can feed Multiple
Clustering to construct synthetic variables. It groups variables rather than immediately
identifying a customer’s hidden risk. A proposed integration must retain which of these
operations was performed, its variables and target, soft versus hard assignments, and the data
used to construct the representation. (Bayesia, 2026k,l)
   Netica’s Learning Algorithms help describes counting, EM and conjugate gradient methods
for conditional probability tables. Counting uses cases with definite values for the node and
its parents; the page directs latent or incomplete-data applications toward EM or gradient
methods and notes local optima. Its adjacent Structure Learning page describes TAN learning
around a selected diagnostic or predictive target, expressly motivating outgoing target links
by predictive dependence. This is a useful modeling and prediction alternative. It does not
278                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


supply a causal interpretation of those target-to-predictor arrows. The structure page refers
to the version 5.00 introduction of TAN; that historical feature description is not a verified
inventory of a current Netica release. (Norsys Software Corp., 2026a,b)
   The Netica discussion writes an objective proportional to p(D | N )p(N ), where N denotes
the candidate network and its parameters. When the prior varies across candidates, this is a
posterior criterion, even though the accompanying discussion also uses maximum-likelihood
language. A matched adapter comparison must therefore record the prior and existing
probability tables as well as the reported fit statistic. The product should compare the actual
configured objective; a shared method name does not establish numerical equivalence. (Norsys
Software Corp., 2026a)
   Stata’s worked latent-class example is more explicit about the fitted quantity. It supplies a
two-class categorical latent variable through lclass(C 2) and estimates class-specific intercepts
for four binary responses using gsem. The example reports marginal class probabilities, posterior
membership probabilities and hard assignments obtained by thresholding those probabilities.
These are distinct summaries: the reported marginal proportions need not equal the fractions
of people assigned by the threshold rule. Neither summary is automatically an observed
pre-offer covariate or a randomized treatment class. (StataCorp LLC, 2025, pp.2–6)
   The same Stata example shows an EM initialization reaching its iteration limit before
full-model fitting converges. That is not evidence that the final fit failed; it demonstrates
why an integration should preserve stage-specific diagnostics instead of interpreting the first
convergence message as the entire result. A prototype can reuse this supplied-model workflow
as a latent-class comparator while retaining the chosen class count, starts, fitted probabilities,
uncertainty and final convergence status. No Stata execution is reported here. (StataCorp
LLC, 2025, pp.3–5)
   SAS/STAT 14.1 CALIS provides another substantial alternative for specified latent models.
Its overview describes factor, measurement-error, covariance, path and other structural-equation
specifications, several modeling languages, parameter constraints, fit diagnostics and reusable
output data sets. ML and GLS carry multivariate-normal assumptions in the documented
formulation. FIML handles missing data under the stated missing-at-random assumption. The
source distinguishes Satorra–Bentler scaled inference from the separate robust procedure that
downweights outliers. These choices address different statistical problems; selecting one does
not validate the causal assignment or make nonrandom observation ignorable. The new product
currently lacks this breadth of fitted-model workflow and should justify any replacement rather
than treating a new interface as equivalent functionality. (SAS Institute Inc., 2026)


24.23.4     Mplus is also a causal-effect comparator

The Mplus mixture chapter distinguishes measurement and structural models, supports
categorical latent classes and extensions with continuous latent variables, and describes multiple
starts for local solutions. It documents options for missing data and complex sampling, including
strata, clusters and weights. These declarations identify specific modeling alternatives; they
do not imply that any chosen default handles the bank’s sampling or missingness law. A
comparison should reproduce the selected model and settings before measuring resource use or
decision quality. (Muthen and Muthen, 2026b, pp.165–171)
   More importantly for this proposal, Examples 7.23 and 7.24 describe complier-average
causal-effect estimation in randomized trials. In Example 7.23, compliance class is observed in
the treatment arm and latent in the control arm. Training indicators constrain membership, the
noncomplier treatment slope is fixed at zero, and the complier slope is estimated. The source
identifies maximum likelihood with robust standard errors as the default for this example.
24.23. Commercial latent-variable methods and the banking question                            279


This is an existing documented causal-effect use of a latent-class model. The proposal cannot
claim novelty merely from combining a latent variable with an intervention target. (Muthen
and Muthen, 2026b, pp.203–205)
  A banking interpretation is a randomized assistance offer. In this example, Y denotes
net customer value in thousands of currency units, so a positive effect is beneficial. Let Z
denote the offer, D receipt of assistance, and C a pre-existing compliance type. For a declared
one-sided design, suppose D = ZC, Z is randomized independently of potential outcomes and
C, and the offer has no direct effect on the outcome apart from receipt. Consistency and a
positive first stage are also required. Under these restrictions, with pc = Pr(C = 1), the offer
contrasts satisfy
                        ∆D = pc ,      ∆Y = pc E{Y (1) − Y (0) | C = 1}.
The ratio identifies an effect for compliers, rather than the effect of offering assistance to
every eligible borrower. The experimental design and the exclusion restriction supply the
interpretation; a fitted class alone does not.
   An exact four-cell project law illustrates the distinction. Set pc = 2/5, assign the offer with
probability 1/2, and define Y = 2 + C + 3D in thousands of currency units. The first stage
is 2/5, the offer effect is 6/5, and the receipt effect for compliers is three. If an additional
direct offer effect of 1/5 is present, the offer effect becomes 7/5 and the same ratio becomes
7/2, although the effect of receipt holding the offer fixed remains three. Communication or
reassurance accompanying an offer can therefore matter to the model. The exact enumeration
is a proposed-design diagnostic, not an Mplus replication or an empirical estimate. (Causal
banking proposal project, 2026k)
   Even a documented encoding deserves a numerical check. Example 7.24 sets binary-
indicator logit thresholds to +15 and −15 while describing perfect class measurement. The
smaller implied probability is 1/(1 + e15 ), approximately 3.0590 × 10−7 , rather than an exact
structural zero. This observation does not demonstrate an empirical failure of Mplus. It
means that a proposed adapter must distinguish a deliberately near-deterministic measurement
specification from a hard membership constraint, including in comparisons with Example
7.23’s training-variable route. (Muthen and Muthen, 2026b; Causal banking proposal project,
2026k, pp.205–207)

   The commercial systems provide capabilities the proposal has not implemented: mature
model specification, latent-class fitting, diagnostic displays, specialized estimation choices
and, in the Mplus example, an experimental causal estimand. The proposed contribution
is a verifiable connection from the banking question to these operations, with preserved
assumptions, graph ambiguity, observation clocks and monetary targets. That contribution
remains a prototype obligation. A generic CLI or MCP endpoint cannot create the missing
measurement or assignment evidence.
   Direct adoption as a complete latent-confounded discovery service is unsupported by this
document set. That is a statement about the reviewed evidence, not a finding that the vendors
lack such services. Selected commercial engines may instead be integrated for supplied-model or
experimental-effect operations. The BayesFusion and Bayesia deployment distinctions reviewed
earlier still apply; the selected edition, engine interface and rights would accompany any actual
trial. Porting a proprietary implementation has no justification from public documentation
alone. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024k; Bayesia, 2026a)
   For the next inexpensive prototype comparison, use public or generated cases with known
information conditions. The two Gaussian worlds test whether an interface invents a unique
effect from indistinguishable data; the proxy example tests whether a score is silently treated
as measured confounder truth; the randomized-offer law tests preservation of offer, receipt and
complier targets. A separate graph-class case should test PAG endpoint roundtrips under an
explicitly reviewed no-selection profile. Selection requires its own case and graph contract.
These deterministic references can precede licensed vendor execution and a prospectively regis-
tered sampling study. Any later performance comparison must retain failed fits, initializations,
budgets and parameter constraints, and compare the same scientific operation across engines.
   Coverage also remains bounded. Edition-specific latent-discovery capabilities of HUGIN,
MathWorks, IBM Amos, LISREL and causaLens remain unresolved in this comparison. They
are candidates for further primary technical review, with their information gaps retained in
the accompanying source register. No market-wide absence, cutoff-complete census, installed
interoperability, or paid-product superiority follows from the present comparison. The im-
mediate investment choice is to reuse and test selected documented operations while keeping
latent-confounded discovery and effect identification explicit.
24.24. Choosing a commercial latent-model component                                            281


24.24      Choosing a commercial latent-model component
The practical choice for a bank is a component that answers a specified question under an
explicit information law. A supplied borrower-risk model, an induced customer segmentation,
a discovered class of causal graphs and an intervention effect are different purchases. Their
outputs can support one another only through an additional modeling argument. This
distinction also prevents the proposed library from taking credit for functionality that an
established commercial system already documents while our canonical interface still reports
an unsupported operation.
   Consider a lending team that wants to assess a concession before the next credit-loss period.
A documented latent-class model can describe unobserved heterogeneity in repayment patterns.
It need not determine whether a concession caused a change in loss, because the same private
information can influence both the concession and the outcome. The observational-equivalence
and noisy-proxy examples in the preceding commercial discussion continue to apply. A proposal
to combine an existing fitter with explicit causal assumptions may be useful; it must not
advertise the fitter as a solution to the missing information.


24.24.1     Six concrete alternatives and five unresolved comparisons

The inspected GeNIe manual identifies its family as 5.0.R2. Its separate SMILE programmer
manual identifies 2.2.4.R1. Those are two documentation identities, not evidence that a
particular pair of installed binaries has been tested together. GeNIe documents EM fitting
for an existing network, including initialization, latent variables and discrete missing-data
cases. It explicitly keeps the structure fixed. The stated continuous multivariate-Gaussian
implementation does not accept missing values on that parameter-learning page. The structure-
learning interface has its own data restrictions. A reuse decision should therefore begin with
a fixed discrete model and its explicit observation law, rather than infer a universal latent-
discovery capability from the EM name. (BayesFusion, LLC, 2024g,j,i,h)
   BayesiaLab provides two substantive representation alternatives: a Naive latent factor
fit with soft class probabilities and the documented Multinet procedure with class-specific
trees and hard imputation. Their likelihoods, assignments and downstream uses are not
interchangeable. A comparison should retain the number of classes, variables used to create
them, conditional-independence restrictions and the date each variable becomes available.
A segment trained using the eventual loan outcome cannot silently become pre-concession
information. The inspected help is a mutable snapshot without a pinned current numbered
edition; that limitation applies to the technical comparison even though the primary text is
available. (Bayesia, 2026k,l)
   The Stata latent-class example supplies a particularly useful conventional baseline. Its
gsem specification fixes two classes, fits class-specific response probabilities, and distinguishes
marginal class proportions from posterior membership and thresholded assignments. Its printed
initialization and final-fitting diagnostics also show why one convergence flag cannot describe
all fitting stages. The example carries a 2025 copyright and release-19 data reference. It
establishes the demonstrated procedure, without establishing a purchased edition’s current
platform or automation entitlement. (StataCorp LLC, 2025)
   Mplus should not be reduced to a generic clustering competitor. The guide linked as
Version 8 includes a randomized-trial complier-average causal-effect example, with compliance
information partially observed and a noncomplier treatment slope fixed at zero. A bank
evaluating randomized assistance offers with incomplete take-up has a direct methodological
comparison here. The offered-treatment effect and the effect among compliers remain different
282                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


targets. The same chapter documents mixture models and complex-sampling options, which
deserve matched comparisons under their stated restrictions. The required licensed option
package and current binary behavior still need separate evidence. (Muthen and Muthen,
2026b)
   Netica’s inspected help describes counting, EM and gradient fitting of supplied conditional
probability tables. Its TAN discussion is expressly motivated by prediction and diagnosis,
including outgoing links from the target variable. Those arrows cannot be imported as
identified causal directions. The reference to TAN’s introduction in version 5.00 is historical
feature information; it does not establish the current installed release. Netica remains a
candidate supplied-model comparator after the prior, objective, initialization and edition are
fixed. (Norsys Software Corp., 2026a,b)
   The archived SAS/STAT 14.1 CALIS documentation supplies a further baseline for specified
measurement and structural models. It documents multiple modeling languages, parameter
restrictions, missing-data estimation and diagnostic outputs. These are capabilities that our
current canonical service does not provide. The archival technical source does not identify
a current SAS license, prove that every proposed model is identified, or supply the missing
current HPBNET or PAG contract. (SAS Institute Inc., 2026)
   Five further candidates remain unresolved: HUGIN Expert, MathWorks, IBM Amos,
LISREL and causaLens. The saved public-source review has unavailable technical routes or
navigation/licensing material insufficient for the required algorithm and edition comparison.
These vendors stay in the landscape, with a request for authentic versioned technical text
before a ranking or adoption recommendation. No lack of capability is inferred from an
inaccessible page. Their omission from the six developed technical comparisons is an evidence
gap, not a finding that they cannot serve the bank’s problem.


24.24.2      API configurations change the integration decision

An API name is not a single capability bundle. The preserved original Bayesia API Overview
table has four columns whose functional entries are encoded as yes/no symbols. Recovering
those symbols from the original HTML gives the following comparison; flattening the page to
text loses the distinctions. (Bayesia, 2026a)

      Function in the Java Modeling    Java Network

      Learn structure No               Yes               No                  No
