With K = 100, m = 10 and ρ = 0.3, the multiplier is 3.7. A thousand records then have
the same variance as about 270.27 independent records with the same marginal variance. A
common calendar shock across the groups violates the independence used in this calculation;
merely labeling borrowers as clusters does not resolve it.Causal banking research project

   One possible integration lets the caller supply independent group totals as columns. That
choice needs a derivation of weighting, normalization and target population, especially for
unequal group sizes. Another constructs an explicit long-run covariance from time-ordered
scores. A third retains dependence within independently sampled whole histories. These
alternatives change the sampling contract and must be compared on that basis.
   Delicatessen permits a pseudoinverse by default when building the sandwich. This is
useful numerical behavior in some problems, but a finite matrix is not evidence that the
parameter is identified. If the derivative of the moment condition loses rank, an ordinary
inverse-based asymptotic argument may fail; using a generalized inverse does not supply the
missing information. Solver residuals, Jacobian rank, scaling and the distinction between
regular intervals and weak-information set inversion belong in the result contract. delicatessen
project (2026a)


29.4      Final covariance settings must reach the final estimator
The inspected statsmodels GMM path defaults to weights_method=cov, using an outer-
product moment covariance divided by the number of observations. There is a separate HAC
29.5. Orthogonality isolates a rate obligation                                                    371


path with an explicit maximum lag and a kernel, defaulting to Bartlett. The results object
obtains the method from the GMM fit options and uses it in the final covariance calculation.
The low-level presence of HAC is evidence of an available code path, not evidence that every
treatment-effect wrapper exposes or activates it.statsmodels project (2026a)
   The treatment-effect entry point explicitly distinguishes its preliminary outcome-regression
covariance setting from final GMM inference. An adapter must therefore record both stages
and trace the actual final call. A statement such as “robust errors requested” is insufficient to
distinguish independent heteroskedastic, household-cluster and serially dependent constructions.
Calendar ordering, lag choice and the relation between estimation weights and covariance
weights also need to survive serialization.statsmodels project (2026b,a)
   The inspected GMM centering expression subtracts moms.mean(), a scalar mean over
the array, rather than an explicit vector of column means. This is a concrete behavior to
compare against an analytic moment reference, particularly when numerical residuals or
overidentification leave nonzero sample moments. It is not sufficient by itself to conclude that
the intended fitted estimator is incorrect. The outcome depends on the full score, weighting
and convergence conditions. Source review identifies the test; executed evidence must answer
it. statsmodels project (2026a)


29.5      Orthogonality isolates a rate obligation
Let Z be an instrument, D an action, Y an outcome and X measured pre-action information.
Write m(X) = E(Z | X), r(X) = E(D | X) and ℓ(X) = E(Y | X). Suppose the declared
causal model identifies θ0 through

                        E[(Z − m(X)){Y − ℓ(X) − θ0 (D − r(X))}] = 0.

This is an assumption about an identified model; the existence of these conditional means does
not establish a valid instrument.
  Condition on nuisance functions trained on an independent pilot with the same target law.
Denote their errors by δm , δr , δℓ . Expanding the fitted score and using the zero conditional
means of the centered variables gives the exact remainder
                                                                                             
        R(θ0 ) = E[δm (X){δℓ (X) − θ0 δr (X)}],        |R(θ0 )| ≤ ∥δm ∥2 ∥δℓ ∥2 + |θ0 |∥δr ∥2 .

The inequality follows from Cauchy–Schwarz and the triangle inequality. It exposes exactly
what must be bounded for this score. In a two-stratum arithmetic example with equal stratum
probabilities, errors (0.1, 0.2, 0.05) and (−0.1, 0.1, −0.05), ordered as (δm , δℓ , δr ), and θ0 = 2,
the remainder is −0.005.Causal banking research project (2026bd)
   The identity provides no convergence rate for a particular learner. Reusing dependent
observations for training and evaluation also invalidates the simple conditioning argument unless
additional separation or dependence control is proved. Support failures and misspecification can
prevent the errors from shrinking. For weak instrument relevance, even a well-controlled score
may yield an unbounded effect set under test inversion. This is why source-level availability of
flexible learners and sandwich calculations cannot settle the unresolved research on dependent
learning and useful precision.
Chapter 30

Histories, forest targets and the
units of causal calculations

30.1      Resampling a sequence requires a sampling model
Consider a bank evaluating a sequence of servicing decisions over twelve months. The data
contain repeated observations of each borrower, interventions that depend on previous balances
and competing events such as account closure. The statistical unit might be a borrower history,
a household, a branch or an independent economic calendar. These choices imply different
resampling laws. A routine with “bootstrap” in its name does not determine the appropriate
law.
   LiNGAM’s generic bootstrap resamples rows and refits the model. VARLiNGAM has a
distinct path: it fits a lag model, applies a contemporaneous LiNGAM model to the residuals,
resamples residual vectors and reconstructs a sequence using the fitted autoregressive coefficients.
The inspected loop temporarily sets the lag-selection criterion to None. Consequently, one
must inspect the initial lag/coefficient settings and the loop’s refit behavior before claiming
that it propagates model-selection uncertainty.LiNGAM project (2026a)
   Residual resampling can be a sensible candidate under an appropriate innovation law. It
does not automatically preserve persistent residual dependence, unmodeled common shocks or
a different sampling calendar. Row resampling is a different candidate suitable for a different
observational unit. A banking comparison should include a correctly specified innovation
model and an adverse case with persistent residuals, preserving the uncertainty target and
failures in both. Bootstrap edge frequencies should not be reported as a calibrated effect
confidence region without an additional argument.
   pygformula’s inspected bootstrap draws observed subject identifiers with replacement, copies
each subject’s complete history and assigns a fresh replicate identifier to each draw. It updates
histories and refits covariate and outcome models. Expanding to the requested simulation
population occurs in a separate step. These operations distinguish the observed sampling unit
from the Monte Carlo population used to evaluate a fitted regime.pygformula project (2026a)
   The fresh identifiers matter. Drawing borrower 17 twice should produce two bootstrap
histories, not concatenate them into one impossible person with two records at every date. An
integration test needs duplicate draws, unequal history lengths and multiple interventions. It
must also preserve the original calendar when that calendar is part of the estimand. Subject
resampling alone does not account for a market shock shared by every subject on the same
date.



                                               372
30.2. The intervention clock and competing-event target                                      373


   Failed fits require equally explicit handling. The inspected bootstrap helper catches an
exception, warns and returns a dictionary whose boot_results is None. The caller filters such
entries when assembling one result list, but subsequently constructs bootests by indexing
every original entry. A failed entry therefore exposes a static inconsistency in that caller
path. This observation requires reproduction in the pinned runtime before attributing an
observed frequency or impact to it. The integration must count attempted, successful and
failed replications and preserve the failure reason, irrespective of whether the eventual repair
aborts, returns an explicit unavailable interval or uses a preregistered rule. pygformula project
(2026b,a)


30.2      The intervention clock and competing-event target
The inspected simulation path applies an intervention to the current simulated frame and then
refreshes history variables before outcome prediction. Static schedules index their values by
the absolute time index int_values[t]. Threshold interventions bound the current action
between the supplied limits. Custom interventions receive the current frame, available pool
and time index. The API permits useful regimes, but does not itself certify that a custom
function uses only information available at the decision time. pygformula project (2026a)
   For example, “contact once delinquency has persisted for two months” refers to the observed
history before the action, whereas “contact borrowers who will be delinquent next month” uses
future information. Both can be expressed as executable code if future fields have been made
available. A valid interface must enforce the declared information clock and treat prohibited
reads as a contract violation. Thresholds should also retain their monetary units and whether
they change an action, a measurement or an eligibility condition.
   Competing events alter the target even when the same outcome model is used. In a stipulated
discrete-time model, let dt be the probability of a competing event in period t among those
still at risk, and let yt be the outcome hazard conditional on avoiding that competing event. If
competing events occur before outcomes within a period, the cumulative incidence through T
is
                                     T
                                       (                    )
                                     X     Y
                         FY (T ) =             (1 − ds )(1 − ys ) (1 − dt )yt .
                                     t=1   s<t

This formula follows by partitioning on the period of the first outcome event. It differs from a
hypothetical law that eliminates the competing event.
   For two periods with y = (0.1, 0.2) and d = (0.05, 0.1), the first contribution is 0.095 and
the second is 0.9(0.95)(0.9)(0.2) = 0.1539. Total incidence is 0.2489. Removing competing
events while holding these outcome hazards fixed gives 1 − (0.9)(0.8) = 0.28. At a stipulated
10,000 accounts and CNY 100 per event, the corresponding expected-loss difference is CNY
31,100. This is exact illustrative arithmetic. It does not identify the effect of eliminating a
real bank’s competing event or establish that the outcome hazard would remain fixed under
that intervention.Causal banking research project (2026bd)
   The inspected pygformula source separately computes survival risks with and without a
competing-event path, using subject-level cumulative products and then population means.
That code provides a concrete place to check the within-period ordering, history alignment and
target definition. It does not settle whether observed censoring or competing-event assumptions
are valid in the proposed banking application.pygformula project (2026a)
374                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


30.3     Following an R forest operation into its C++ implemen-
         tation
For grf, the causal-forest binding assigns the same variable index to treatment and
instrument, then calls an instrumental predictor. The predictor factory constructs
InstrumentalPredictionStrategy. The native prediction uses a ratio of centered outcome–
instrument and treatment–instrument moments. When instrument and treatment coincide,
this corresponds to a weighted local covariance divided by a weighted local treatment variance.
This traced route supports the interpretation of continuous-treatment output as a local slope
under its functional assumptions.grf project (2026a)
   It does not identify an arbitrary finite change in a nonlinear dose-response curve. A change
from an offer rate of one unit to two units needs the appropriate counterfactual contrast and
exposure support. A slope, an average slope and a finite contrast can coincide in a linear
model and diverge otherwise. The bank must choose the target before comparing software
outputs.
  The native variance routine forms influence-like quantities across tree groups, separates
between-group variation from group noise and calls a Bayes debiaser. These groups concern
the forest’s computation. They are distinct from the observed borrower clusters used by the R
average-effect calculation. Inspecting both paths avoids the false inference that a tree-group
variance option automatically accounts for a persistent banking calendar. The debiaser, forest
sampling, serialization and numerical safeguards require additional review before a direct
native interface is qualified.grf project (2026a)
   The maintained R interface is therefore a reasonable first integration candidate, subject
to a complete license/dependency and behavioral review. A direct C++ port would have to
preserve the forest representation, prediction strategy, variance method, randomization and
exceptional outcomes across version changes. Avoiding one language boundary does not by
itself justify that maintenance commitment. The open-source decision should compare the
operational cost of an R process or library bridge with the full scientific and technical cost of
a maintained port.


30.4     Population averaging, support and unavailable combina-
         tions
In grf’s inspected all-population AIPW path, the mean is a weighted average of get_scores
output. The variance calculation sums centered weighted scores within the declared clusters,
squares these group contributions and applies a group-count correction. For binary treatment,
the score uses the usual propensity residual divided by eb(1 − eb). For continuous treatment, an
auxiliary regression forest estimates the conditional variance of the treatment; the debiasing
weight divides the treatment residual by that estimate.grf project (2026a)
   Small conditional variance is an information problem. Borrowers with essentially one
available offer rate do not support precise estimation of a local rate response simply because a
forest can fit the outcome. Qualification should retain weak-support cases and identify whether
the operation returns a warning, an extreme weight, an unavailable result or a misleading
finite value. The inspected formula alone supplies no finite-sample guarantee for such cases.
  The all, treated, control and overlap populations must remain distinct. In the overlap
path the code fits a residualized outcome on a residualized treatment and uses cluster or
heteroskedastic covariance as applicable. Moving to an overlap target may improve stability
30.5. A generalized propensity score has physical units                                         375


while changing which banking population the result describes. A wrapper must not silently
make that choice on the analyst’s behalf.grf project (2026a)
   Option support must be determined from reachable control flow. The inspected average-
effect routine rejects TMLE when clusters or sample weights are supplied before reaching later
formulas that contain cluster-related expressions. Seeing those later formulas would not justify
advertising clustered TMLE at this entry point. Likewise, only specified combinations support
continuous treatment. The adapter’s capability matrix needs explicit accepted combinations
and typed refusal for the others.grf project (2026a)


30.5      A generalized propensity score has physical units
Let a continuous exposure follow a location-scale law A = µ(X) + s(X)R, with s(X) > 0.
Conditional change of variables gives

                                             1             a − µ(x)
                                                                   
                             fA|X (a | x) =     f                   x .
                                            s(x) R|X         s(x)

The Jacobian 1/s(x) is necessary for a density with respect to the original exposure measure.
If a common residual density is used instead of fR|X , an additional residual-distribution
assumption is being made.
   CausalGPS’s inspected compute_resid returns the standardized residual (a − b)/c. Its
compute_density helper calls R’s density estimate and interpolates it with rule=2. In the
inspected kernel branch of estimate_gps, the standardized-residual density is assigned to the
GPS field without division by the predicted scale in that branch. The normal branch instead
evaluates a normal density using its fitted mean and scale. These observations establish a
concrete scale question for downstream matching, weighting and dose-response construction.
They do not establish the behavior of every downstream operation.CausalGPS project (2026b,a)
   At a standardized residual of zero, a standard normal density is about 0.3989423. Two
strata with scales one and two have original-exposure densities 0.3989423 and 0.1994711 at
their respective means. Retaining only the common standardized-residual value loses that
difference. If the exposure is measured in units one hundred times smaller, its numerical
value is multiplied by one hundred and the corresponding density must be divided by one
hundred. The probability of any physical exposure interval remains unchanged. These exact
transformations provide a reference for a future unit-consistency test. Causal banking research
project (2026bd)
  Some downstream procedures might deliberately use a transformed balancing quantity, while
others require a density in the original units. The integration decision therefore remains deferred
until each use of the returned field is traced and the intended quantity is established. Silently
changing the helper could alter package behavior without resolving the scientific contract. A
matched comparison should examine heterogeneous scales, near-zero scales, counterfactual
dose evaluation and an explicit unit conversion, retaining any unsupported cases.
   The causaldrf comparison has a separate source obligation. Its accompanying license notice
identifies the year and copyright holder, supplementing the package’s license declaration. That
resolves the availability of that notice; it does not settle transitive licensing or the statistical
behavior of its interval routines. Source availability, permission to distribute and justified
uncertainty remain separate questions.causaldrf project (2026a)

30.6     Implications for reusable causal operations
These examples support a common semantic contract with explicit graph orientation, query/-
failure type, independent observational unit, decision clock, target population, dose units
and uncertainty construction. A business-facing assistant can elicit these fields and explain
unresolved choices, while a deterministic validator checks the declared operation against its
supported combinations. An LLM’s plausible description is not evidence that a package uses
the intended covariance or intervention target.
   The relevant next qualification compares complete causal requests. It retains the same
estimand and information across packages, separates sampling from Monte Carlo error, includes
failed fits and preserves unbounded sets. Numerical agreement in a benign case is useful
evidence about implementation, but cannot establish assignment truth, identification or useful
precision in adverse banking regimes. Those remain scientific and institutional requirements.
Chapter 31

Catalog context for causal
observations

A bank considering a new servicing policy first needs to locate the histories that describe
eligibility, actions, cash flows and observation. An enterprise catalog can identify datasets,
owners, schema fields and transformations that would otherwise have to be rediscovered. The
causal proposal should reuse that work. It must also preserve the distinction between a record
about a dataset and evidence about the decision made for a particular customer.
    DataHub is a concrete candidate for this boundary. Its open repository contains typed
dataset and field identities, ownership and lineage aspects, a Python client and metadata
ingestion tooling. The inspected revision, dated 7 October 2026, pins sixteen selected original
files. The Python distribution is named acryl-datahub; its version is dynamically supplied, so
the source revision does not establish the identity of an installed distribution. The README
separately describes OSS and Cloud. The referenced MCP server and Cloud SDK require their
own package, rights and behavior review. No service, SDK, connector or MCP server was
executed for the comparison below. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a,b)


31.1     The metadata graph has a useful, specific meaning
The dataset constructor takes a platform, dataset name, platform instance and environment,
then delegates the construction of its URN. Field identity adds a field path to a dataset
identity. An exporter should preserve those opaque identities and their versions. The display
name balance is insufficient: three stipulated fields in production/east, development/east
and production/west are distinct even when their dataset and leaf field names agree. An
exact identity example has three complete tuples but only one leaf name. Merging them
changes which population and source produced an observation; a downstream estimator cannot
reconstruct the lost distinction. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal,
2026bf)
   The UpstreamLineage aspect represents upstream datasets and optional fine-grained field re-
lationships. FineGrainedLineage can retain transformation text and a query reference. These
fields help explain how a derived value was computed. The type also has a confidenceScore
whose default is one. The inspected definition calls it confidence in lineage; it supplies no
calibrated probability that a corresponding causal arrow is true. Its optional matching status
describes the resolution of a URN against the catalog at ingestion time, and the comments
explicitly say that this status is not re-evaluated later. A later exporter must preserve the
distinction between exact, normalized, unresolved and unassessed references. (datahub-project

                                              377
378                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


contributors, 2026a)
   This distinction matters when an agent helps construct a diagram. A pipeline may transform
a contact table and a recovery table into an analysis table. That lineage supports a provenance
statement. It does not establish that contact caused recovery, that contact assignment was
unconfounded, or that every predictor was available before contact. A description or glossary
term can suggest a variable interpretation, but the proposal should retain its source, owner and
unresolved alternatives until the causal interpretation has separate support. The agent may
propose a mapping; it must not promote a lineage-confidence default into scientific certainty.
(datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026be)


31.2     Identical catalog context can support different interven-
         tions
An exact generated example makes the missing information visible. Let A be a binary offer
and Y a binary recovery. In a first world, A is a fair random draw and

                              Y = A ⊕ E,        P (E = 1) = 1/4,

where ⊕ denotes exclusive-or and E is independent of assignment. In a second world, an
unobserved fair borrower state U determines assignment, A = U , and Y = U ⊕ E; changing
the offer leaves the recovery mechanism unchanged. Both worlds give the strictly positive
observed table
                                         Y =0 Y =1
                                  A=0     3/8     1/8
                                  A=1     1/8     3/8
and can use the same two source tables, field descriptions and transformation lineage. Direct
enumeration gives

              E[Y | do(A = 1)] − E[Y | do(A = 0)] = 1/2 in the first world,
                                                    =0      in the second world.

The observed conditional difference is 1/2 in both. At a stipulated USD 100 per recovery and
USD 30 per offer, the incremental net values are USD 20 and USD −30. The opposing decisions
arise with identical observed tables and catalog structure. This is an authored information
example, not a bank effect estimate or a failure observed in DataHub. More catalog entries
cannot alone choose the assignment mechanism. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   Useful catalog integration therefore retains the evidence for an assignment claim alongside
the variable mapping. For a randomized campaign, that may eventually include the actual
allocation record and deviations. For an observational proposal, it may be a declared adjustment
argument with competing graphs and sensitivity analyses. An empty assignment-evidence
field remains unknown. It cannot be filled by a well-connected asset graph. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026be)


31.3     Separate the clocks before constructing a historical feature
The inspected audit-stamp type records when a resource or association entered a lifecycle
stage and who acted. An upstream lineage stamp records who reported that lineage and when.
Ownership has an audit stamp whose zero time explicitly denotes missing data. Schema-field
creation and modification stamps likewise describe metadata objects. None of these definitions,
31.4. A bounded export must preserve incompleteness                                           379


by itself, states when a particular customer-level value first became available to a servicing
decision. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a)
   Let t be the action time, ej a feature’s event time, aj the time its value became available,
and mj the time the catalog observed its metadata. A proposed historical input contract
requires aj ≤ t for a feature used by the policy, together with evidence for the relevant version.
The inequality ej ≤ t is insufficient when an event is recorded or revised later. Similarly,
mj > t need not invalidate a retrospectively acquired description of an older value; it means
that the exporter needs an additional historical availability argument. The clocks have different
meanings. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   For a generated example, take an independent fair baseline B and recovery Y at day 30.
The baseline is available on day −1. A derived field Z = Y is labeled with an origination
event on day zero but becomes available only on day 31. Both fields have schema creation
time −60 and their catalog snapshot is acquired on day 40. Enumerating the four equally
likely (B, Y ) pairs gives classification agreement P (B = Y ) = 1/2 and P (Z = Y ) = 1. The
latter is perfect retrospective leakage. At a day-zero action, the availability rule admits only
B; filtering solely by event time also admits Z. A third field with unknown availability stays
unresolved even if its event time is old. These exact agreements describe stipulated variables,
not a fitted prediction benchmark. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   DataHub’s inspected get_aspect method supports an explicit version, with version zero
documented as latest. A latest schema can be useful for discovery, but it is not automatically
the schema used by a historical policy. The proposed export should bind the requested
aspect version, returned bytes, source-data version and clock evidence. A sequence of reads
is not declared an atomic catalog snapshot merely because every request succeeds. Version
consistency and concurrent changes belong in the prototype acceptance cases. (datahub-project
contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026be)


31.4     A bounded export must preserve incompleteness
The selected aspect reader distinguishes a missing aspect, which yields None for HTTP 404,
from other HTTP failures and from a malformed response lacking the expected aspect. It
also rejects a time-series aspect on this particular path. An adapter should retain these
distinctions. Missing metadata is not evidence that an asset has no owner, that a covariate
has no confounders, or that the underlying data were complete. An authorization or transport
failure must not become an empty successful causal context. (datahub-project contributors,
2026a)
   Lineage traversal has two further source-level details. The inspected client maps requested
hop counts above two to the categories one, two and “3+”. That is not a strict three-edge
radius: a generated chain with distances one through four retains distance four under the
“3+” category, whereas a literal three-hop contract would exclude it. The method’s count
argument is passed to a scrolling query, and the implementation accumulates results while
a continuation cursor is returned. Two generated pages of 500 and one records therefore
produce 501 accumulated records. The per-query count is not a proved whole-export bound.
These are static interpretations of the saved code, not observations from a running server.
(datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal, 2026bf)
   A proposed export wrapper should make its own request, result, byte and elapsed time
limits explicit. It should track cursors, preserve each returned page, and mark exhaustion,
repetition or inconsistency as partial or failed retrieval. In the authored cursor example, seeing
the same nonempty cursor twice produces a repeated-cursor disposition after two requests,
380                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


with completeness false. No live failure is alleged. The example specifies what a bounded
wrapper must do if that response sequence occurs. A partial graph cannot support the claim
that all relevant upstream sources have been found. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bf,be)
   Lifecycle and projection also affect completeness. The inspected status model separates
the legacy removal flag from a lifecycle stage whose search visibility may differ; its comments
warn that these are not automatically synchronized. The lineage-result conversion retains
schema-field path entries while omitting other path-node types, such as queries. A causal
provenance export should therefore retain raw aspect/query evidence and lifecycle context, in
addition to a convenient summarized path. It should not silently infer a missing transformation
from the projected result. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a)


31.5      A reuse choice with a concrete prototype
The present choice is to retain DataHub as a pinned technical reference and a candidate for
conditional integration with an existing catalog. Adopting the entire platform as a required
causal engine would add a deployment and maintenance dependency before the narrow use
has been justified. Porting its catalog or client into the causal core would create another
implementation to keep compatible. A small export boundary, with a manually prepared
public metadata fixture as the initial comparator, is a more testable proposal. Other catalog
families remain separate candidates; their names do not supply equivalent APIs, rights or
clock semantics. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   The root source license is Apache 2.0 and the repository has a substantial NOTICE file.
The inspected redistribution conditions address license copies, modification notices, attribution
and applicable NOTICE content. The Python project declares Python 3.10 or newer and
numerous dependencies, including version ranges; its dependency file says it is generated from
another source of truth. This review does not establish a complete resolved distribution,
dependency-license inventory or equivalence to that generating file. The source revision and a
recent commit show observed maintenance activity, not a support commitment or compatibility
with a future bank’s server. (datahub-project contributors, 2026b)
    The prototype should first consume a frozen, project-authored export containing opaque
entity and field identities, aspect versions, raw hashes, acquisition time, lineage evidence,
lifecycle state, unknown fields and separate feature availability declarations. It should reproduce
the four exact example families, retain the five explicit missing-context cases, and refuse to
emit causal arrows solely from catalog lineage. A later source-matched SDK fixture must check
actual serialization, pagination, schema changes, deletion visibility and failure behavior before
the proposed adapter receives integration permission. No such permission is granted by the
present reference decision. (Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
   An agent using the library, CLI or MCP interface should receive the same bounded context
object and evidence links. Read operations and proposed metadata changes should have
separate interfaces: the inspected SDK contains both query and mutation methods, including
automatic column matching. A discovery request should not invoke a lineage mutation as a side
effect of trying to understand the data. Descriptions remain source material, not instructions
to change the analysis or credentials. This is a proposed consumer contract; it does not claim
that an existing MCP integration implements it. (datahub-project contributors, 2026a; Causal
banking proposal, 2026be)
   The catalog owner would eventually supply the permitted scope, access route and relevant
historical evidence. The prototype maintainer owns source/version matching, conversion
and bounded failure handling; a scientific reviewer owns the assignment and measurement
31.5. A reuse choice with a concrete prototype                                             381


claims. The economic comparison includes manual mapping time, maintenance, infrastructure,
entitlement, semantic review and incident investigation. A public fixture can establish whether
the proposed boundary prevents identifiable errors before any bank connection is sought.
It cannot establish actual owner truth, causal identification or bank return on investment.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026be)
Chapter 32

Matched qualification and build, buy
or integrate decisions

32.1     An admissible route before a preferred supplier
A bank selecting causal software is choosing a procedure for a specified decision, together with
the means of maintaining and operating that procedure. Discovery for a supplied independent
sample, identification in a latent graph, and evaluation of a repeated servicing policy are
different services. The software survey establishes candidate routes and their restrictions. This
chapter asks how those routes should be compared once a bounded use has been chosen, and
what evidence could justify direct adoption, a process bridge, a port, an internal implementation,
a commercial purchase, or reference-only use.
  Let q denote the complete requested scientific operation and s a declared workload scenario.
For candidate route j, write

              aj (q, s) = amethod
                           j      (q, s) arepresentation
                                          j              (q, s) aoperating
                                                                 j         (q, s) arights
                                                                                   j      (q, s),

where each factor is one only when the corresponding necessary condition has been established
in the declared scope. The factors describe compatibility with the causal method, preservation
of its objects, the required runtime behavior, and the intended reuse arrangement. An unknown
condition remains unresolved; it is not a passing value. This is an admission rule for a proposed
comparison, not a probability model or a weighted capability score. A low price cannot
compensate for a method that answers a different intervention query, and a favorable license
cannot supply missing uncertainty. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)
    Admission should distinguish hard scientific restrictions from tunable engineering require-
ments. If the selected routine only handles independent units, declaring a panel identifier does
not make it a dependent-data method. If the issue is process startup, an alternative process
lifecycle may resolve it without changing the target. If the issue is an unsupported counterfac-
tual, an adapter cannot resolve it by relabelling an associational prediction. This classification
tells the proposal whether to restrict the supported domain, implement a conversion, select
another scientific method, or commission research. It prevents an implementation task from
carrying an implicit promise to solve nonidentification.
   The inspected candidates illustrate why a route is more specific than a package name. The
pinned pgmpy review finds an advertised adjustment option whose selected implementation
raises NotImplementedError; that option cannot enter the executable comparison merely
because it appears in a guide. The selected Tetrad review supports a restricted Java PC
prototype subject to runtime, conversion and reuse conditions, not an unrestricted Java

                                                     382
32.2. Matching the experiment and its denominator                                            383


discovery service. The CausalNex review treats the inspected discontinued source as an
archival comparison; maintenance and unreported solver behavior remain part of the decision.
These are findings for inspected revisions. They do not establish that another release, method
or supplier has the same restriction. (pgmpy contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal
project, 2026r; mckinsey/causalnex, 2026b)


32.2     Matching the experiment and its denominator
A comparison requires a common request population before it requires a common timer. Let
Q be the prespecified distribution of requested cases, including difficult and unsupported
cases relevant to the proposed service. For each route, retain a disposition Rj (q) such as
computed, unsupported, unavailable, or invalid input, together with the target and uncertainty
object actually returned. The intended denominator is the requested workload. A conditional
accuracy figure among successful outputs remains useful, but it answers a different question
from the probability of receiving a correct, usable result for an arbitrary requested case.
   For estimator comparisons, a matched case must bind the population measure, intervention,
horizon, information clock and uncertainty meaning. The two procedures may legitimately
use different computational strategies. They may also use different statistical methods if the
purpose is a method comparison, provided the target and admissible information are held
fixed and each method’s assumptions are exposed. A port-equivalence study has a narrower
objective: it tests whether the intended procedure survives translation, including defaults,
failure behavior, randomness and diagnostic outputs. Mixing these objectives would make a
better result ambiguous between a scientific change and a faithful implementation.
   The first prototype should contain three complementary groups. Exact finite or analytic
constructions test meanings and numerical identities. Generated sampling experiments test
operating characteristics under explicit truth. Documented public datasets test preparation,
interfaces, and useful questions within their evidence limits. Agreement on public observational
data is not itself a causal-truth label. A benchmark with known intervention assignments
supports a stronger comparison only for its documented population and design. The proposal
can therefore establish the merit and practicality of a later bank experiment without pretending
that public data reproduces private bank assignment, identity or operational truth. (Causal
banking research project, 2026as)
   Workload matching also includes resource and information budgets. Both routes should
receive the same permitted data and expert restrictions; preprocessing, search, tuning and
human repair must be charged consistently. If one candidate uses a larger graph-search
budget, report both a fixed-budget comparison and the declared cost–quality tradeoff. For a
bridge, include serialization, data movement, environment startup, numerical work, uncertainty
construction and publication. Warm and cold executions are distinct operating scenarios.
Reuse of a fitted model or cached result is valid only when the identity and invalidation rule
agree with the intended service.


32.3     A paired comparison can reverse a preferred route
Consider an authored workload law with 1,000 equally weighted request slots. Each route
produces a correct usable answer, a wrong answer, or an unavailable answer. The following
table specifies the entire paired law; it is not an observed package trial. A row refers to route
384                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


A, and a column to route B.

                               B : correct B : wrong B : unavailable total
                 A : correct          600         20              10  630
                 A : wrong              10         5               5   20
               A : unavailable        190         75              85  350
                    total             800        100             100 1000

Among available answers, A is correct in 630/650 = 126/130 cases and B in 800/900 = 8/9.
On the requested denominator, their correct-answer rates are 0.63 and 0.80. Thus A has higher
conditional correctness while B supplies more correct answers overall. Neither statement alone
selects the preferred banking workflow. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
  Suppose a correct answer has stipulated gross value USD 10, a wrong answer causes loss ℓ,
unavailable answers have zero gross value, and the complete per-request costs are USD 1 for A
and USD 2 for B, charged on all requests. Their total values are

                VA = 630(10) − 20ℓ − 1000,       VB = 800(10) − 100ℓ − 2000.

The difference is VB − VA = 700 − 80ℓ. Route B is preferred only when ℓ < 8.75. At ℓ = 40,
the totals are USD 4,500 and USD 2,000, respectively. This threshold is a sensitivity result
under a specified loss and fallback convention. It is not a market price or a claim about a
bank’s actual error cost. If unavailable answers require manual review, that fallback has its
own value, delay and cost and must be incorporated in both workflows. (Causal banking
research project, 2026at)
  Pairing provides information that two separate success percentages lose. Let Xj be the
indicator of a correct usable answer from route j, and let D = XB − XA . In the stipulated
law, D = 1 on 200 slots, D = −1 on 30, and D = 0 on 770. Hence

                     E(D) = 0.17,       Var(D) = 0.23 − 0.172 = 0.2011.

Equivalently, the covariance of the two correctness indicators is 0.600 − (0.63)(0.80) = 0.096,
and
                        Var(D) = 0.63(0.37) + 0.80(0.20) − 2(0.096).
If independent paired requests were drawn from this law, the sample mean difference would have
variance 0.2011/n. Treating the two outcomes as independent instead gives 0.3931/n. These
expressions describe the stipulated sampling experiment; they are not confidence statements
for a fixed benchmark table. Repeated variants from one customer, graph or source document
require their actual group dependence to be retained. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   The paired table also makes disagreement review efficient. The 200 cases on which only B
is correct and the 30 on which only A is correct are natural targets for diagnosing method
domain, conversion or failure handling. They should remain in the final outcome accounting
after investigation. Correcting a test oracle or an adapter creates a successor comparison with
explicit changes; removing disagreeing cases until the routes agree would change the workload
and obscure the reason for the improvement.


32.4     What a failure-free prototype establishes
A set of successful fixtures proves the stated examples, not universal compatibility. A small
stochastic qualification experiment supplies a different, conditional statement. Suppose a fixed
workload distribution has independent Bernoulli failures with probability p, and the evaluation
32.5. A port must preserve the full procedure                                                  385


contains n prespecified requests. If zero failures occur, the probability of that observation is
(1 − p)n . Inverting the one-sided test at error probability α gives the upper bound

                                         pU = 1 − α1/n .

With n = 100 and α = 0.05, this is approximately 0.0295. Zero failures among a hundred
independent requests therefore does not establish a one-percent failure ceiling at this level.
The exact inequality
                                     (0.99)n ≤ 0.05
first holds at n = 299. This is a prospective sample-size implication if that design and ceiling
are appropriate, not a claim that the prototype has passed it. (Causal banking research project,
2026at)
   For eight separately declared profiles, a simultaneous statement needs its own error allocation.
Assigning α/8 to each and applying the union bound yields joint error at most α without
requiring independence between profiles. Each within-profile zero-failure calculation still
requires its stated independent Bernoulli experiment. At a common one-percent ceiling,
(0.99)n ≤ 0.05/8 first holds at n = 505 requests per profile. A single pooled bound would
answer a different question and could hide a bad rare profile. Conversely, infinitely many graph
families or deployment regimes cannot be qualified by calling eight chosen profiles exhaustive.
(Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   These calculations motivate a bounded qualification protocol rather than a large unstructured
test collection. Define the admitted profile, failure event, request distribution, denominator,
sample size, simultaneous statement and stopping rule before evaluation. A crash, timeout,
missing interval or wrong target is not automatically the same event; retain their separate
frequencies and any combined service failure used for acceptance. If a generated experiment
tests confidence-set coverage, its event is whether the known fixed target is contained, together
with declared availability and precision requirements. Statistical coverage, computation
completion and useful decision resolution need separate criteria. Adaptive test selection or
optional stopping requires a design that justifies it; repeatedly adding cases until the displayed
bound passes does not preserve this fixed-sample argument.
   An exact finite-domain test can offer stronger evidence within a smaller domain. Exhausting
all supported endpoint pairs or all three-node graphs may settle the declared finite conversion
behavior. It does not become a sampling confidence claim, nor does it establish arbitrary-
dimensional algorithm correctness. The topology examples show how exact counterexamples
and actual codecs complement rather than replace a generated performance study. The
proposal should state which of these evidence forms closes each acceptance condition. (Causal
banking research project, 2026aw,au)


32.5      A port must preserve the full procedure
Porting has several possible meanings. A mathematical reimplementation may reproduce
a functional using a different algorithm. A compatibility port may seek the same defaults,
accepted inputs, warnings and output semantics as a specified release. A new method may
deliberately improve an estimator or uncertainty construction. Each can be useful, but each
requires a different comparison. The product should not retain an upstream method name
while changing its weighting measure, policy target or interval construction without declaring
that change. Source-level agreement is particularly weak when a caller changes the meaning of
an otherwise correctly translated routine.
386                                                                    Causal analysis for a universal bank


   For the inspected CausalPy route, the proposed sharp-discontinuity contract distinguishes a
finite-epsilon prediction contrast from a threshold estimand, and a point backend from posterior
draws and predictive responses. A port that reproduces a plotted difference while discarding
epsilon, treatment direction or left/right support has not reproduced the causal operation. For
the d3rlpy route, the proposed contract separates episode termination, administrative cutoff,
missing continuation, initial-state population, policy identity and the physical discount clock.
Reproducing an optimizer while averaging the wrong initial states can produce a different
policy value. These source-grounded contracts specify tests to execute before enabling the
proposed integrations; they are not records of native acceptance trials. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026c,at)
   Numerical acceptance should be stated in the coordinates of the decision. Let θe approximate
an independently defined reference θ, with justified deterministic bounds |θei − θi | ≤ εi . For
fixed weights wi and cost c, the triangle inequality gives
                                                               !
                          X                      X                     X
                                wi θei − c −          wi θ i − c   ≤       |wi |εi .
                            i                     i                    i

This transports certified numerical error; it does not certify the reference’s causal validity or
its sampling uncertainty. Relative-error tolerances alone are unsuitable near a zero-valued
target, and coordinate tolerances that look small can still reverse a near-threshold decision.
   For a stipulated example, let w = (3/4, 1/4), θe = (24, −8) USD, c = 15 USD and ε = (2, 4)
USD. The approximate net value is USD 1, but its numerical error allowance is USD 2.5,
giving the enclosure [−1.5, 3.5]. The permitted reference θ = (23, −10) yields USD −0.25.
Declaring a profitable action from the approximate point would exceed the available numerical
evidence. Reducing the numerical budget, retaining an unresolved decision, or changing the
information/design are distinct responses. If sampling uncertainty is also present, the numerical
enclosure must be combined with that construction under its actual guarantee, not relabelled
as another confidence level. (Causal banking research project, 2026at)
   Port acceptance should consequently include independent algebraic references, metamorphic
transformations with known consequences, adverse inputs, and method-specific numerical
error checks. Graph and set outputs need structural and containment criteria, not only a
mean squared difference. Seeds, thread counts, solver versions, hardware-dependent arithmetic
and stopping conditions belong in the tested procedure. An upstream test suite is valuable
inherited evidence, but common implementation mistakes can survive a direct translation
of both code and tests. Independent references should target the scientific properties the
proposed product promises.


32.6     Lifecycle cost conditional on qualified behavior
Only admitted routes should enter a procurement comparison. For route j, a transparent
planning quantity over T periods is
                                        T
                                        X
                          Cj = F j +           dt {Ljt + Mjt + Nt cjt + Ijt },
                                        t=1

where Fj is initial engineering and qualification cost, Ljt license or subscription expense, Mjt
maintenance and compatibility work, Nt cjt workload-dependent cost, and Ijt the expected
incident or recovery cost under an explicitly stated model. The dt are the chosen discount
factors. These terms need not be known at proposal time. Ranges and break-even conditions
are more informative than an invented precise total, and omitted costs must remain visible.
32.7. A proposal decision that can be executed                                              387


  Suppose, purely for planning, a bridge costs USD 100,000 initially, USD 20,000 per year to
maintain and USD 3 per request. A port costs USD 300,000 initially, USD 80,000 per year
and USD 1 per request. Ignore discounting over three years and assume both routes meet
exactly the same service requirements. Ignoring maintenance suggests a break-even volume of
                                  300000 − 100000
                                                  = 100000
                                       3−1
requests. Including the three years of maintenance gives
                        300000 − 100000 + 3(80000 − 20000)
                                                           = 190000.
                                      3−1
At 150,000 total requests the bridge costs USD 610,000 and the port USD 690,000. The
cheaper numerical kernel does not establish the cheaper full route. These are exact hypothetical
calculations, not measured costs, vendor quotes or return on investment. Their practical use
is to identify which workload and maintenance estimates could change the decision. (Causal
banking research project, 2026at)
   The same decomposition organizes substantive alternatives. Direct adoption can minimize
translation work when the upstream environment and result contract fit, but it retains
dependency and upgrade obligations. A process bridge can isolate an environment and preserve
the upstream implementation, at the cost of conversion, lifecycle and operational work. A
port may serve an unavailable deployment environment or a demonstrated bottleneck, but
incurs full-procedure equivalence and maintenance responsibilities. An internal implementation
is justified when the required scientific construction or result type is absent from suitable
existing routes; its comparison should include the continuing cost of independent verification.
Reference-only use is appropriate when an implementation clarifies a method but its runtime,
rights, maintenance or scientific domain is unsuitable for the proposed service.
   A commercial purchase is evaluated through the same admitted operation and whole-
workflow cost. The exact edition, automation route, technical method, diagnostics, export
semantics and intended deployment terms matter. Community extensions should not be
attributed to the vendor’s supported core without evidence. Missing technical documentation
leaves a capability unresolved; it does not establish absence. Unquoted prices remain unknown.
The commercial comparison therefore supports a request for a matched evaluation or a bounded
purchase decision when its evidence permits one, rather than an unsupported claim of product
superiority. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)


32.7     A proposal decision that can be executed
The immediate deliverable should be a conditional route decision, with a specific supported
profile and a finite acceptance experiment. A useful decision identifies the candidate revision
and environment, the exact causal operation, the alternative route, the information and
compute budget, the correctness and failure events, the required numerical or uncertainty
guarantee, and the cost quantities that remain to be measured. It also states what outcome
would change the choice. A preferred prototype candidate is therefore compatible with deferred
integration; it expresses where the next evidence is most valuable without asserting that the
evidence exists. (Causal banking research project, 2026as)
  For a discovery prototype, a restricted supplied regime and independently checked graph
conversions precede an effect claim. For a threshold design, the treatment direction, support
and requested limit precede a comparison of predictions. For servicing, the complete policy
and episode population precede offline value comparison. For funding, weak information and
388                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


the topology of the effect set precede a monetary recommendation. These conditions let
independent prototype routes advance while another method remains unsupported. They also
make rejection useful: a documented mismatch removes a route from the admitted domain
and identifies whether new information, another method or engineering work could restore it.
   No proposed acceptance test can make observationally indistinguishable causal models
distinguishable by computation alone. Nor can it invent bank precision targets, authentic
identity and assignment records, supplier commitments or independent approval. Those limits
should govern the claim made by the proposal, while public/generated prototype comparisons
establish what can be learned now. A later bank trial is justified by a credible scoped method,
demonstrated semantic and numerical behavior, and a decision-relevant uncertainty and cost
question. The resulting build, buy or integrate decision is conditional on that evidence, with
an explicit fallback when qualification fails.
Chapter 33

What language models contribute to
causal knowledge

33.1     Four different objects called causal reasoning
A banker asking why deposit balances fell can be asking for an explanation of a recorded event,
an estimate of a feasible rate intervention, a prediction of next month’s balance, or a diagnosis
of an observation error. A fluent answer can move between these objects without announcing
the change. The useful starting point for evaluating language assistance is therefore the object
being produced: a proposed scientific question, evidence about a causal model, a formal
calculation conditional on that model, or a recommendation under a specified loss. Success at
one object supplies no automatic guarantee for the others.
   The early frontier argument proposes using language models to organize domain knowledge,
draft graphs, critique assumptions and suggest robustness analyses. It also records the ability
to reproduce recognizable public data and distinguishes transforming known information
from discovering a new causal structure.Kıcıman et al. (2023) This distinction is particularly
consequential in banking. A familiar statement about interest rates can be useful prior
knowledge, but the effect of a particular bank’s deposit offer depends on its population,
competitors, eligibility rules and information clock. A remembered relationship does not
determine that intervention effect.
   Formal benchmarks introduce a second object. CLadder constructs questions from known
causal structures with different verbalizations. Its results concern answers to those generated
questions, including historically specified models and prompting methods.Jin et al. (2023)
Such a benchmark can reveal failures to distinguish observation from intervention. It cannot
establish that a model elicits the right variables from an unfamiliar bank process, measures
them correctly, or returns calibrated uncertainty after fitting to dependent data. These are
additional stages of the proposed product.
   Third, a language model can propose a causal mechanism for numerical analysis. Model
Discovery Agent illustrates a separation between executable mechanism proposals and numerical
fitting, evidence approximation and experiment design. Its finite predictive evaluations
explicitly do not establish causal identification.Murphy (2026) A mechanism may predict well
because several observationally equivalent models predict equally well. The bank must still
justify which intervention the model represents and which new experiment would distinguish
economically different mechanisms.
  Finally, workflow assistance concerns selection and coordination of established operations.
Causal-learn+ describes assistance with diagnosis, assumptions, method selection and inter-

                                              389
390                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


pretation while retaining algorithm outputs and graph ambiguity.Zheng (2026) This is a useful
architectural direction. It changes the analyst’s interaction with numerical tools; it does not
make a method’s premises true. The following chapters keep these four contributions separate
while studying how they can work together.


33.2      Text supplies a different information channel
Write D for the observed numerical records, K for inspected documentary or expert evidence,
and M(D, K) for the models consistent with the declared interpretation of both. For target
ψ, a set-valued answer is

                             Ψ(D, K) = {ψ(M ) : M ∈ M(D, K)}.

This notation does not assert that finite data identify the population law or that a statistical
confidence procedure has been supplied. It describes which models the analysis intends to
consider. Statistical uncertainty about the law must subsequently be propagated through the
model set.
  Additional reliable knowledge may exclude a model that the observed distribution alone
cannot exclude. A contract establishing that an invitation was randomized, for example,
has a different evidential role from a predictive correlation. But a model-generated sentence
repeating that randomization is common practice does not establish what happened in the
bank’s historical process. The analysis must identify the original source, the relevant population
and dates, the interpretation of its claim, and the person or measurement that supports it.
   This also explains why retrieving more documents need not improve discovery. LACR
combines background knowledge, retrieved documents and optional numerical information,
and includes an UNKNOWN response. Its reported retrieval effects differ across benchmarks,
with adverse as well as favorable outcomes. Zhang et al. (2024) Retrieval changes K; it does
not certify K. Documents may concern a different treatment definition, contain an association
stated as a cause, or duplicate the same original assertion. Ten repeated documents are not
ten independent confirmations of an edge.
   An appropriate evidence object therefore retains the claim, source passage, date, domain,
units and proposed role. A passage may justify a variable definition without justifying an
arrow. A process document may establish that one action occurs before another without
excluding a common cause. A source about another bank may suggest a hypothesis while
leaving transport assumptions unresolved. These roles determine the strength with which K
can restrict the model class.


33.3     Discovery methods use language judgments in different
         ways
Three broad routes recur in the inspected literature: direct graph or relation prediction,
refinement of numerical discoveries, and priors or constraints used within a search.Wan et al.
(2024) The distinction matters because it locates where a wrong assertion enters the calculation.
   In direct conditional-independence elicitation, chatPC obtains language-model judgments
from descriptions and context. Its statistical calculation concerns the proportion of YES/NO
model responses.Cohrs et al. (2024) Repeated answers can measure response variability under
a prompt. Without a separate argument, they are not repeated draws of the bank variables
33.4. Temporal discovery is not a change of vocabulary                                       391


and do not yield a sampling test of independence in the bank population. A highly stable
wrong answer can therefore be more dangerous than a visibly variable one.
   Soft guidance provides a different failure boundary. The inspected CD-UCT method
combines language and mutual-information scores to guide graph search without excluding
otherwise valid DAGs. Language-only priors are not uniformly beneficial in its reported
comparisons.Darvariu et al. (2024) Ancestral-path constraints can likewise enter through a
soft log-prior penalty, with reported degradation under inaccurate prior information.Ban et al.
(2023) Softness leaves room for the numerical criterion to resist the suggestion, but it does not
establish that the final graph probabilities are calibrated.
   Hard restrictions can be scientifically appropriate when backed by a genuine design fact.
They are more consequential when inferred from prose: deleting a candidate model deletes
every effect value that only that model permits. Statistical Causal Prompting converts model
outputs into forced, forbidden or unknown prior knowledge using method-specific mappings.
The inspected examples include failures as well as improvements.Takayama et al. (2024) The
interface must expose both the original assertion and the conversion rule, so a reviewer can
determine whether a numerical threshold has quietly become a scientific exclusion.
   Noisy language priors can also guide a sequential allocation of questions over edges while
retaining PAG representations.Verma et al. (2025) This is closer to a budgeted information
problem than to asking for a finished graph in one prompt. Its relevance to a bank still depends
on whether the supplied knowledge applies to the observed regime, whether latent structure is
represented correctly, and whether the retained ambiguity survives into the effect query.


33.4      Temporal discovery is not a change of vocabulary
A statement that collections activity affects arrears omits the action time, available history,
response horizon and possible feedback. Expanding a variable name into a paragraph does not
supply these missing indices. A temporal graph needs explicit time labels and a rule governing
contemporaneous edges, lag limits, hidden histories, stationarity and interventions.
   RealTCD combines a language-derived initial adjacency with numerical score optimization
over temporal graphs and intervention targets. Its setup includes causal sufficiency, a known
observational regime, finite lag and a DAG on unrolled variables; its identification statement
has further stated premises. The inspected real-system assessment lacks a ground-truth DAG
and evaluates selected relationships through expert rules.Li (2024) These qualifications prevent
a graph score from being read as a general guarantee for a bank’s latent, irregularly observed
time series.
   The Large Causal Models work is an adjacent numerical foundation-model route, not
simply a conversational language-model interface. The inspected model assumes additive
noise, stationarity, no latent confounders and no contemporaneous effects, and does not detect
or correct violations of these assumptions.Kougioulis et al. (2026) Distinguishing the two
routes avoids treating the shared word “model” as a common scientific contract. One supplies
semantic proposals; the other learns a temporal mapping under a training distribution and
structural restrictions. Either can be useful within its declared regime.
   For sequential servicing, a credible workflow starts with the decision history and feasible
intervention. It then asks whether the discovery output expresses the required variables and
whether a policy effect is identified over every retained graph. An automatically generated
lagged graph cannot resolve unrecorded private information merely by assigning it a latent-node
name.
392                                                          Causal analysis for a universal bank


33.5     Interactive systems and agents add a review problem
CausalChat combines graph suggestions, user editing and numerical updates. Its small nonex-
pert study uses a fixed sequence of interfaces. Zhang (2024) Such evidence can motivate better
interfaces, but it does not isolate every learning, ordering or expertise effect. The proposed
bank evaluation needs qualified reviewers, an explicit task distribution and a comparison that
records the time and information supplied by people.
  Debating agents provide another review structure. MAC uses affirmative, negative and
judge roles; its inspected comparisons also report a competitive single-agent route for simpler
graphs at lower cost.Le et al. (2024) Several personas can share the same mistaken premise or
model knowledge. Agreement among them is not automatically independent corroboration.
Their usefulness should be measured through detected errors, retained correct alternatives,
decision consequences and total cost.
   The oci-agent study instead emphasizes an accountable human principal over actor/critic
workflows and deterministic causal libraries. Its critic can decline analyses with poor over-
lap.Chou et al. (2026) The relevant outcome then includes correct refusal and what remains
possible for the requested population. Reporting only completed analyses would hide precisely
the difficult cases in which an agent’s judgment matters most.
   An evidence-auditing agent faces a similar boundary. ARGUS audits reported support
for assumptions rather than adjudicating their truth. Its retrieval and abstention tradeoffs
and small human-label pilot leave substantial generalization questions.Zhang et al. (2026)
In banking, an omitted document, a contradicted assumption and an assumption whose
truth is unknown require different responses. A documentation score should not become an
identification certificate.


33.6     An evidence standard for the proposed banking product
The synthesis supports a modular research program. Language assistance proposes questions,
variables, graph alternatives and evidence links. Formal operations check declared structures
and calculate identified functionals or sets in supported regimes. Numerical procedures estimate
those objects with their own sampling and approximation arguments. Human and institutional
evidence supply facts about assignment, ownership and feasibility that neither interface can
manufacture.
   Each interface needs an explicit refusal or unknown state. A retrieved passage with the
wrong unit should fail target review. A graph class outside a backend’s domain should return
unsupported. A valid but uninformative effect set should remain visible. A conflict between
textual and numerical evidence should retain both sources for investigation instead of selecting
whichever yields a cleaner answer.
   CausalDS makes narrated mechanisms, observations and private scoring objects separate
parts of a benchmark, and its results distinguish symbolic answers, uncertainty, abstention
and cost.Leban and Sun (2026) The proposed evaluation adopts that separation as a design
principle. It does not borrow a published model score as evidence for the local prototype. The
next chapters develop the translation, diagram, discovery, workflow and economic consequences
of this architecture; its empirical value still requires independent mechanisms and an actual
declared backend.
33.7. From a frontier result to a banking capability                                           393


33.7      From a frontier result to a banking capability
The inspected literature gives reasons to invest in better assistance, but it does not yield a
single ranking of causal systems. A system that extracts relations from documents, a system
that answers a supplied structural-model question and a system that chooses a treatment
policy may all receive a score called causal accuracy. Their inputs, permissible assumptions
and correct outputs differ. A product proposal must recover these differences before it uses an
experimental result to select software or allocate development effort.
  For this purpose, describe an evaluation claim by

                                      E = (T , I, A, O, B, L),                              (33.1)

where T is the task distribution, I the information supplied to the system, A its scientific
assumptions, O the oracle or adjudication rule, B the tool, repair and human budget, and L
the loss used to score its output. This is a proposed comparison vocabulary, not a theorem
that these quantities are observed without error. It asks a practical question: which parts of
the published experiment would remain the same in the proposed banking use? A change in
any component requires an argument or a new experiment before the original score can carry
the same interpretation.
   For example, a graph provided in the prompt belongs to I. Correctly calculating a back-door
formula from it tests conditional reasoning. Inferring that graph from account and contact
records is a different task with different assumptions. Likewise, a human who repairs a mistaken
join changes the combined workflow’s information and cost. The repaired answer can be
valuable, but attributing its correctness entirely to the model would misdescribe the product
being evaluated. This motivates an explicit comparison of the strongest available alternatives
rather than an agent-only leaderboard.


33.7.1     Favorable and adverse results locate different opportunities

The earliest broad frontier analysis treats language models as a channel for domain knowledge
and a possible aid to graph construction, critique and robustness analysis. It also probes
memorization and prompt sensitivity. These observations motivate assistance with familiar
concepts while warning that a recognizable public dataset can supply information absent
from a fresh bank problem. Neither renaming a variable nor recalling a benchmark answer
establishes a new identification result Kıcıman et al. (2023).
   CLadder gives a more controlled formal task: generated questions from specified causal
structures with alternative verbalizations. That design isolates important distinctions among
association, intervention and counterfactual reasoning. The supplied structure and generator,
however, are part of the experimental information. A bank workflow must also determine
whether its variable, treatment and population definitions support that structure. The paper’s
remaining language-to-formal-tool problem is therefore central to the proposed product, not
an incidental user-interface issue Jin et al. (2023).
   Two comparisons show why the proposal should retain nonagent and smaller-model baselines.
In CausalEval, adding function calls improves the reported GPT-4o CLADDER point score
from 69 to 76 relative to ordinary chain-of-thought, but reduces its e-CARE score from 90 to 73.
These are outcomes from the named historical configurations and samples. They demonstrate
variation across tasks, not a general tool penalty or benefit. In the inspected relation-extraction
study, the DDI F1 values for Single-Prompt C and PubMedBERT are 67.4 and 87.9. The
task concerns binary pairwise relations and the fine-tuned system receives labeled training
examples. The result supports considering supervised extraction where the document domain
394                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


and annotation budget are suitable; it does not compare whole causal pipelines at equal total
cost Longxuan Yu, Delin Chen, Siheng Xiong, Qingyang Wu, Qingzhen Liu, Dawei Li, Zhikai
Chen, Xiaoze Liu and Liangming Pan (2025); Yuni Susanti and Nina Holsmoelle (2025).
   Retrieval has similarly mixed consequences. LACR combines background knowledge, docu-
ments and optional numerical information. Its ASIA skeleton F1 falls from 1 to approximately
.73 when documents are added, while other reported cases benefit. Documents can add an
applicable mechanism, introduce a conflicting definition or repeat the same unsupported
assertion. The scientific question is which information changed and why it was relevant, rather
than how many documents entered the prompt Zhang et al. (2024).
   Auditing assumptions is another promising but restricted task. ARGUS assesses the reported
support for difference-in-differences assumptions, uses injected flaws as local ground truth and
explicitly avoids adjudicating causal truth. Its five-paper human-label pilot and in-sample
calibration do not establish the error rate on a new collection of studies. A bank can use such
an assistant to find missing discussion or contradictory passages while keeping assignment,
parallel trends and measurement facts open to scientific assessment Zhang et al. (2026).
   CausalCollab makes the longitudinal issue concrete. It defines an incremental stylistic effect
in sequential human–model interactions under explicit positivity and sequential exchangeability
premises. Its intervention mixes text versions through a specified functional construction. A
proposed collections-message rewriting policy is not automatically that intervention: it must
define which actual messages are delivered, to whom, and after which history. Model-generated
counterfactual edits or outcome labels in an evaluation remain generated evidence. The
theorem’s premises, the estimator’s approximation and the operational rewriting policy must
be reviewed separately Bohan Zhang, Yixin Wang and Paramveer S. Dhillon (2024).
  These results favor a portfolio of bounded roles. Template-driven formalization, supervised
extraction, retrieved evidence, formal graph algorithms and numerical causal estimators can
each be a baseline or component. A language model is valuable where it reduces a measured
bottleneck while preserving the meaning of the task. Its presence is not a requirement for every
component. The architecture chapter develops how to enforce those boundaries in handoffs;
the question here is what evidence can justify selecting them.


33.7.2    Task composition can reverse a published ranking

Let sak be method a’s success probability on task stratum k and wk the proportion of eligible
                               P
requests in that stratum, with k wk = 1. Under a common success definition, the overall
probability is                                X

                                                 k

Even when every sak is known, ranking methods requires w. A pooled score from one benchmark
mixture is not a mixture-free property of a system. When the strata use incompatible outcomes,
they should first remain separate rather than be forced into this formula.
   As an arithmetic illustration, use the two reported CausalEval point-score pairs just discussed.
Give CLADDER weight w and e-CARE weight 1−w. The FunctionCall-minus-chain-of-thought
difference is
                            ∆(w) = .07w − .17(1 − w) = .24w − .17.                           (33.3)
It changes sign at w = 17/24 ≃ .7083. At equal weights the difference is −.05; at w = .8 it is
