   This calculation supplies a clear reason to prefer a generated prototype now. It can verify
the likelihood update, target preservation, action threshold and complete outcome accounting.
It can introduce dropout, shared shocks or worlds outside the two-model family and test
whether the workflow reports the changed assumptions. An actual bank experiment is justified
only when its feasible action, observation law, transfer population and cost could resolve a
consequential uncertainty. The present calculation cannot supply those inputs and does not
authorize or perform an experiment.
   A retrieval-only query has zero value for discriminating these two worlds if its response law
is identical in both and it conveys no new applicable restriction. Its likelihood ratio is one and
the posterior remains q. Retrieval may still improve variable definitions, reduce clerical effort
or reveal a genuine distinguishing fact. Those are separate benefits to model and measure.
Repeating a prompt until it favors the preferred graph does not reproduce the experiment
analyzed in Equation (38.7).
   The comparison also explains why full graph recovery is sometimes unnecessary. When
every retained model recommends the same feasible action over the relevant cost range, further
orientation may have little decision value. When two models differ on a consequential action,
the useful query is the one that separates them under an admissible information mechanism.
An agent can help formulate that query and show which assumptions drive its value. The
proposal’s initial objective is this reviewable connection from discovery to a decision, with
numerical and semantic limits preserved.


38.26        A correlation screen can discard a nonlinear cause
The proposal should also evaluate what happens before the formal discovery engine is called.
A marginal correlation screen may reduce the number of candidate pairs supplied to an agent,
but its omissions constrain everything downstream. The inspected Augur procedure uses a
Spearman screen before language judgments. Its reported forecasting performance does not
establish that this screen retains all intervention-relevant mechanisms (Zhiqing Cui, Binwu
Wang, Qingxiang Liu, Yeqiang Wang, Zhengyang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang and Yang Wang, 2025).
An exact project example shows the distinction without making any claim about an executed
38.27. Information gain and decision value can choose different queries                        477


Augur benchmark.
  Let X ∼ N (0, 1) and E ∼ N (0, 1) be independent, and set
                                         Y = X 2 − 1 + E.
Then E(Y | X = x) = x2 − 1, so X and Y are dependent, but
         Cov(X, Y ) = E(X 3 ) − E(X) = 0,          Var(Y ) = E(X 4 ) − E(X 2 )2 + 1 = 3.
The population Spearman correlation is also zero. To see this, the joint law of (X, Y )
is unchanged when X is replaced by −X. Since the normal distribution function obeys
Φ(−X) = 1 − Φ(X), the expectation of (Φ(X) − 1/2)(FY (Y ) − 1/2) is equal to its negative
and hence is zero. The independent Gaussian error makes the outcome continuous, so the
usual continuous-rank interpretation applies. Neither a Pearson nor a Spearman population
threshold bounded away from zero retains this pair on the basis of its marginal correlation.
   The intervention response is not zero: replacing X by x gives E{Y | do(X = x)} = x2 − 1.
Moving from zero to one changes the mean by one; moving from minus one to one changes
it by zero. Thus even the phrase “the effect of X” is incomplete without the intervention
contrast. In a banking scenario, X might be a standardized deviation from a reference pricing
point and the response might be curved. The example does not establish that such a curve
applies to deposits. It identifies a specific failure regime that a discovery proposal should cover
(Causal banking proposal, 2026n).
   A deterministic feature H = X 2 − 1 would reveal the association in this law: Var(H) =
Cov(H, Y ) = 2. That feature is a useful model representation, but it does not make H an
independently manipulable business action. It maps X and −X to the same value. The
interface must retain the original action, the transformation and the intervention contrast.
Discovering relations among engineered features can change the graph’s variables and its
feasible interventions. An agent should not relabel those features as independently adjustable
levers.
   Several remedies have distinct costs. Retaining all candidate pairs avoids this particular
screen but increases search and testing burden. A nonlinear dependence screen can detect
other features of the joint law, subject to its sampling assumptions and power. A scientifically
motivated feature family can make a restricted functional model plausible, but choosing
features after examining the final evaluation sample changes the procedure being assessed.
A language proposal of a nonlinear relation can be retained as a hypothesis without being
treated as verified evidence. The public prototype should compare these alternatives with
the same initial information and report which candidate relations were removed before graph
search began.


38.27       Information gain and decision value can choose different
            queries
Model disagreement or expected entropy reduction can be useful ways to select a new experiment.
The inspected Model Discovery Agent uses a disagreement surrogate for information gain
within its candidate mechanism pool (Murphy, 2026). The banking decision adds another
requirement: the acquired information must concern something that can change a feasible
action. A high information score need not meet that requirement. The following project
example makes the difference exact.
   Let a candidate world have two independent binary properties, R and S. Assume Pr(R =
1) = 1/10 and Pr(S = 1) = 1/2. Only R affects the offer decision: offering gives five units
478                                                                Causal analysis for a universal bank


when R = 1 and minus three when R = 0; not offering gives zero. Property S concerns
another graph feature that does not affect this target. The current expected offer value is
5/10 − 27/10 = −11/5, so the current action is no offer. Perfect observation of R would allow
offering only in its favorable state, with expected value 1/2. Perfect observation of S cannot
change the action and has decision value zero.
   Nevertheless, a query revealing S removes one bit of world uncertainty, while a query
revealing R removes only h2 (1/10) ≃ .468996 bits, where h2 (p) = −p log2 p − (1 − p) log2 (1 − p).
Maximizing entropy reduction over the full candidate world therefore prefers the decision-
irrelevant query. This is a difference between objectives, not a computational failure. It can
arise even when the candidate probabilities and the query likelihoods are exactly known.
  Now consider an informative but imperfect query Z about R, with Pr(Z = 1 | R = 1) = 4/5
and Pr(Z = 1 | R = 0) = 1/5. A positive answer gives posterior probability 4/13, and a
negative answer gives 1/37. Both are below the offer threshold 3/8, so the optimal action
remains no offer for either answer. This query has positive mutual information about R,
namely h2 (13/50) − h2 (1/5) ≃ .104818 bits, but zero value for this decision. Information that
changes beliefs can still be too weak to cross a relevant action threshold.
  A more accurate query has true-positive probability 19/20 and false-positive probability
1/20. Its positive posterior is 19/28 and its negative posterior is 1/172. Offering only after a
positive answer now gives ex ante value
                                 1 19          9 1             17
                                                    
                              5             −3             =      = .34.
                                10 20          10 20           50
This remains below the perfect-information value .5. A query cost of .1 per comparable future
decision would leave planning net value .24 under these stipulations. The same priced irrelevant
query has negative net value. The probability and cost assumptions are authored inputs, not
measured calibration or vendor prices (Causal banking proposal, 2026n).
   The lesson for an agent is precise. Retain a model-discrimination objective when scientific
understanding is the declared target. For a specified banking action, propagate candidate
worlds into utilities and ask whether the query can change the preferred action. If several bank
decisions share the graph, the utility may include several uses; their populations and weights
need to be stated rather than silently inferred. Customer constraints and acquisition costs
also belong in this calculation. Optimizing information gain is not wrong, but its connection
to investment value must be demonstrated.
   The prototype can implement these finite reference problems before conducting any expensive
experiment. It should reproduce the different query rankings, preserve the posterior update
and explain the dependence on the prior and loss. If a language-only query is assigned a
likelihood, that likelihood requires its own evidence; model confidence is not a substitute. A
correct implementation of this arithmetic would demonstrate decision accounting in a declared
finite problem. It would not establish that the candidate-world set includes the bank’s true
mechanism or that a real proposed query has the stipulated reliability.


38.28      From language guidance to a defensible discovery deci-
           sion
Language assistance can make a discovery workflow more useful by clarifying variables, locating
applicable knowledge, comparing algorithms and exposing conflicting assumptions. Its strongest
proposal is a supervised route from meaning to an explicitly restricted causal model. The
decisive question is whether that route improves the intervention decision while preserving
38.28. From language guidance to a defensible discovery decision                              479


what the observations cannot distinguish. A graph that is more fluent, more stable under
repeated prompting, or easier to fit need not answer that question.
   Consider a bank choosing a one-unit increase in a standardized deposit offer A at the start
of a month. Let Y be a standardized measure of the following month’s retained balances.
The population consists of accounts eligible when the offer is set; post-offer behavior cannot
become baseline information by renaming a column. For the example below, account histories
are independent, there is no interference, and the decision compares do(A = 1) with do(A = 0).
These are stipulated conditions for a calculation, not properties inferred from a real bank.
Shared branches, calendar shocks, selection and equilibrium responses would require a different
observation model.


38.28.1     A clock-compatible ambiguity that more observational data cannot
            remove

Two centered Gaussian structural models illustrate the information problem. In the first, the
offer changes the outcome:

          A = UA ,     Y = 12 A + UY ,      UA ⊥ UY ,      Var(UA ) = 2,   Var(UY ) = 23 .

  In the second, a pre-offer latent condition H affects both variables:

               A = H + V,        Y = H + W,           H, V, W independent N (0, 1).

  Both mechanisms respect the recorded order of offer and outcome. Both produce the same
nonsingular observed distribution,
                                             !!
                                     2 1
                      (A, Y ) ∼ N 0,              ,      E(Y | A = a) = 12 a.
                                     1 2

   The covariance determinant is three, so this ambiguity does not depend on a degenerate
observed table. Nevertheless, the intervention contrast is 1/2 in the first model and zero in the
second. Causal sufficiency would exclude the second model by assumption. The clock alone
does not exclude it. A language system that interprets the phrase “offer response” as proof of
a direct effect has supplied a scientific restriction that was absent from the numerical data.
   There is also an exact limit on a forced choice based only on these observations. If an
algorithm selects the first model with probability q, its success probabilities in the two worlds
are q and 1 − q, because the input distribution is identical. Their sum is one and the smaller
is at most one half, for any observational sample size. This statement includes randomized
algorithms. It does not say that all causal discovery is impossible; it identifies the information
missing in this particular comparison. An applicable assignment restriction or an intervention
could distinguish the worlds. A repeated description of the same observed association cannot.
   This distinction determines the numerical baseline. A PC analysis under causal sufficiency
and the stipulated order answers a conditional question. A latent-aware analysis must retain
the possibility of common causes. Neither method should be scored as wrong merely for
declining to select a single DAG when its declared model class permits both mechanisms. For
these two stipulated worlds the compatible effect values are {0, 1/2}. That pair is not an
exhaustive identified set over arbitrary latent models, and it is not a finite-sample confidence
set. A prototype should retain those qualifications in the returned object. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026x)
480                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


38.28.2     What the reported gains do and do not support

The available studies motivate several distinct product options. Retrieval can supply missing
definitions or restrictions; soft priors can guide a limited numerical search; statistical prompt-
ing can make existing numerical evidence intelligible; and debate can organize competing
explanations. The appropriate comparator changes with the role. A retrieved definition is
compared with a dictionary and a documented expert rule, whereas a search prior is compared
with the same numerical algorithm and resource budget.
   The primary results also preclude a single claim of uniform improvement. LACR’s retrieved-
document condition reduces ASIA skeleton F1 from 1 to 0.73, while additional knowledge
improves CORONARY. Its reported perfect orientation score is conditional on recovered true-
positive edges. Missing and false edges therefore remain outside that particular denominator.
(Zhang et al., 2024) Darvariu and colleagues report useful combined mutual-information and
language priors, especially with limited search, but mutual information alone performs best
on Child in the reported comparison. Keeping positive search support is useful; it does not
calibrate the probability of a causal effect. (Darvariu et al., 2024)
   Statistical prompting is similarly task dependent. In Takayama and colleagues’ Table 3,
the Sachs PC baseline has F1 0.44, the language condition without the statistical prompt has
0.52, and the two statistical-prompt conditions have 0.29 and 0.27. Other algorithm/dataset
combinations improve. These are comparisons within the authors’ experiment, not local
replications or evidence that one algorithm always dominates. Their lower fit criterion and
their closer-to-reference graph are different outcomes. (Takayama et al., 2024)
   Cohrs and colleagues report query-order agreement of 0.510 and 0.870 for their two model
configurations, and a data-based method has higher SACHS F1 than either language method.
Their answer-proportion null concerns the response process. Even a correctly calibrated test
of that null would not automatically test conditional independence in the bank population.
(Cohrs et al., 2024) The response-count calculation developed earlier in this chapter supplies a
separate finite-binomial counterexample; it should be reused as a diagnostic, not represented
as a new model experiment.
  The newer multi-agent comparison combines algorithm selection and code execution with
graph debate. Its inspected version reports that additional debate rounds can degrade Survey
and Auto results and that the complete workflow consumes 16–25 times the tokens of standard
baselines. Those findings support a bounded single-round comparator and full cost accounting,
without establishing bank economics. (Le et al., 2024) The 2026 argumentation approach
makes conflicts explicit but retains hard semantic constraints after an irreversible preliminary
skeleton reduction. Its synthetic descriptions are generated with access to the true graph
and its runtime comparison omits external model latency. These limits motivate neutral
descriptions, misleading-description controls and complete timing. (Li and Russo, 2026)
   Exposure and semantics require separate tests. The accessible-corpus study by Feng and
colleagues links relation frequency to performance and examines contradictory statements and
context changes. Its scope does not establish the behavior of every closed model. Moreover,
a changed context may genuinely change the causal claim. A fixed-world paraphrase test
must preserve the population, timing and intervention; a changed-world test must change its
reference answer accordingly. (Feng, 2024) Contradiction reduction and graph agreement are
useful diagnostics, but neither is a substitute for effect truth. The inspected hallucination
study explicitly retains that distinction. (Grace Sng, Yanming Zhang and Klaus Mueller, 2024)
   Barakati and colleagues provide a domain application that usefully exposes the translation
problem. Their materials study maps microscopy-derived unit-cell descriptors to literature
terminology, queries relationships using LangChain and a language model, and reruns gCastle
38.28. From language guidance to a defensible discovery decision                              481


PC with required and forbidden relations. The stated response schema includes insufficient
information. This is a concrete architecture for connecting measurements, terminology and
candidate restrictions. Its comparison chiefly discusses agreement between inferred pathways
and prior LiNGAM findings. Agreement does not establish an intervention oracle, and spatial
unit cells are not automatically independent samples. The abstract uses the term fine-tuning,
whereas the inspected methods describe querying literature and give no reproducible training
recipe or checkpoint. The proposal should therefore retain the documented workflow without
inferring a trained artifact or calibrated effect uncertainty. The linked repository is a separate
reuse lead requiring its own revision, rights and execution review. (Barakati et al., 2025)


38.28.3     Missing answers and recorded identity are part of the causal inter-
            face

Tracing the pinned research code reveals obligations that are less visible in a method name. In
the selected causal_GPT interface, the pure PC wrapper reads variable descriptions and stored
language answers. Its numerical pvalue method pools the two query orders, then converts a
decision to zero or one. A missing stored row returns zero. The advertised weighted-vote branch
also returns zero beside an unfinished implementation marker. Thus unavailable evidence,
an unsupported aggregation method and a dependence decision can share one numerical
representation. These observations concern the inspected source, not measured frequencies in
an installed package. (IPL-UV causal GPT contributors, 2024)
   The hybrid path contains a genuine numerical fallback for queries outside the selected
language-variable/conditioning scope. Within that scope it collects unanswered queries, uses
temporary decisions while assembling them, and requests their answers in the surrounding
driver. That driver also saves result metadata with fixed model and temperature strings despite
accepting different values as arguments. For example, a configured model B at temperature
0.2 would still receive the inspected record’s fixed model label and temperature 0.6. This is a
literal assignment trace, not an API call. A comparison cannot be reproduced reliably if result
identity and actual configuration can diverge. (IPL-UV causal GPT contributors, 2024)
   The proposal should therefore adopt the useful separation of language and numerical query
channels while replacing the ambiguous interchange. A language-answer object needs the target
statement, operational definitions, source evidence, model revision, settings, parsing status and
an explicit unknown state. A statistical test object needs its observations, null, sampling law
and calibration. A pending query must not be published as a completed dependence judgment.
Unsupported weighted voting should refuse until implemented and checked. Result identity
should be populated from the actual request and response, with missing metadata retained as
missing.


38.28.4     A token score does not have the same meaning in three discovery
            engines

The five pinned LLM-and-SCD notebooks expose a complete research route from an initial
graph and bootstrap summaries through two prompts to constrained rediscovery. In a selected
collection cell, the code sums the first token’s top-five probability mass only when the token is
exactly Yes or yes. It separately accumulates No or no. It does not identify all semantically
equivalent strings or turn the unreported mass into an explicit uncertainty object. The resulting
score is a property of the prompted token distribution, not a probability that an edge exists in
the bank. (Masataka Takayama and contributors, 2024)
  An exact authored example makes the parsing boundary visible. Suppose the five tokens
482                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


have masses 0.96, 0.02, 0.01, 0.005 and 0.005, assigned to Yes, No, a newline, I and It. The
literal affirmative score is 0.96. Change only the first token to a leading-space Yes; the exact-
string collector assigns affirmative score zero, although a whitespace-normalized semantic class
still has mass 0.96. These are constructed input distributions, not observed endpoint outputs.
They show why unrecognized formats and truncated token lists need explicit treatment before
any scientific constraint is created. Simple normalization would fix this example but would not
establish causal calibration or solve multi-token answer semantics. (Causal banking proposal,
2026x)
  The conversion then magnifies a parsing choice. The selected notebook marks a score
below 0.05 as forbidden, above 0.95 as required, and the interval between them as unknown.
Consequently the two constructed representations above become opposite hard constraints.
At exactly 0.95 the notebook returns unknown, while the inspected paper’s Algorithm 2 uses
an inclusive upper threshold. The 0.05 boundary is unknown in both. The notebook commit
predates the inspected paper revision, so the discrepancy is a version-alignment obligation,
not evidence about the authors’ later experimental execution. (Masataka Takayama and
contributors, 2024; Takayama et al., 2024)
   The target backend introduces another semantic choice. The PC conversion creates required
and forbidden directed-edge objects; exact search receives an allowed supergraph, in which a
high score permits rather than forces an edge. The proposed pinned DirectLiNGAM target
documents directed-path prior knowledge. Its meaning must be checked against the notebook’s
direct-impact question and the chosen matrix convention. For a chain A → M → Y , no
direct A → Y edge exists, but an A-to-Y directed path does. Converting “no direct impact”
to “no directed path” rules out this chain and its mediated effect. A common matrix with
numbers −1, 0, 1 does not make these three contracts interchangeable. (Masataka Takayama
and contributors, 2024; LiNGAM project, 2026b)
  Notebook dependency installation is not locked to a reproducible environment. The separate
cycle-conversion notebook also passes the data positionally into a constructor whose first
parameter is random_state in the later inspected target, before calling fit with the data.
Compatibility must be established at an actual chosen dependency revision; this source
comparison does not demonstrate what ran in the historical notebook. Acyclic conversion and
choosing among repaired constraints by fit on the same observations are further parts of the
adaptive procedure, and must accompany any later uncertainty claim. (Masataka Takayama
and contributors, 2024; LiNGAM project, 2026b)
   LLM-CD offers a useful alternative representation. The inspected evaluation checks generated
relations against directed reachability. Its backend wrappers serialize ancestral constraints
separately from absent edges and, for one backend, order constraints. This is consistent with
the primary paper’s distinction between ancestral priors and local adjacency. The paper also
states that the factorization of path priors is approximate and that their common strength
is problem dependent. (LLM-CD contributors, 2025a; Ban et al., 2023) Adoption still needs
a bounded adapter: the selected wrappers use shared working paths and shell calls whose
exit status is not checked before parsing, then remove intermediate files. A nested backend
license does not resolve missing root-project terms. The proposed adapter should retain typed
constraints, use isolated run directories, check process results and preserve all scientific inputs
and outputs. Its terms and dependency boundaries must be resolved before enabling it.


38.28.5     A public and generated prototype with a decision criterion

A useful first prototype has two stages. Deterministic semantic fixtures check missing answers,
unsupported methods, token variants, exact threshold boundaries, graph endpoint preservation,
38.28. From language guidance to a defensible discovery decision                             483


cycles, edge-versus-path conversion and request/result identity. These tests are cheap and
have known expected answers. They establish an adapter contract; they do not estimate live
model quality. Only then should the team profile a matched discovery experiment and register
its final design.
  The experiment should split by mechanism family. Repeated numerical samples, variable
names, retrieved packets and prompts belong inside a mechanism’s cluster. The Gaussian
pair above is a compulsory ambiguity case, accompanied by causally sufficient, non-Gaussian
and latent cases with explicit clocks. Generator truth and effect oracles remain outside the
prompts. Natural descriptions, neutral renamed descriptions and deliberately misleading
descriptions are crossed with no retrieval, applicable original evidence, wrong-domain evidence
and contradiction. Removing meaningful definitions changes the information supplied, so the
comparison must say when it tests robustness and when it tests the value of information.
  Each language arm needs the same numerical inputs and a declared comparator: a dictio-
nary/clock baseline; PC or FCI under the appropriate assumptions; score or non-Gaussian
methods within their qualified regimes; language-only proposals; and soft or hard guidance
with declared strength and refusal rules. Final graphs alone are insufficient. Record class
and endpoint retention, invalid outputs, valid abstentions, conditional effect-set retention and
width, and downstream action regret under known truth. Include every requested case in the
denominator, including parse failures, timeouts, empty outputs and conflicting constraints.
Measure total calls, tokens, retries, numerical resources, latency and adjudication effort.
   Before final runs, freeze versions, rights, splits, targets, sample sizes, replication counts,
tolerances, primary paired comparisons and multiplicity treatment. Development profiling
may set resource caps; it cannot become an unannounced final experiment. Prompt variants
and prior strengths must not be selected on the final mechanisms. An optional live model
experiment needs the chosen endpoint’s actual revision and measured costs, but none of these
design steps requires bank data or a paid experiment now.
   The banking example supplies a transparent economic threshold. Stipulate USD 200 per
outcome unit and USD 60 for the unit offer increase. Net values are USD 40 in the direct-
effect world and minus USD 60 in the latent world. If a planner assigns probability p to the
former, the expected net action value is 100p − 60. Because the observed likelihood is the
same, additional observational records alone cannot update those odds within this two-world
comparison. At p = 0.9 the expected value is USD 30, while perfect knowledge would produce
USD 36 by taking the action only in the favorable world. Thus USD 6 per decision is an
upper bound on the expected value of any information experiment under those assumptions.
At p = 0.5 it is USD 20. A real noisy experiment supplies less information and incurs costs;
neither number is bank ROI or an authorized spending budget. (Causal banking proposal,
2026x)
   The resulting recommendation is to reuse typed evidence, explicit conflict handling and
bounded search guidance as design references; to defer enabled package integration until the
specified contracts are verified; and to reject automatic conversion of response agreement into
causal confidence. The unresolved scientific task is to justify useful graph/effect uncertainty
for the complete adaptive procedure in declared regimes. The small-language-model discovery
lead currently has metadata but no acquired original; its methods cannot support a technical
comparison yet. Broader literature coverage and that original remain explicit survey work.
They do not prevent the proposed public/generated prototype from testing the concrete
semantic and decision boundaries established here.
484                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


38.29      Temporal discovery with hidden causes: what an agent
           can add

38.29.1     Start with the intervention, the clock and the hidden alternative

A servicing team observes that a borrower receiving more contact this month has a different
repayment outcome next month. It wants to change contact intensity, not merely forecast the
outcome. Let Xit denote the intensity for borrower i at decision time t, and let Yi,t+1 denote
the subsequent net recovery before contact cost. A useful first target is

                       τ = E{Yi,t+1 (do(Xit = 1)) − Yi,t+1 (do(Xit = 0))}.

Here the expectation is over a declared eligible borrower population and its predecision histories.
A multistage policy requires a separate target that also specifies subsequent actions. Recording
a message after a payment does not make the message a prepayment intervention. Event time,
availability time, decision time and follow-up must therefore be represented separately. An
agent can elicit these distinctions and propose candidate mechanisms. Neither the ordering of
the records nor a persuasive mechanism description establishes exchangeability, the absence of
selection, or a manipulable treatment. (Zheng, 2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ax)
  The distinction can be seen without fitting a model. Consider a centered two-wave Gaussian
example, with independent standard normal U, ex , ey :

                                X = U + ex ,       Y = 2U + ey .

The hidden state U can represent persistent financial distress. There is no effect of intervening
on X. A second world has X ∼ N (0, 2) and Y = X + e, where e ∼ N (0, 3) is independent
of X. Its intervention effect is one. Both worlds have exactly the same observed bivariate
Gaussian law, with covariance matrix
                                                     !
                                                2 2
                                          Σ=        .
                                                2 5

The regression slope is one in both worlds; the time order is also the same. More observations
of this law cannot choose the causal effect. If one outcome unit is stipulated to be USD 20
and the added contact costs USD 8, the two net effects are minus USD 8 and plus USD 12. A
language model that labels U “distress” has supplied an interpretation, not an observation of
U or a reason to discard either world. These exact constructions explain why a proposal must
preserve ambiguity until a defensible restriction, proxy, assignment mechanism or experiment
supplies additional information. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   Time indexing also changes the graph class. The arrows At → Bt+1 and Bt → At+1 are
compatible with an acyclic time-unrolled model. Collapsing time produces the cycle A →
B → A. Likewise, At → At+1 is ordinary autoregressive persistence, not a contemporaneous
self-cycle. An instruction to “repair the DAG” by deleting these arrows would remove valid
candidate mechanisms. The product needs a typed graph carrying lag units, contemporaneous
edges, endpoint marks and latent-variable semantics before it asks an agent to explain or
modify it. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ay,ax)


38.29.2     Five frontier roles that should be evaluated separately

RealTCD uses language-derived meta-initialization within temporal discovery from observa-
tional and interventional regimes. Its unknown-target result is valuable because intervention
38.29. Temporal discovery with hidden causes: what an agent can add                            485


targets need not all be supplied in advance. It nevertheless assumes causal sufficiency. The-
orem 3.1 concerns a global score maximizer under sufficient conditional-density capacity,
intervention faithfulness, strict positivity, finite entropy and suitably small penalties. These
are substantive restrictions on the data and optimization problem. LLM initialization does
not prove that a numerical optimizer reaches that maximizer. A month with unusually many
arrears is not automatically an intervention regime: an unrecorded macroeconomic shock
can change both contact and repayment. For banking, the proposed use is to suggest initial
lagged structures and possible regime targets while retaining a separate register of which
regime assignments are observed, assumed or conjectured. Its reported benchmark advantages
are author results under their designs, not evidence that hidden banking causes have been
recovered. (Li, 2024)
   Sequential Causal Discovery with Noisy Language Model Priors addresses a different problem.
Its sequential axis consists of arriving observation batches; it should not be silently equated
with a fully specified temporal structural model. The inspected formulation allows latent
confounding under a restriction that each confounder affects two observed variables. Language
judgments update edge-level beliefs in a Bayesian-inspired scheme. The authors explicitly
distinguish this from full probabilistic inference over graphs, and leave broader confounding,
calibration and interventional extensions as future work. Their discussion also warns against
transferring standard independent, stationary bandit regret guarantees to the dependent
language-response channel. This is a useful approach to noisy suggestions, but an edge belief
cannot be presented as a calibrated posterior over all banking mechanisms or as confidence in
a policy value. (Verma et al., 2025)
   Large Causal Models provide an essential numerical comparator. They are pretrained
numerical transformers for temporal discovery, not large language models interpreting business
text. The inspected paper assumes additive noise, causal stationarity, no hidden confounders
and no contemporaneous effects. Its limitations section says that the model does not detect or
correct violations of these assumptions; predictions can instead reflect training-distribution
biases. Reported speed and accuracy under its test design motivate a challenger in that
declared domain. They do not justify using the model as a hidden-confounder detector. A
bank comparison should therefore separate the gain from numerical pretraining from any gain
due to language descriptions, expert restrictions or additional information. (Kougioulis et al.,
2026)
   Model Discovery Agent assigns language another role: proposing additions to a mechanistic
hypothesis library. Candidate models are fitted and compared using evidence approximations,
including BIC or tempered sequential Monte Carlo in different settings. The inspected
experiments use open-loop inputs; the method discussion distinguishes these from closed-loop
actions that depend on observed history. The finite-pool interpretation is particularly relevant to
banking. Even exact evidence would give a posterior restricted to the enumerated candidates. In
the implemented search, evidence is approximate, top-pool pruning is deterministic hypothesis
search, and unproposed model mass is not represented. Small residuals can delay further
expansion, and a discarded model can later become relevant. An agent can thus make a model
library more useful without establishing that it contains the true policy-response mechanism.
A servicing application needs an archive of rejected alternatives and challenges that distinguish
their intervention predictions, not only their fit to logged trajectories. (Murphy, 2026)
   The protected-core architecture advocated in Causal Discovery in the Era of Agents supplies
a way to combine these roles. The formal discovery method continues to determine the meaning
of its output; the agent proposes context, retrieval, assumptions and analyses around it. A
CPDAG represents a class of DAGs, and a PAG preserves ambiguity arising with latent or
selection variables. Neither should become a single confident DAG because the report needs a
486                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


diagram. This is an architectural argument and prospective evaluation standard. It is not an
empirical demonstration of safe banking performance, and its causal-learn+ identity is distinct
from the CausalAgent repository inspected below. (Zheng, 2026)
   Evidence against unqualified language assistance belongs alongside these favorable possibili-
ties. The inspected study on integrating language priors reports degradation when priors are
inaccurate, particularly for the temporal Water and Mildew examples. A model’s familiarity
with a variable name can encode the wrong temporal scale, population or intervention. Con-
sequently, a fair comparison must include deliberately reversed or misleading priors, opaque
variable names, and a no-language baseline. Tuning prior strength on the final evaluation
mechanisms would conceal the very failure the comparison is meant to measure. (Ban et al.,
2023; Causal banking proposal, 2026ax)


38.29.3    Additional non-Gaussian information: a useful but restricted route

Shi and colleagues develop a two-wave method that can distinguish some causal alternatives
using higher-order cumulants. Their model is

                           X = β1 U + ex ,      Y = β2 U + ηX + ey ,

with temporal ordering, linearity, independent errors and latent component, and specified
non-Gaussian information. Define the fourth mixed cumulants C31 = cum(X, X, X, Y ),
C22 = cum(X, X, Y, Y ) and C13 = cum(X, Y, Y, Y ). The first statistic is
                                                     2
                                     ∆1 = C31 C13 − C22 .

For this scalar-component model, writing κU = cum4 (U ) and κx = cum4 (ex ) gives

                                 ∆1 = κU κx β1 β22 η(β2 + ηβ1 ).

The proof’s nonzero cumulants and loadings, and the excluded cancellation η = −β2 /β1 ,
matter. Under those conditions the statistic supplies information absent from the Gaussian
example. It does not create information in that example by changing the estimator. (Shi et al.,
2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
  Two exact checks make the boundary concrete. First, let U take values −1, 0, 1 with
probabilities 1/6, 2/3, 1/6. It is nonnormal, has variance 1/3, and has fourth cumulant
1/3 − 3(1/3)2 = 0. With independent Rademacher errors, X = U + ex and Y = U + X + ey
have a direct effect of one. Nevertheless, C31 = C22 = C13 = −2, so ∆1 = 0; the relevant
third cumulants are also zero. This does not contradict the result with its full nonzero-
cumulant premises. It shows why “nonnormal” alone is an insufficient eligibility test and why
nondetection must remain inconclusive. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
  Second, consider independent Rademacher U, V, ex , ey with

                           X = U + V + ex ,       Y = U + 2V + ey .

There is no direct X → Y path. Direct enumeration of all sixteen equally likely atoms,
independently checked by adding factor cumulants, gives C31 = −6, C22 = −10 and C13 = −18.
Thus ∆1 = 8. After standardizing X and Y , whose variances are three and six, the determinant
is 8/(32 62 ) = 2/81, still nonzero. The two hidden loading vectors (1, 1) and (1, 2) are not
proportional. Although the paper discusses aggregating hidden factors into a global component,
one common scalar component is not automatically an adequate representation of arbitrary
loadings with the required independent errors. This example lies outside that scalar restriction;
it supplies a diagnostic requirement for a proposed banking application, not a counterexample
38.29. Temporal discovery with hidden causes: what an agent can add                           487


under all theorem premises. Multiple forms of persistent borrower distress should not be
collapsed into a single latent score merely because that makes the test available. (Shi et al.,
2026; Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   The proposed multiple-testing algorithm standardizes the observations and uses percentile
bootstrap intervals for three statistics with a Bonferroni allocation of α/3. The paper explicitly
treats failure to detect as inconclusive. In one specified weak-signal simulation, reported power
rises from 4.8% at N = 2,000 to 99.5% at N = 200,000. These are useful warnings about
information requirements, not a general sample-size formula for a bank. Calendar dependence,
selection, heavy tails and estimated high-order moments require their own inferential argument.
A bootstrap implementation cannot supply that argument by itself. Moreover, detecting the
presence of a path does not consistently estimate its magnitude. The contact decision still
needs an effect or effect set in recovery units. The appropriate reuse is a narrowly qualified
statistical challenger and assumption diagnostic, with stronger restrictions declared explicitly.
(Shi et al., 2026)


38.29.4     Screening, hierarchy and prediction are complementary evidence

Yu and colleagues illustrate a more modest and practically useful language role in dementia
research: screening thousands of candidate variables using word and document embeddings,
followed by manual review and statistical discovery. This is not evidence that a modern agent
independently discovers a true temporal mechanism. Their pipeline uses a mixed graphical
model skeleton followed by FCI-MAX, temporal restrictions, fifty imputed datasets, and
edge-frequency thresholds of 30%, 50% or all datasets. Manual review restores risk factors
missed by the information-retrieval models. The lesson for a bank is to test the recall of
the variable-screening stage before celebrating a smaller graph: a missed common cause can
undermine the downstream analysis. Agreement across imputations is a stability statistic, not
automatically a calibrated graph posterior or a causal confidence set. The source’s cohort prose
reports 406,837 participants whereas its table reports 406,781; that discrepancy is unresolved,
and no exact cohort-size claim is used to justify a banking comparison. UK Biobank access
requires a researcher application, and the supplementary code has not been inspected here.
Publicly described data should therefore be distinguished from data available for unrestricted
immediate reuse. (Yu et al., 2025)
   Spatio-Temporal Hierarchical Causal Models offer another adjacent route. The hierarchy
distinguishes units, such as regions, from repeated subunits, such as sensors. Its collapse
arguments take the number of subunits toward infinity while the numbers of units and
time points remain fixed. The stated conditions include convergence of mechanisms and
empirical measures, static unit confounders, neighbor restrictions, a known global ordering of
contemporaneous spatial influence, and common functional mechanisms. The adjustability
result additionally requires observable history to block the relevant backdoor paths. More
observations within a branch cannot establish that premise or make a time-varying unobserved
shock static. A proposed bank use must specify which objects are units and subunits and why
the asymptotic sequence represents the intended decision. (Li et al., 2026b)
   The paper also states instrument-based identification claims that must be read with a
target-specific argument. A valid instrument alone does not identify an arbitrary population
intervention distribution. To see the problem, let an independent binary instrument Z
encourage treatment among a population split equally between compliers and never-takers.
Compliers have Y (0) = 0, Y (1) = 1; never-takers have Y (0) = 0 and either Y (1) = 0
or Y (1) = 1. Both worlds satisfy exclusion, relevance and monotonicity and produce the
same observed (Z, A, Y ) law. The complier effect is one, but the population average effect
488                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


is respectively one half or one. Additional restrictions are necessary before translating an
instrument into the population recovery target. This construction does not purport to refute
every specialized hierarchical result; it prevents a generic IV sentence from being treated as a
universal identification theorem. (Li et al., 2026b; Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   The hierarchical paper reports favorable simulation comparisons and traffic applications,
including stress settings with drift or feedback. Such results are useful leads for a prototype.
A finite simulation mean of 4.91 near a truth of five is not itself a proof of unbiasedness,
and observed robustness does not remove the theorem’s assumptions. Its public code lead
is a separate item for version, rights and numerical review. It is also a statistical modeling
contribution rather than a demonstrated language-agent capability. (Li et al., 2026b)
   Augur uses language-generated causal explanations and teacher–student distillation for
discrete trend prediction. Its graph-overlap consensus and summary-to-graph consistency
scores help select training explanations. Agreement among sampled graphs, however, can
reproduce one shared misconception. A narrative can match every edge of an incorrect graph.
The inspected forecasting and explanation results therefore motivate a prediction or explanation
baseline, not a claim of hidden-confounder recovery or identified intervention value. (Zhiqing
Cui, Binwu Wang, Qingxiang Liu, Yeqiang Wang, Zhengyang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang and Yang
Wang, 2025)
   CausalPulse illustrates the difference between a successful workflow and successful causal
diagnosis. In its manufacturing evaluation, reported aggregate operational success reaches
98.73% for PSE, while root-cause Hits@1 is 0.44 and F1 is 0.39. Its reference labels are manually
identified “immediate variables changed” at an anomaly timestamp. Those labels and process-
order rules may be useful for its diagnostic task, but changes can be downstream consequences,
and neither operational success nor those annotations establish a bank’s intervention truth. The
appropriate banking comparison reports workflow completion, diagnostic ranking, identification
and decision performance separately. No one metric can stand in for the others. (Chathurangi
Shyalika, Utkarshani Jaimini, Cory Henson and Amit Sheth, 2026)


38.29.5     Inspect the executable boundary before proposing adoption

The pinned LCM source declares package version 0.1.0, Python at least 3.10, an Apache-2.0
root license and six direct dependencies, including NumPy below two and PyTorch Lightning
2.0.8. These declarations do not settle all dependency or checkpoint rights. The advertised
checkpoints support up to twelve variables, lag three and length five hundred; their external
bytes have not been qualified here. The inspected forward path returns a tensor with axes
batch, target variable, source variable and lag index. The example applies a sigmoid, and its
convention maps index l to lag ℓmax − l. For example, index two at maximum lag three means
lag one. A wrapper that reverses source and target or treats the last axis as elapsed calendar
time silently changes the causal claim. (Pinned upstream contributors, 2026b)
  The README’s example contains a concrete masking issue. It loops over the three lag
positions but indexes the two variable dimensions:

for l in range(pred.shape[-1]):
    pred[:, l, l] = 0

For shape (1, 12, 12, 3) this clears nine cells, all lag entries on variable diagonals zero through
two; diagonals three through eleven remain. More fundamentally, valid lagged self-edges should
survive unless the declared model excludes them. The remedy is therefore to decide which
temporal edges are admissible before correcting the index loop. The example’s global min–max
normalization also has a zero denominator for a constant input, and its random padding needs
38.29. Temporal discovery with hidden causes: what an agent can add                            489


explicit seeds, validity semantics and evaluation controls. The inspected loading helper returns
no model on a missing or failed checkpoint and uses a loader path with unrestricted weight
deserialization. Checkpoint identity, loading behavior and failure classification belong in a
prototype contract. These are static-source and exact-coordinate findings, not measurements
from running LCM. (Pinned upstream contributors, 2026b; Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   For DMIRLAB’s CausalAgent, the inspected route spans tool selection, MCP dispatch,
the statistical backend, graph extraction, cycle processing and report preparation. Its root
license is MIT; requirements include specified MCP and LangGraph versions as well as lower-
bounded statistical dependencies, so a resolved compatible environment remains necessary.
The MCP module imports the PC function but invokes an OLC function without importing it,
even though that function exists in the backend. A missing binding and an absent optional
CDMIR dependency are different failures. Neither should be described as a scientific conclusion
that hidden causes are absent. The PC path uses Fisher’s Z at level 0.05; a generic tool
description cannot extend that test’s validity to arbitrary data-generating laws. (Pinned
upstream contributors, 2026a)
   Graph conversion introduces another distinction. The PC path retains raw endpoint matrices,
while the OLC formatter documents its own row/column and coefficient conventions. The
downstream cycle detector keeps entries equal to one and transposes them into a directed
graph. If a bidirected endpoint pair is admitted, this projection produces two directed arrows
and a false directed two-cycle. This is a conditional converter example, not an assertion that
ordinary PC outputs bidirected graphs. Undirected and circle endpoints also need explicit
treatment; deleting them is information loss, not resolution of uncertainty. The detector
catches exceptions and returns the same pair as “no cycle.” A validation error must instead be
an explicit unavailable state. (Pinned upstream contributors, 2026a; Causal banking proposal,
2026ay)
   Tracing the caller prevents an incomplete repair recommendation. It does run the cycle
detector again after proposed edits, but only warns if cycles remain and still reports the original
cycle count as fixed. The editing function deletes one matrix entry without a paired-endpoint
contract. In the normal dictionary-result path, a reversed type guard leaves the critical edge
list empty; the emitted revised graph is then an empty list, and the edited working matrix
is not used for that output. The alternate string branch attempts dictionary access on a
string. Independently, the edge evaluator’s prompt placeholders differ from the keys supplied
at invocation and its exception path returns a low-confidence retain default. Correcting only
that prompt would not repair the dictionary branch or the lost edited graph. A bounded
repair must address the entire typed result path and verify the resulting report, while keeping
original and proposed graphs separately available. No live application or language model was
invoked for these observations. (Pinned upstream contributors, 2026a)
   These findings support reference use before integration. Direct adoption is deferred because
target semantics, native behavior, dependencies and weight identities remain unqualified.
Porting entire neural or agent stacks would add maintenance and equivalence obligations
without an established benefit. A narrow adapter is a plausible next step: preserve upstream
numerical methods while owning the clock, graph, failure and evidence contracts. Rejecting
all research use would discard useful challengers, but accepting an MCP response or an acyclic
projection as causal certification would be equally unjustified. The proposed adapter must
round-trip permitted endpoint pairs and lagged edges, distinguish validation errors from
negative findings, and retain every edit’s origin and justification. (Causal banking proposal,
2026ax)
490                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


38.29.6     A public and generated comparison that can resolve useful questions

The first investment should be a bounded prototype using generated truth and suitable public
observations. Public time series can supply realistic clocks, missingness, vocabulary and
forecasting challenges. They supply causal ground truth only when assignment or interventions
are independently documented. Generated structural models supply known intervention
responses and controlled violations. Combining those roles is more informative than declaring
a public observational graph to be the true bank mechanism. It also avoids making expensive
bank experiments a prerequisite for investigating basic conversion errors. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026ax)
   The comparison should have distinct arms: a numerical method without language; the same
method with expert-supplied restrictions; language proposals accepted only through the formal
core; deliberately corrupted priors; and the numerical LCM challenger within its declared
sufficient, stationary, lag-only domain. Mechanism families should vary scalar versus multiple
latent loadings, weak or zero higher-order signal, temporal feedback and contemporaneous
effects, irregular or aggregated clocks, and drift and selection. Identical observations and
information budgets should be used wherever the scientific target permits. An expert arm
given true hidden structure is an information oracle, not a fair practical competitor. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026ax)
   Evaluation units must be independent mechanisms or complete trajectories under a declared
sampling design, not repeated prompts or neighboring rows. Development, calibration and final
evaluation need separate mechanisms. Freeze source and weight identities, variable descriptions,
prompts, prior-strength rules and stopping budgets before the final set. A pilot can estimate
runtime and variance to choose a defensible replication budget; no final qualification dataset or
success rate is claimed here. Report endpoint accuracy and retained-class validity separately
from identification correctness, effect-set coverage, width, availability, decision loss and total
review/computation cost. Unavailable tools, failed fits, timeouts and refusals remain in their
declared denominators. A repaired graph conversion can pass exact native fixtures while
the scientific model remains inapplicable to a particular hidden-confounder regime. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026ax)
   Several remedies are already concrete. Exact endpoint and lag fixtures can detect conversion
loss. Constant-input and padding fixtures can enforce preprocessing eligibility. A missing OLC
binding or backend can produce a typed failure. The dictionary, prompt, structured-response
and output branches can be corrected together and tested with generated results. Public
metadata-screening exercises can measure omitted-variable recall against an independently
curated reference. None of these steps requires pretending that a language-generated latent
label is an observed variable. They should proceed while the broader statistical questions
remain open. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ax)

misses the true effect with probability at most αG + αE , by the union bound. Independence

   For illustration, budgets of 0.03 and 0.02 allow a 0.05 overall failure bound. An exact

this bound. No graph-frequency histogram, low entropy over LLM outputs, or successful DAG
check establishes either premise. Nor does a narrow interval conditional on one selected graph
account for excluded alternatives. In the Gaussian banking example, even infinite observational
data leave both effects zero and twenty dollars available unless extra assumptions are justified.
Conservative uncertainty can therefore remain wide for an informational reason, not because a
numerical solver needs improvement. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   The known research route is to declare a restricted temporal model family, derive or verify its
retention and observed-law confidence procedure, propagate all compatible effects, and account
for numerical approximation. Exact small models should precede dependent-data studies and
larger learners. General nonlinear latent systems with selection, changing mechanisms and
potentially false language priors are not covered by that route merely because a restricted
example succeeds. Useful finite-sample precision and robustness in those broader regimes
remain open questions. When equivalent models imply opposite decisions, a valid outcome
is an effect set or a request for additional information, rather than a forced point estimate.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026ax)
   An illustrative value-of-information calculation helps decide whether that additional in-
formation merits a later experiment. Suppose, explicitly as a decision-maker’s stipulated
prior, the direct-effect world has probability 3/5. Acting immediately has expected net value
(3/5)12 + (2/5)(−8) = 4 dollars per eligible case. Perfectly distinguishing the worlds before
acting would yield (3/5)12 = 7.2 dollars, so perfect information is worth at most USD 3.2
before its cost. This is an upper bound under the stipulated prior and two-world decision
problem, not an observed bank price or the value of an imperfect trial. A robust decision-maker
who declines to assign that prior may instead retain the net-effect set {−8, 12} and withhold
action under a worst-case criterion. The proposal can explain both decision rules without
inventing institutional preferences. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ay)
   The resulting program is specific about what can be done now: improve semantic contracts,
repair selected adapters in a prototype, test exact counterexamples, and run predeclared public/-
generated comparisons. It is equally specific about what is unresolved: broad graph/effect-set
calibration, model misspecification, useful precision and the information needed to distinguish
observationally equivalent mechanisms. This review recovers three additional primary originals,
but the diffusion-model lead still lacks a securely acquired original and the Earth-science lead
returned HTML rather than a genuine technical PDF. Specialist search saturation, uninspected
supplementary code and checkpoint qualification remain open. These coverage limits do not
prevent the concrete prototype work, and they do prevent a claim of an exhaustive or generally
qualified temporal causal agent. (Causal banking proposal, 2026ax)
