   while the point ratio is .4. All numerator/denominator corners here obey 0 ≤ N ≤ D, so
intersecting with the probability range does not narrow the interval. A valid dependence
relation between their errors might narrow it, but it must be supplied and retained as joint
information. The broad result is produced by bounded deterministic error alone; it is not a
statistical confidence interval. (Causal banking research project, 2026s)
  If an uncertainty region includes D = 0, the service should preserve the unresolved support
condition. Clipping the denominator to a positive constant silently changes the functional
and generally supplies no error certificate. If only strictly positive but arbitrarily small
denominators are allowed, a ratio may be highly sensitive even though the target is defined at
every admitted point. The response should distinguish a model-relative identification result, a
supported numeric coordinate and a finite-precision certificate. These objects answer different
questions and may become available at different times.
   Composition also requires the correct order of nonlinear operations. Suppose two equally
weighted customer groups have success probabilities 1/5 and 1/2. Their population probability
is 7/20, with odds 7/13. Averaging their odds instead gives (1/4+1)/2 = 5/8, which transforms
back to probability 5/13. Neither number arose from a floating-point error. Averaging and
the nonlinear odds map do not commute. An interface that substitutes an average log-odds,
odds or probability because each is called a “risk” has changed the target. In a causal contrast
the error can affect both action-specific means before they are differenced. (Causal banking
research project, 2026s)
   These examples motivate a transformation graph accompanying the result. Its nodes should
identify the scientific object and coordinates, and its arrows should identify an exact map, a
conditional approximation or a certified outer enclosure. A population aggregation followed by
valuation is one path; conversion to a subgroup score followed by averaging is another. The
workflow should be able to explain why the selected path answers the declared question. A
chain of individually sensible package defaults is insufficient evidence that the composed path
does.
   Cross-language comparison can test these properties without pretending to qualify every
estimator. For an exact finite reference table, an admitted identification expression should agree
with a separately computed intervention distribution; variable renaming and category-order
changes should preserve that answer after inverse mapping. A sign reversal should reverse
an effect and reorder interval endpoints. A probability marginal should normalize on its
declared support. These are necessary checks on the concrete path, not sufficient evidence
of universal scientific correctness. The front-door and collider examples provide particularly
useful references because a superficially plausible formula can return a different probability.
  The same testing discipline should retain expected refusals. An unsupported graph class
must not become an empty graph. A normalization failure must not become an estimated
zero effect. A numerical timeout must not be cached as a scientific negative answer for an
624                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


unrelated context. Matching those dispositions across library, CLI and MCP is part of semantic
equivalence. The preserved local transport trial demonstrates selected comparisons for the
existing bounded operations; the proposed y0 path still requires its own actual engine and
conversion evidence. (Causal banking research project, 2026u)
   For investment planning, the practical question is whether the information and computation
are adequate for the decision. A numerically precise conditional effect on a vanishingly small
subgroup may be irrelevant to the bank’s target population. A broad but valid effect set may
establish that a costly expansion cannot be justified yet. A slightly more expensive evaluator
may be valuable if certified containment resolves a decision that uncontrolled approximations
cannot. The proposed product should expose these consequences through the scientific result,
its restrictions and its value calculation, rather than hiding them behind a generic success flag.



46.14      Preserving graph classes, coordinates and set geometry
A bank can receive a syntactically valid result for a different decision from the one it submitted.
A graph may retain its adjacency while losing an unresolved endpoint. Two effects measured in
dollars may exchange positions. A disconnected confidence set may become a convenient interval
that includes values the calculation excluded. These changes matter before an estimator’s
speed or predictive accuracy is compared. The proposed integration layer must therefore
preserve the object on which the decision depends: the scientific context, the graph or graph
class, the named coordinates, and the meaning and geometry of the returned set. A transport
test should deliberately construct examples in which losing one of these features changes an
answer.
   The distinction between a declaration and its scientific validation is especially useful here.
The local reference service already rejects directed cycles in a declared DAG, ambiguous
DAG endpoints, changed context hashes, inconsistent set topologies, and several unsupported
identification requests. Its graph-review operation explicitly reviews syntax. Direct calls
also accept an ADMG declaration containing a circle endpoint or a directed cycle, and a
CPDAG declaration with a bidirected edge, while returning the limitation that full graph-class
membership has not been tested. These are observed boundaries of the selected operation, not
evidence that those objects belong to the named classes. The separate problem-declaration
reviewer rejects the tested ADMG circle and performs additional mark, duplication, cycle and
event-order checks. It still delegates full CPDAG and PAG recognition to a formal engine. An
adapter must retain the review level as well as the graph label; neither a successful request nor
the word computed is a graph-theoretic certificate. (Causal banking research project, 2026ax)


46.14.1     A class of graphs is not their union

Consider the three-node chain with variables A, M, Y , with no adjacency between A and Y .
The three orientations

                  A −→ M −→ Y,          A ←− M −→ Y,           A ←− M ←− Y

have no unshielded collider. For a positive observed law satisfying A ⊥⊥ Y | M , their
observational factorizations agree:

                         p(a)p(m | a)p(y | m) = p(m)p(a | m)p(y | m)
                                               = p(y)p(m | y)p(a | m).
46.14. Preserving graph classes, coordinates and set geometry                                625


This equality is an application of conditional independence and Bayes’ rule. It does not declare
the corresponding interventions equivalent. An exact enumeration of all directed simple graphs
on these three labelled vertices finds 25 DAGs and 11 groups defined by their skeletons and
unshielded collider patterns. The chain group contains these three members. Taking the union
of their directed edges introduces arrows in both directions on the adjacent pairs, producing
cycles that occur in none of the members. Storing that union as a DAG thus destroys the
object being represented. (Causal banking research project, 2026aw)
   A set representation should preserve member identities or a precisely defined equivalence-
class representation. An endpoint mark must retain its declared meaning; adjacency alone
cannot preserve the distinction between a tail, arrowhead and circle. Additional background
restrictions also need their own identity, because they can reduce the admissible orientations.
A declared member handle is only a reference. In an actual syntax-review probe, an absent
member with a well-formed hash and handle is counted and returned without resolving its
bytes. The proposed class-review operation must separately resolve every required member,
verify its content and schema, check its variable map, and record the exact recognition domain.
Missing members require an unavailable review, not silent deletion from the class. (Causal
banking research project, 2026ax)
  The effect consequence can be seen without a large simulation. Let independent zero-mean
Gaussian errors generate either

                    A = εA ,    Y = 12 A + εY ,    (Var εA , Var εY ) = (1, 3/4),

or
                    Y = εeY ,   A = 12 Y + εeA ,   (Var εeY , Var εeA ) = (1, 3/4).
                                                               
                                                        1 1/2
Both observed vectors (A, Y ) have covariance 1/2 1 , hence the same Gaussian law. In-
creasing A by one through intervention changes the mean of Y by 1/2 in the first model and
zero in the second. At a stipulated USD 20 per outcome unit and USD 8 action cost, the net
values are USD 2 and USD −8. Choosing one orientation because a receiving library requires a
DAG would choose between these decisions without new evidence. The appropriate proposal is
to retain both effects or obtain a defensible restriction, intervention or additional measurement
that distinguishes them. (Causal banking research project, 2026aw)
   The current supplied-DAG back-door operation does not implement that general class
calculation. The actual probes return unsupported for PAG, CPDAG, ADMG and DAG-
set requests. A supplied DAG with an unblocked latent common cause also returns an
unsupported back-door attempt, explicitly distinguished from a general nonidentification
result. A future identification engine must declare which graph family and criterion it handles.
For a retained model collection G, a proposed aggregate effect region is G∈G ΘG , where
                                                                               S

ΘG includes all effects compatible with the stated observational law and assumptions within
member G. This expression requires each constituent calculation to have the claimed meaning.
An uncomputed constituent cannot be dropped or converted to the empty set. Neither a
graph-class representation nor a conditional identification formula supplies sampling calibration
by itself. (Causal banking research project, 2026ax)


46.14.2     Coordinate identity is stronger than a unit label

Suppose retail and corporate effects are USD 40 and USD −10 per eligible account. The
requested population weights are 4/5 and 1/5, and the action costs USD 5. The net effect in
the declared order is
                                 4        1
                                 5 (40) + 5 (−10) − 5 = 25.
626                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


If a response uses corporate–retail order but a consumer applies the weights by position, the
result becomes
                                  4         1
                                  5 (−10) + 5 (40) − 5 = −5.

Both vectors have length two and both coordinates use USD. The existing schema and semantic
checks accept an authored response whose generic payload declares the reversed order, while
the requested population text declares retail first. They check units and coordinate counts, but
do not bind an explicit coordinate identity vector between these locations. This observation
concerns an admitted ordering mismatch; it does not claim that any schema can prove that
submitted numbers are scientifically correct. (Causal banking research project, 2026ax,aw)
   The proposed contract should give each coordinate a stable identifier binding its outcome,
intervention contrast, population, horizon, statistic and units. Results should pair these
identifiers with their values and set components. A consumer either matches the requested order
or applies an explicit declared permutation. If P is its permutation matrix, the transformation
must act on the estimate, covariance, joint-region constraints and financial weights together.
For a general fixed affine map ϕ = Lθ + c, the familiar relations

                                  ϕb = Lθb + c,         b ⊤
                                                   b = LΣL
                                                   Σ ϕ

do not license a change in the causal target. The map needs its own input and output
identities, and an estimated map needs its own uncertainty treatment. The earlier population
and covariance examples establish why this binding must include the weighting measure and
joint errors. (Causal banking research project, 2026t)
   Stable identifiers make an accidental reordering detectable when values retain their identities.
They cannot detect a producer that attaches a wrong value to the correct identifier. Native
adapter acceptance therefore also needs asymmetric sentinel examples, deliberate node and
column permutations, and independent numerical references. Equal effects or identical units
are poor sentinels because they can conceal the error. The proposed retail example is small
enough to run at every language boundary before any financial trial.


46.14.3     Set images and joint restrictions

Unknown, empty, whole-line and disconnected sets have different meanings. The current
semantic representation distinguishes an uncomputed unknown set with intervals:null, an
empty set with intervals:[], and the whole line with a single pair of unbounded endpoints.
The probes preserve these states, finite unions and singleton intervals, and reject inverted,
overlapping or inconsistently labelled pieces. A refusal with no numerical result remains
separate from all of them. In particular, an unsupported identification algorithm does not
establish an empty identified set. (Causal banking research project, 2026ax)
  For a scalar map g(x) = 1 − 2x, consider

                                    S = (−∞, −2] ∪ [2, ∞).

Because the slope is negative, the image reverses both endpoint order and component order:

                                   g(S) = (−∞, −3] ∪ [5, ∞).

For the finite union [−3, −2] ∪ [4, 5], the image is [−9, −7] ∪ [5, 7]. Replacing it by its
convex hull [−9, 7] introduces the entire gap (−7, 5). The existing scalar interval-union
arithmetic reproduces these images, including sign reversal and unbounded endpoints. An
outer approximation can be appropriate if it is explicitly labelled and its consequences are
46.14. Preserving graph classes, coordinates and set geometry                                 627


understood. It cannot be described as the exact image when it fills excluded values. (Causal
banking research project, 2026aw)
  Coordinate projections lose a different kind of information. Let a stipulated joint region for
two dollar effects be
                               C = {(x, 10 − x) : 0 ≤ x ≤ 10}.
Each projection is [0, 10], but every point in C has sum ten. With USD 12 cost the exact
joint net-value image is the singleton {−2}. Applying interval-sum arithmetic to the Cartesian
product of the projections instead yields [−12, 8]. The arithmetic correctly computes the image
of the larger rectangle. It has not recovered the relation shared by the two coordinates. A
consumer seeking a robust acceptance decision would reject this action under both sets, but a
possibility-of-profit screen admits it under the rectangle and rejects it under the actual joint
region. Numerical agreement on coordinate endpoints therefore does not establish agreement
on the proposed decision. (Causal banking research project, 2026aw)
   The contract should identify whether a set is a marginal projection, a product outer
bound, or an encoded joint region, and preserve any constraints needed by the downstream
transformation. Sampling meaning is another independent field. Two pointwise 95% sets
provide a joint coverage lower bound of only 90% by the union bound; under independent
exact coverage events their joint coverage is 0.952 = 0.9025. A declaration of simultaneous
coverage requires a construction that supports it. The local validator requires construction
evidence for a joint-confidence label, but cannot certify the validity of that evidence. The
selected three-variable independent Gaussian discovery construction also returns conservative
outer bounds under its restricted linear, causally sufficient model class. Its existence does not
qualify arbitrary temporal PAGs or a general graph-to-effect region. (Causal banking research
project, 2026ax,aw,ay)


46.14.4     A lossless-looking JSON round trip

An actual Python–Node–Python parse-and-serialize probe preserves the tested endpoint marks,
graph-member hash string, unknown and empty states, whole-line and disconnected sets, and
a large identifier stored as a string. This is evidence about this generic codec path; no R,
Java or C++ causal adapter was executed. The same path changes an integer estimate and
singleton endpoint from 253 + 1 = 9007199254740993 to 253 = 9007199254740992. Both the
original and changed response pass the present schema and semantic checks. The resulting
singleton excludes the original value despite preserving the apparent topology and context
hash. (Causal banking research project, 2026au)
   The example is deliberately chosen at an exactness boundary; it does not claim that ordinary
bank effects have that magnitude. Large integer monetary counts, identifiers and scaled fixed-
point quantities can nevertheless cross language boundaries. A prototype should either reject
integers outside a declared exact numeric domain or introduce a typed decimal/integer string
representation with a scale and rounding rule. The present numeric endpoint schema would
need an explicit successor to admit that representation. Infinities should retain their structured
endpoint meaning, rather than being silently replaced by large finite sentinels. For approximate
endpoints, the contract must state error bounds and, where set inclusion is claimed, use justified
outward rounding.
   Context hashing exposes a complementary failure. Python’s current sorted-key JSON digest
distinguishes a horizon value serialized as 12.0 from one serialized as 12. The Node round
trip changes the former to the latter, after which the reference validator rejects the unchanged
response hash. Here the number has the same mathematical value, but the byte convention
differs. This conservative rejection is preferable to accepting an actually changed question; a
628                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


shared canonical encoding is still necessary for reliable interoperability. The proposed encoding
must specify number forms, strings, key ordering and exact type distinctions. Alternatively,
an adapter can retain the original canonical context bytes as an opaque object and hash those
bytes. Simply recomputing a digest after an arbitrary transformation would hide the very
changes that context binding is intended to detect. (Causal banking research project, 2026au)


46.14.5     A bounded prototype acceptance contract

The first implementation comparison should use generated objects with exact answers and
documented public examples. It should admit a narrow graph family, resolve and validate all
members, and compare graph representations under declared node renaming. The three-node
enumeration supplies a small exhaustive reference; additional tests must cover each supported
family, background restriction and latent/temporal convention. Recognition, observational
equivalence and intervention identification should have separate result types. Unsupported
families must remain visible in the request denominator.
   At the numerical boundary, the same asymmetric coordinates and interval unions should
pass through each proposed native adapter, library, CLI and MCP route. Acceptance requires
preservation of identities and topology or an explicitly bounded approximation, agreement
with independent affine and joint-region references, and rejection of undeclared rounding or
reindexing. Deliberately missing members, changed hashes and unknown constituent effects
should produce typed unavailable or unsupported results. Deadline and resource failures must
not publish a partially assembled graph class as complete. This comparison has a known
engineering route, but the generic JSON probe alone does not establish any native adapter’s
acceptance. (Causal banking research project, 2026av)
   The harder scientific question remains separate: a retained observational class may imply
several intervention effects, and a learned class need not have calibrated retention probability.
Numerical preservation can prevent additional distortion; it cannot supply missing causal
information or a new uncertainty theorem. The proposal should select a model and sampling
regime, justify its identification and joint construction, and use generated truth to study
that regime before proposing expensive bank experiments. Later bank owners must supply
variable meanings, feasible interventions, clocks, background restrictions and decision tolerances.
Platform and consumer owners must accept their actual encodings and failure behavior. These
are subsequent acceptance inputs, while the public/generated prototype and the present
proposal comparisons can proceed now. (Causal banking research project, 2026av)


46.15      Data custody preserves the meaning of a causal claim

46.15.1     The object to preserve is a decision with its information

A servicing analysis can be arithmetically reproducible and still answer the wrong question.
Suppose an analyst computes the effect of an offer on the next twelve months of account value
among accounts eligible at the decision date. A second workflow receives the same numerical
moments but reports a twenty-four-month effect for all customers. No file corruption is needed
for that mistake. Population, outcome horizon, intervention, information clock, units and
sampling law belong to the scientific object being transferred. They must travel with the
data, graph and result. A consumer that cannot establish this agreement should return an
unavailable result or request an explicit new analysis.
  Let C denote the declared scientific context, including those fields and the graph with its
assumption statuses. Let S be the local deterministic JSON serialization, H the SHA-256
46.15. Data custody preserves the meaning of a causal claim                                   629


digest, and B = S(V ) the stored bytes for a JSON value V . The implemented local store uses
a descriptor

                    D = (H(B), media type, schema, role, |B|, custody),

   and derives a handle from H(S(D)), preceded by a fixed letter. A scientific input also carries
H(S(C)) inside its payload. These are separate bindings: the first identifies bytes and their
declared interpretation, while the second ties a payload to a particular scientific request. The
store’s serialization sorts object keys and excludes nonfinite JSON numbers. It is an inspected
Python serialization rule, not an established canonicalization standard for every language or
a proof that distinct textual descriptions express the same causal question.(Causal banking
proposal, 2026j)
   For instance, a moment summary contains both its numbers and the context digest. Changing
the horizon from twelve to twenty-four months changes the context digest even when all
moments are unchanged. The service checks the expected artifact role and schema, reads and
verifies the referenced bytes, and compares the embedded context digest. In an actual local trial
with a generated quadratic sensitivity input, the twelve-month request computed an empty
sublevel set; the otherwise identical twenty-four-month request raised a context error. Through
the subprocess runtime the latter became a failed, unavailable response with no numerical
result. This distinction matters: an empty set is a mathematical outcome for a supplied
problem; an unavailable result says that the requested problem was not computed. Conflating
them would turn a custody failure into apparent scientific evidence. (Causal banking proposal,
2026k)
   Hash agreement does not establish that the population declaration is true, that timestamps
reflect actual availability, or that a supplied graph is causal. The declaration and the authority
behind it require different evidence. A data owner can provide a signed account of extraction
and eligibility, but the signature would establish who made that account, not the validity of
ignorability, exclusion or a measurement model. The proposed product should preserve these
distinctions from ingestion through the reported monetary consequence.


46.15.2     What the local implementation establishes

The reference store is restricted to nonsymlink runtime paths inside this repository. It stores
finite JSON values up to eight MiB and publishes each content or metadata file atomically,
with a directory flush. Reading checks agreement between the supplied reference and recorded
metadata, file length and the byte digest. The operation dispatcher adds role, schema and
declared scientific-context checks. The runtime verifies input references before execution and
before considering an idempotent replay. (Causal banking proposal, 2026j)
   Fifteen generated local cases exercise this boundary. Repeated insertion under the same
role returned the same reference; changing only the role retained the content digest and
changed the handle. Changed bytes, changed metadata, an incompatible horizon, a wrong
role or schema, an insufficient read limit, a nonfinite number, and selected symlink paths
were refused. The two existing service/runtime test modules also passed all sixteen tests in
this environment. These observations support selected implementation claims; they do not
estimate an operational error rate, prove correctness against every possible input, or validate
bank records. (Causal banking proposal, 2026k)
   Replay deserves its own scientific interpretation. A new request correlation identifier may
retrieve the same result, but reusing the idempotency key for a changed horizon returned
a conflict. After the referenced input was altered, replay returned an artifact-access failure
630                                                            Causal analysis for a universal bank


with no result. Its key binds the request digest, selected implementation and schema hashes,
Python version and declared dependency versions. A current source digest prevents an ordinary
unchanged-key replay across a detected implementation change; it is not a complete software
supply-chain attestation. The local operator still controls these files and the environment.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026j,k)
   The report path has an equally narrow role. Its summaries explicitly carry a schema-only
verification label. Preserving a canonical response in a report does not promote execution
evidence into accepted causal inference. For example, an assumption-conditional identification
expression must retain that qualification even if its artifact passes every byte check. Similarly,
a refused or unsupported operation must not disappear from a report that counts only
successful tasks. The preserved runtime tests establish selected report and cancellation behavior;
institutional report approval remains an additional decision.(Causal banking proposal, 2026j,k)


46.15.3     Two observed boundaries and the repairs they require

The first boundary concerns the relation between a handle and its descriptor. The writer derives
the handle from the descriptor, but the current reader does not independently recompute that
derivation. A controlled local trial changed a generated balance from 100 to 900, rewrote
the stored descriptor with the new byte digest and length, and supplied the correspondingly
changed reference under the original handle. The old trusted reference was refused. The
new supplied reference was accepted, although recomputing the descriptor digest produced a
different handle. The test required write access to content and metadata and control of the
supplied reference. It demonstrates a limit of the single-operator model; it does not establish
an exposed remote attack path.(Causal banking proposal, 2026k)
   There is a direct local repair: validate the complete descriptor schema and recompute its
handle before returning content or accepting stored metadata. Require the derived handle
to equal both the requested identifier and the identifier in the stored reference. Preserve the
original implementation as the evidence baseline, and qualify a successor against the old trusted
reference, a coherently rewritten reference, a mismatched metadata identity, missing descriptor
fields and extra fields. This is a proposed repair, not an implemented feature. It also does not
solve unrestricted substitution: a writer who can replace the trusted request can supply an
entirely new, internally consistent artifact and handle. Preventing that substitution requires an
independently trusted manifest or authenticated authorization binding the requester, purpose
and allowed inputs. (Causal banking proposal, 2026i)
   The second boundary concerns availability. The reader opens a path before checking that
its file descriptor denotes a bounded regular file. The open uses a flag rejecting a final symlink,
but lacks nonblocking mode. In a disposable subprocess, opening a named pipe without a
writer did not return within a one-second deadline after the child signalled that it was about
to read. The subprocess was terminated. The observed block occurred before the regular-file
test could reject the pipe. Because the runtime performs its initial reference verification in the
parent, a deadline on the later worker does not by itself bound that initial access. This is an
actual local availability finding, with no claim about deployment reachability or a measured
service-level failure rate. (Causal banking proposal, 2026j,k)
    A candidate repair opens candidate paths without following a final symlink and in non-
blocking mode, immediately checks the returned descriptor, and accepts only bounded regular
files. The acceptance cases must include pipes with and without writers, directories, symlinks
and oversized or changing files; each rejection must occur before any causal worker starts.
Directory file descriptors and controlled directory ownership should also be reviewed if the
threat model includes concurrent path replacement. A prior path resolution check alone does
46.15. Data custody preserves the meaning of a causal claim                                   631


not establish race-free access. Nonblocking open is a concrete first repair for the demonstrated
pipe, not a promise to bound all filesystem delays or solve every race. A production design still
needs an access deadline and an operating-system-specific review. (Causal banking proposal,
2026i)
  These findings do not invalidate the observed ordinary mutation refusals. They define
the assumptions under which those refusals are useful. For a single researcher working with
generated inputs, agreement with a trusted reference can detect accidental changes. For
multiple operators, automated agents or a bank repository, the trust anchor and authorization
decision must live beyond a request’s freely supplied custody string.


46.15.4     Custody across languages, repositories and agent tools

The transfer contract should distinguish a logical artifact from a path on one machine. A
Python caller, an R adapter and a Java discovery engine may share a causal task without
sharing a filesystem. The prospective adapter resolves an allowed handle within its own
custody boundary, checks the manifest and exact schema, and obtains the material needed
for its declared operation. It preserves graph endpoints, effect-set topology, units, population,
clock and uncertainty semantics in the returned object. Copying a path into a CLI flag or
an MCP request does not establish that agreement. No new sibling-repository execution is
claimed by this design. (Causal banking proposal, 2026i)
   Two prospective arrangements have different costs. A controlled local service may expose a
small allowlist of typed handles and operations to trusted callers. This keeps initial experiments
inexpensive but depends on the service’s operator and host boundary. A broader artifact service
would bind authenticated principals and permitted purposes to manifests, retain authorized
provenance, and enforce current access and revocation decisions. That arrangement adds
operational complexity and requires an owner for identity, keys, access policies and lifecycle
events. The product proposal can specify and compare them before claiming either is an
accepted bank service.
   A context digest provides a strict equality check, which can be desirable at a computational
boundary but does not resolve semantic equivalence. Equivalent population wording or a
different serialization of the same declared numerical quantity may fail equality; different
underlying data can also carry an identical but false declaration. A future interoperable context
schema therefore needs a versioned representation, explicit units and clock conventions, and
reviewed migrations. If an adapter changes a horizon, aggregation or currency conversion, it
should produce a new artifact with the transformation and input identities recorded. It should
not overwrite the meaning attached to an existing result.
   Retention creates another distinction between repeatability and permission. An immutable
result can remain scientifically reproducible while its source records become unavailable for a
later request. The service should check current access policy before replay, distinguish revoked
access from missing bytes, and retain only the audit material its owner permits. An invalidated
source should have an explicit status and downstream impact record. Deletion, backups,
redaction, derived artifacts and legally permitted audit retention require owner decisions. The
current local store has no qualified revocation or institutional retention service. Designing one
requires more than continuing to compare hashes.(Causal banking proposal, 2026i)


46.15.5     An affordable qualification path

The next experiment can use generated accounts, public documents and deliberately altered
copies. It should first qualify the two demonstrated local repairs without changing the original
632                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


evidence. Then it can exercise an adapter against distinct populations, horizons, endpoint

and permitted-use review.

46.16      Recovery that preserves a causal request
A recoverable service must preserve the scientific request as well as the computation. Suppose
a servicing analyst requests an effect in dollars over twelve months and the calculation is
interrupted. A later response for euros, another horizon or a revised graph is not a continuation
of that request. Conversely, the absence of a response says nothing about whether the effect is
zero, unidentifiable or economically unattractive. Our proposed integration therefore maintains
separate identities for the scientific context, execution environment, input artifacts, completed
work and published result. (Causal banking proposal, 2026s)
46.16. Recovery that preserves a causal request                                                633


   The local reference runtime already binds requests to context and artifact identities, and binds
replay to selected code, schemas, Python and dependency versions. Its report jobs preserve a
prefix of completed artifact identifiers and corresponding summaries. Reports describe supplied
results as declarations checked against a schema; they do not confer independent causal review.
These are useful mechanics for an early prototype, with a deliberately narrow single-operator
scope. They neither authenticate the supplied business premises nor qualify the system for
bank operation. (Causal banking proposal, 2026t)


46.16.1     Semantic failure and operational failure require different responses

Generated local requests illustrate the distinctions. A valid quadratic sensitivity request
returned a computed empty set. Changing its declared units from USD to EUR while retaining
the original input artifact produced a failed, unavailable response with no mathematical
result. An unsupported discovery method returned a completed invocation with the scientific
disposition unsupported and no result. A one-byte output limit produced an output-budget
failure. These observations demonstrate distinct response meanings for selected requests; an
empty mathematical set must not be used as a generic representation of missing computation.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026u)
   The review also exposed a boundary that the proposed interface must repair. The library
raises a validation exception for an unsupported request-schema version. It also raises a JSON
decoding exception when a previously saved replay file is manually truncated to an incomplete
JSON object. The latter case used an unchanged, valid request; the fault was in local saved
state. A follow-up through the actual CLI found that both conditions return exit code two
and the error code invalid_request. The CLI catches the exception, but assigns the storage
fault to the wrong operational category. A caller could repeatedly rewrite a scientifically valid
request while the corrupted replay state remains unchanged. (Causal banking proposal, 2026u)
    This finding does not establish that the runtime’s atomic writer naturally emits truncated
files. The truncation was a deliberate local fault injection. It does establish the observed
reader behavior for those bytes, and a concrete recovery requirement. The proposed response
should classify invalid caller syntax separately from corrupt or unavailable saved state, preserve
the offending bytes and their identity for diagnosis, and expose whether retry can succeed.
It should not silently delete the cache and rerun a scientific operation whose original inputs,
environment, randomization or authorization may no longer be available. A rebuild must first
revalidate those identities and declare whether it resumes the old request or creates a new
attempt. (Causal banking proposal, 2026s)


46.16.2     Three interruption windows

The content-addressed artifact store publishes bytes and metadata through separate atomic
writes. Individual write atomicity does not make the pair one transaction. In a generated case
we paused immediately after publishing the content file, before publishing its descriptor, and
killed that child process. The resulting content-only artifact was absent from the reference
listing and could not be retrieved by descriptor lookup. Retrying the same value, schema and
role completed the missing metadata under the same handle and returned the original value.
This supports one idempotent repair route. A different value under that handle would require
a different decision; this observation does not authorize silently reusing a stale descriptor.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026u)
  The second window concerns work already completed but not yet delivered. A report
over three generated canonical responses was interrupted after its first saved summary. An
634                                                             Causal analysis for a universal bank


unmodified runtime then resumed the job. The final ordered identifiers exactly matched the
original three requested artifacts, and the report contained one summary per identifier. Every
summary retained the qualification that checking was schema-only, without causal or external
review. Preserving that qualification across recovery is as necessary as avoiding duplicated
work: a restart must not upgrade a conditional result into an accepted finding. (Causal
banking proposal, 2026u)
   The third window occurs after the report artifact has been stored but before the job’s
terminal state points to it. We paused at that exact boundary and killed the child. Saved job
state still reported running with no result reference, although the report artifact already existed.
Recovery completed the job and returned the same report handle and bytes. Thus a durable
content-addressed artifact can support idempotent publication even when acknowledgement is
lost. The demonstrated behavior concerns local deterministic summaries. A future external side
effect, such as submitting a bank instruction, would need its own transaction and reconciliation
protocol; repeating a local report write supplies no evidence about that different operation.
(Causal banking proposal, 2026u,s)
   These three trials used explicit test-process hooks at named publication boundaries. The
library source files were unchanged. The test child executed the actual store or report-worker
code up to the boundary, and the parent killed only its own child. Subsequent recovery used
the ordinary runtime. Initial submission scheduling was deliberately deferred so the selected
boundary could be reached deterministically; therefore the production spawn counter excludes
that injected first worker. We do not treat the displayed counter as a count of every process
launched by the harness. These cases give reproducible mechanism evidence, not outage
frequencies or coverage of every operating-system failure ordering. (Causal banking proposal,
2026u)


46.16.3     A checkpoint is evidence to validate, not an instruction to trust

In another generated case, the first saved summary was changed while retaining its old
checkpoint digest. Resume failed with a checkpoint-content mismatch, kept the result reference
absent and preserved the failed state. This is the appropriate local refusal for that mutation.
The implementation also checks that completed identifiers form a prefix of the frozen request,
that summary and identifier counts agree, and that execution identity remains compatible.
These checks bind a particular continuation. They do not authenticate a writer who can
coherently replace every relevant descriptor and trust anchor; the separate custody discussion
retains that limitation. (Causal banking proposal, 2026t,u)
  The proposed state transition can be expressed without assuming success:

                    queued −→ running −→ {completed, failed, cancelled}.

Resumption of unfinished work is allowed only after the input, execution and checkpoint
conditions hold. Completion additionally requires a readable result whose content and meaning
match the declared request. Cancellation records a terminal decision about future work;
it is not a claim that previously published artifacts or external effects have been rolled
back. A nonterminal job may already have a durable artifact, as the third interruption case
demonstrates. The authoritative job state and the artifact’s independent identity must remain
distinguishable. (Causal banking proposal, 2026s)
   For the next prototype, the known repair is to centralize error normalization for library, CLI
and MCP callers, while preserving the difference between request defects, state corruption,
resource exhaustion and scientific refusal. Acceptance cases should include malformed and
missing replay records, wrong context or schema, unreadable referenced artifacts, changed code
46.17. What exact agreement across three interfaces establishes                                635


identity, partial metadata, corrupt checkpoints, cancellation at each publication boundary, and
recovery near the original deadline. Negative cases must remain in the request ledger with
their attempted inputs and observed disposition. A valid retry must not gain a fresh unlimited
budget merely by restarting. (Causal banking proposal, 2026s)
    The current observations establish selected local behavior and expose a concrete classification
defect. They do not repair the implementation, rerun a live MCP consumer, measure bank-
scale recovery, or settle the previously observed descriptor-replacement and FIFO limitations.
Those claims require their own tests and, for operating acceptance, a named consumer, target
filesystem and platform, identity authority, retention rules and declared service limits. Public
or generated fixtures can justify the prototype and demonstrate the merit of later experiments
before expensive bank trials are commissioned. (Causal banking proposal, 2026s)


46.17      What exact agreement across three interfaces establishes
The common operation service supplies a useful starting point for a banking analyst, a
command-line workflow and an assistant using MCP. Each should retain the same question,
assumptions, result and limitations. That objective needs a precise boundary. Here the library
entry is Runtime.invoke; a lower level numerical helper is not automatically the same public
operation. A CLI exit code, an MCP protocol error and a canonical scientific disposition also
belong to different layers. Requiring identical bytes across those layers would obscure their
meanings rather than preserve them.
   For a request q that is admissible through all three negotiated surfaces, let L(q) denote
the canonical library response, C(q) the decoded CLI response, and Ms (q) and Mt (q) the
structured and decoded text responses from MCP. The desired equality is

                        L(q) = C(q) = Ms (q) = Mt (q),        q ∈ Qshared .

Equality includes context identity, operation, execution status, scientific disposition, result
kind, units, set topology, qualification, evidence and error. A normalization that discards the
error or reduces an unbounded set to a convenient point would not meet this requirement. The
shared domain is itself negotiated: a generic local dispatcher can represent an unsupported
operation that the MCP server deliberately does not advertise. (Causal banking proposal,
2026bj,bi)


46.17.1     Actual local observations, with independent result meanings

A deterministic local comparison exercised thirteen scientific requests through the library,
CLI and real Python MCP client/server over stdio. The server negotiated protocol 2025-
11-25 using SDK 1.27.0. All thirteen canonical responses agreed exactly, including MCP’s
structured and serialized-text copies. The cases comprised capabilities, graph syntax, a
supplied-DAG back-door expression, unsupported dependent sampling, a contradicted premise,
an unsupported estimation method, four deterministic sensitivity-set shapes, weak-moment
inversion, a changed-context failure and observation-clock diagnostics. Three further lifecycle
calls exercised report submission, terminal status and cancellation after completion; together
the selected cases exercised all nine advertised operations. This is actual local execution on
generated inputs, not a mock transport or a statistical performance study. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026bj)
  The equality check is useful because the expected meanings were also reviewed. The
four sensitivity examples solve b2 ≤ 4, b2 + 1 ≤ 0, −b2 − 1 ≤ 0 and −b2 + 4 ≤ 0. Their
636                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


sets are respectively [−2, 2], the empty set, the whole line and (−∞, −2] ∪ [2, ∞). Their
uncertainty is explicitly nonprobabilistic. Matching copies of these objects cannot turn them
into sampling confidence regions. The moment example retains its conditional Gaussian-
moment interpretation. The graph example retains the supplied graph and the limitation
that syntax review does not prove causal truth. The clock example flags both an observation
available exactly at the decision time and one without an availability time under the requested
strict-before rule. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj)
   For banking use, these distinctions matter when the same request is reused in a batch report
or presented by an assistant. The dependent-sampling and unsupported-method examples
returned a completed invocation with an unsupported scientific disposition. The contradicted-
premise example returned a completed invocation with refusal. All three had CLI exit zero
and isError=false in MCP; none produced the requested causal estimate. Changing the
sign convention while retaining a moment artifact bound to the old context instead produced
a failed canonical response, CLI exit four and isError=true. The preserved context hash and
failure prevent a response about one contrast from being relabeled as the opposite contrast.
This is agreement about the supported boundary, not a general guarantee that every possible
scientifically inconsistent context is recognized. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj)
   The shared report job preserved computed, unsupported and refused input declarations,
while labeling its verification as schema-only. Its submission response was a queued handle; the
terminal state belonged inside the subsequent job-status payload. Cancelling the completed
job left its completed report intact. A proposed consumer must display those states separately.
A finished report is not independent scientific approval of its contents, and a successful cancel
call cannot be presented as reversal of an already completed action. This local case covers
cancellation after completion; it does not replace the distinct recovery, in-flight cancellation
and target-platform evidence. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj)


46.17.2    Capability negotiation and errors are part of the scientific contract

The unimplemented discovery request exposes the boundary of the equality statement. Library
and CLI returned the same canonical unsupported response, with CLI exit zero. Calling the
unadvertised discovery tool through MCP produced JSON-RPC error −32602, “Unknown
causal tool.” This follows the adapter’s separation between advertised operations and unimple-
mented canonical requests. The protocol error says that this tool call is unavailable; it does
not say that a causal effect is nonidentified. A proposed client should retain the negotiated
capability set and resolve this availability question before dispatch, using a common user-facing
explanation while preserving the actual wire error if a call is nevertheless made. It should not
invent a scientific response that the service never returned. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj;
Model Context Protocol contributors, 2026f; Causal banking proposal, 2026bi)
   The invalid-schema case also behaved differently at the transport boundary. An extra
request property raised a library validation exception, produced CLI invalid_request with
exit two, and produced an MCP tool error without a canonical structured response. This is
appropriate input rejection for that case. The corrupt-replay case shows why a matching coarse
error label is not enough. A valid capability request was first saved under an idempotency key;
its local replay JSON was then deliberately malformed. The library raised JSONDecodeError.
The CLI returned invalid_request with exit two, while MCP returned “Invalid local causal
request” and no canonical response. The request had not changed. The failing bytes belonged
to stored execution state, so attributing the failure to the analyst’s request is wrong. This
extends the earlier CLI failure finding with a real MCP observation. The original replay bytes
were restored after the isolated local trial. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj)
46.17. What exact agreement across three interfaces establishes                               637


   The source explains the attribution. Replay parsing occurs inside the runtime, but JSON
decoding errors inherit from ValueError; the CLI and MCP adapters catch that broad
exception family together with input-validation errors. The proposed repair is to separate
validated caller-input failures from artifact, replay-state, worker and transport failures. For an
already validated request with a corrupt replay, return a failed/unavailable canonical result
with its context identity and a specific stored-state error. For an unparseable incoming message,
retain a transport/input error without fabricating a scientific context. Preserve the corrupt
record for operator investigation; do not automatically discard an idempotency record and
repeat a potentially consequential action. This repair is specified, not implemented in the
observed runtime. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj,bi)


46.17.3     Validation ownership, identity and the remaining acceptance cases

Validation responsibility cannot be assigned merely by noticing that a tool advertises an
output schema. In the inspected SDK, a handler returning an explicit CallToolResult takes a
path that returns that object before the decorator’s later structured-output validation branch.
The local adapter does explicitly validate its canonical response, and the runtime also checks
response semantics. A future refactor must preserve those checks and test malformed responses
on every return path. The successful local trials do not establish that the SDK will perform
validation which this specific code path leaves to the adapter. (Causal banking proposal,
2026bj)
   Execution identity needs an equally precise scope. The runtime binds selected local sources,
two schemas, Python and four numerical/validation dependencies. Its identity does not itself
include MCP or AnyIO versions or the separate MCP tool-mapping contract. The current
observations record SDK versions and source identities separately. The proposed transport
identity should bind the negotiated protocol, tool map, SDK, concurrency dependency, launch
profile and any response normalizer as well as the scientific runtime. A common scientific
result with a changed transport contract then remains distinguishable from an exact replay
under the same complete interface. (Causal banking proposal, 2026bj,bi)
  The known next tests are concrete: valid requests with missing, malformed or incompatible
replay records; unknown tools and unsupported method identifiers; schema and context
mismatches; nonfinite or incorrectly typed responses; divergent MCP text and structured
content; changed SDK/tool-map identity; and terminal versus in-flight job cancellation. Freeze
the request and expected layer of failure before each test, retain failed attempts, and compare
the whole result object. Extend the common decoder to each proposed consumer language and
then test against its actual caller. These engineering routes are known, but their completion
and external acceptance are not supplied by the thirteen matched examples. (Causal banking
proposal, 2026bi)
   The environment observation is also bounded. A six-second worker-thread probe stalled
under the managed sandbox; the same fixed local probe succeeded in the approved execution
environment outside it, where the MCP comparison ran. This is an observed operating
constraint, not a reason to treat sandbox and production environments as interchangeable.
HTTP, multiple operators, authentication, remote retries, newer protocol revisions and bank-
platform performance remain separate qualification work. The immediate proposal can justify
testing these interfaces with generated and permitted public inputs; actual consumer owners
must later accept their deployed workflows. No transport comparison can supply missing
intervention truth, causal assumptions or useful bank precision. (Causal banking proposal,
2026bj,bi)

46.18      A Java discovery boundary that retains the question
The Java comparison motivates a concrete first integration: a pinned Tetrad process for
a restricted PC discovery request, with a separate admission path for FGES. The initial
request concerns complete continuous observations under an explicitly assumed IID linear
Gaussian model with causal sufficiency, acyclicity, faithfulness and no unmodeled selection.
These restrictions identify a reviewable prototype. They do not imply that a table of banking
observations satisfies them. Clustered customers, repeated account histories, missing-data
correction, latent-variable discovery and background-knowledge constraints require other
profiles. The adapter is a proposal contract; no Java engine or new transport endpoint has
been implemented here. (Causal banking research project, 2026v; cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a)
   The request retains the downstream target even though discovery does not compute it. A
funding analyst’s population, treatment contrast, outcome, time horizon, units and sampling
declarations remain attached to the graph. They prevent a later identification step from
silently changing the question. The generic operation contract already provides these fields
for effect operations. The Java discovery profile deliberately requires that context as well.
A standalone graph request without a downstream treatment and outcome needs its own
reviewed context extension; inserting arbitrary variable names would create a fictitious causal
question. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)
   The logical interface is the same across the proposed library invocation, causalbank
operation graph.discover command and causal_graph_discover MCP tool. Each trans-
ports a versioned canonical request and receives the same typed result. A complete scientific
context digest accompanies a broader request digest containing input hashes, engine revision,
algorithm settings, adapter version and resource limits. An interface that changes USD into
thousands of USD, reverses the treatment contrast, changes the sampling law or orients an
ambiguous edge has changed the scientific request, even if its JSON remains valid. The
reference serialization examples demonstrate those identity changes on local objects; they are
not executions of a server or MCP client. (Causal banking research project, 2026v,w)


46.18.1    The graph object preserves a class of possible interventions

Use opaque variable identifiers and a bijection into engine symbols. Store the original column
order and its permutation separately from the engine’s order. Every variable, including an
isolated node, travels through the conversion. Human-readable labels, availability times and
units remain metadata with their own scientific meaning; names do not supply an orientation
rule. For every pair, retain its two endpoint marks. When the serialization orders the pair
lexically, it swaps the marks with the nodes. Thus R → B, expressed as a tail at R and an
arrowhead at B, agrees with the reversed pair representation having an arrowhead at B and a
tail at R. Reversing only the node order changes the graph. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a; Causal
banking research project, 2026w)
  A Gaussian example illustrates why an unoriented link must survive this boundary. Consider
three standardized variables X, Y, Z with covariance
                                                       
                                         1 4/5 2/5
                                   Σ = 4/5 1 1/2 .
                                                  
                                        2/5 1/2 1

For a banking interpretation, X can denote a rate concession, Y a balance response and Z a
funding outcome, all in stipulated standardized units. The covariance obeys X ⊥ Z | Y . The
undirected path X − Y − Z represents three acyclic orientations without an unshielded collider.
46.18. A Java discovery boundary that retains the question                                       639


The orientation X → Y ← Z is excluded because it would require a different independence
pattern under faithfulness. (Causal banking research project, 2026w)
  For each retained orientation, regress a variable on its proposed parents using the same
Σ, and assign the residual variance as its independent Gaussian noise variance. In matrix
notation, if Wij is the coefficient from source i to target j, then

                                  Σ = (I − W T )−1 Ω(I − W )−1 ,

where Ω is the diagonal noise covariance. The exact reference calculation verifies this equality
for all three models. In the forward chain, the coefficients are 4/5 and 1/2; intervening on X
changes Z by 2/5 per unit. In the fork and the reverse chain, X has no directed path to Z, so
the effect is zero. The same observational covariance therefore supports the effect multiset
{2/5, 0, 0}. (Causal banking research project, 2026w)
   Returning the forward chain alone would select the positive effect by an unrecorded conven-
tion. Returning the interval [0, 2/5] would introduce values such as 1/5 that none of these
three specified linear Gaussian models produces. That interval is a hull, not the discrete effect
set, and neither object is a confidence set without a separate statistical construction. The
discovery response consequently retains the CPDAG and returns no effect estimate, effect
region or uncertainty level. A later identification operation must state how it handles the whole
class and the additional functional assumptions. (Causal banking research project, 2026v,w)
   Checking endpoint syntax is insufficient to award the CPDAG label. A graph can contain
only tails and arrows and still fail to represent a completed Markov equivalence class. The
existing reference validator does not recognize all such cases. The proposed Java boundary
therefore requires an independently reviewed graph-class check before publishing a completed
CPDAG. A circle, bidirected conflict or invalid completion in the initial route is an invalid-
engine-output failure, with the raw graph retained for diagnosis. It is not silently coerced
into a DAG. Background knowledge is initially excluded because orienting an observational
CPDAG using additional restrictions requires an appropriate constrained-graph representation
and provenance. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)


46.18.2     Admission must cover the failure path as well as the constructor

The proposed PC profile sets the conditioning depth to the inspected unbounded value, enables
the stable skeleton option, selects the separating-set collider rule, disallows bidirected conflicts,
and prevents directed cycles. It supplies empty background knowledge and a caller-declared
test level. These choices make the attempted operation explicit. A user-requested depth cap is
initially unsupported; exhausting a runtime budget returns an incomplete job, not a graph
advertised as the result of the completed search. (Causal banking research project, 2026v;
Tetrad contributors, 2026)
   The numerical test profile is equally specific: complete data, no shrinkage, zero ridge and
no pseudoinverse fallback, with all settings frozen before search. The inspected Fisher-Z
source exposes these alternatives separately. Automatically activating regularization after
a singularity would change the test while keeping the same apparent method name. That
may be useful in a different profile, but it needs a separate calibration argument. The initial
profile requires at least n ≥ p + 2 complete observations for p variables so that even the largest
possible conditioning set has positive Fisher-Z degrees of freedom. This is only an arithmetic
prerequisite; it does not guarantee useful power or stable covariance inversion. (Causal banking
research project, 2026v; Tetrad contributors, 2026)
  As the Java comparison showed, the inspected checkIndependence path converts a singular-
matrix exception into a dependence result with p = 0. The proposed wrapper instead uses the
640                                                           Causal analysis for a universal bank


exception-preserving getResult path and derives a decision only from a valid result. Every
invocation receives a query identity and a terminal record. Before propagating an exception,
the wrapper sets a job-level failure flag. Publication then checks that every issued call has a
valid terminal record and that the flag is clear. This matters because search code may catch
interruptions internally: receiving a graph object alone does not prove that all its requested
tests completed. (cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a; Tetrad contributors, 2026; Causal banking research
project, 2026v)
   That wrapper remains an implementation prerequisite. Its full independence-test interface,
ancillary methods and interaction with the search implementation must be inspected and com-
piled; calling one method in a design document is not sufficient. Numerical rank checks before
dispatch help detect duplicate accounting columns, but per-query records remain necessary
for failures that arise during the search. A zero test probability cannot be reinterpreted as
maximal causal confidence. If the required failure provenance cannot be obtained, the route is
unavailable in this runtime. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)
   Parallelism and deadlines also belong to admission. The stable FAS path uses a parallel
stream and requires thread-safe records. FGES’s separate worker setting does not control that
path. The inspected PC search delegates the skeleton phase to FAS without demonstrating an
end-to-end deadline guarantee from PC’s timeout setting alone. The proposed parent process
therefore enforces the whole-job deadline, memory and output budget. An engine’s cooperative
timeout is supplementary. A cancellation or a process death preserves the attempt’s failure
record and withholds its graph. (Tetrad contributors, 2026; Causal banking research project,
2026v)


46.18.3    Units, unsupported requests and the next executable comparison

The signed funding model in the Java survey provides a useful independent conversion reference.
If x′i = di xi , the source-row coefficients must transform as Wij′ = dj Wij /di . Rescaling the
rate by 100, balances by 1000 and cost by 10, then applying the correspondingly rescaled
rate intervention, must recover the original responses after converting units back. The exact
reference does so. It also verifies that an unchanged absolute coefficient threshold can select a
different graph after rescaling. This does not give coefficients to the PC adapter, whose result
is graph-only; it supplies an admission example for any later weighted route. (Causal banking
research project, 2026w,x)
   A valid request outside the initial scientific scope receives a completed unsupported response
with its context preserved and a specific alternative. Repeated account observations point
toward a separately reviewed temporal or cluster profile; latent-variable assumptions point
toward an appropriate PAG route; missing values require an explicit observation mechanism
and correction profile. An uninstalled or unqualified runtime receives an unavailable response.
Neither condition is called nonidentification, which would be a stronger scientific conclusion
about an effect under a model. Malformed inputs and failed computations carry structured
errors, with no effect or graph result masquerading as a completed calculation. (Causal banking
research project, 2026v)
   The first prototype should use a fixed local Java process so its dependency and runtime
identity can be measured. The process boundary does not remove the inspected GPL conditions.
The actual compiler target, runtime vendor and version, dependency artifacts, operating system
and thread configuration must be locked for the chosen route; the source’s compiler setting
and bridge README cannot substitute for that environment check. Result publication is
atomic after validation. A crashed search is restarted as a new retained attempt under the
same immutable request, with no promise of resuming an internal search state. If completion
46.19. A native forest boundary that preserves the banking question                          641


wins a cancellation race, the immutable published result remains the observed outcome.
(cmu-phil/tetrad, 2026a; Causal banking research project, 2026v)
   The executable comparison begins with independent oracles: the three-model Gaussian
class, a collider and an isolated node, the depth-three separator, signed matrices and unit
changes, singular input, and injected failures. Only after these pass should a prospectively
specified generated-sample study estimate graph error and resource use under the declared
assumptions and their violations. It should retain every attempted request, including timeouts
and refusals, and compare a matched baseline under the same budgets. These steps test
whether the proposed boundary deserves a prototype claim. Expensive bank experiments
become relevant when that bounded evidence exposes a decision-relevant uncertainty that
public or generated data cannot settle.


46.18.4     Encoding algorithm settings without changing the shared schema

The existing discovery request schema permits only an algorithm identifier and algorithm
version in its parameter object. The proposed Java profile therefore places the detailed
settings in a separate immutable configuration artifact. The request supplies its opaque
handle, hash, media type, schema version and role, alongside the data artifact. Resolving
that artifact recovers the test level, conditioning depth, missingness policy, numerical controls
and background-knowledge choice. The full request identity includes its hash, so changing
a setting creates a different request even when the downstream scientific context remains
identical. This preserves compatibility with the shared schema while retaining the scientifically
relevant settings. (Causal banking research project, 2026v)
  The adapter’s admission check must require exactly one configuration artifact of the reviewed
version, verify its bytes and recognized fields, and check that the declared algorithm version
admits that profile. Generic schema validation alone cannot establish those conditions. The
worked wire records separately represent an unavailable runtime, an unsupported sampling
regime, a failed invocation and a graph response from an independent population reference.
Their data fixture is deterministic, and their graph is not a fitted result. These records make
the proposed response contract concrete without treating a valid message as evidence of an
executed engine.


46.19      A native forest boundary that preserves the banking
           question
A servicing analyst asks whether making a specified offer changes twelve-month net receipts
for eligible customers. The proposed treatment is the offer, coded one, against no offer, coded
zero. The outcome includes the offer’s cost and is measured in dollars per customer over the
stated horizon. A heterogeneous-effect forest can help estimate this contrast under a declared
identification model. Its C++ implementation cannot decide whether the recorded offer was
randomized, whether all confounders were measured, or whether the analyst actually wants
the mean over customers, branches, or treated customers. Those choices must precede engine
dispatch and survive it.
  The proposed first grf integration uses its maintained R interface in a pinned local process,
which in turn invokes the native C++ core. Direct native embedding is a separate alternative.
Inspection covers commit 5bee99b51471, dated 30 April 2026, whose package description
declares version 2.6.1. The snapshot therefore precedes the literature cutoff; its October
acquisition date is separately retained. The design is not an installed adapter. The executed

examples below are project-owned arithmetic references; they neither train grf nor measure its
statistical performance GRF contributors (2026d); Causal banking research project (2026l,m).


46.19.1     From an offer question to a local moment

Let X contain information available before the offer, W ∈ {0, 1} denote assignment, and Y (w)
denote the potential twelve-month net receipt. With consistency, no interference, conditional
exchangeability and positivity, the target is

                       τ (x) = E[Y (1) − Y (0) | X = x],          θ = E[τ (X)].

The outer expectation defines the customer population. An observed treated subpopulation or
an overlap-weighted population gives a different target. The initial proposed profile accepts
complete observations from independent customers, a binary treatment, one fixed outcome and
a fixed horizon. It excludes repeated decision histories, unmeasured confounding, interference,
survey weighting and latent-graph ambiguity that has not been resolved for this estimand.
These are restrictions of the proposed profile, not assertions that the package has no other
functionality.
   Write m(x) = E[Y | X = x] and e(x) = E[W | X = x]. The inspected R wrapper either
obtains nuisance predictions or uses supplied predictions, then passes Y − m(X)

that boundary. The causal binding selects the instrumental trainer and sets the instrument
coordinate to the treatment coordinate. Consequently the inspected native prediction is a
ratio of locally weighted covariances, with the treatment variance in its denominator GRF
contributors (2026c,b).

In the exact reference, equal weights on residual outcomes (−2, −1, 1, 2) and residual treatments
(−1/2, −1/2, 1/2, 1/2) give slope three. Constant residual treatment gives zero denominator
and the reference refuses the calculation. Its numerical threshold is an explicit arithmetic
rule, not evidence that positivity holds in a bank population. The native source divides by
its local first-stage quantity; the adapter must inspect finite outputs and retain weak-support
diagnostics instead of silently replacing a failed division with zero.
   Honest tree splitting and out-of-bag prediction address particular reuse of observations.
They do not establish the causal premises or turn customer rows from a common branch shock
into independent samples. Generalized forest theory also imposes regularity, subsampling,
smooth local identification and variance conditions; a named package and a successful fit do
not verify them Athey et al. (2018). The proposed first profile retains the R nuisance path and
its out-of-bag predictions. Supplying an independently estimated nuisance vector requires a
later profile with explicit training identities, alignment and sampling-unit split rules. A known
randomized propensity may be supplied only with the corresponding assignment declaration;
it is never inferred from a convenient constant.

and (5, 1, 2, 3/4, 2). Their scores are 8/3, 0, 2, 16/3. The mean score is 5/2, whereas the mean

Causal banking research project (2026m).

   For target weights qi , the corresponding estimator is θb = i qi Γi / i qi . Choosing qi = 1
targets a customer-weighted population; choosing inverse branch sizes gives each observed
branch equal total weight. A branch with two customer scores of ten dollars and a branch with
four scores of forty dollars produce a customer mean of thirty dollars and an equal-branch
mean of twenty-five dollars. A planning cohort of ten thousand customers turns the five-dollar
difference into fifty thousand dollars in a naive projection. That calculation exposes the target
change; it does not justify applying an equal-branch mean to an arbitrary customer portfolio.
   The R interface documents that equal cluster weighting changes both training sampling
and average-effect weights, and disallows user sample weights in that mode. Replacing the
final mean alone cannot reproduce training under that option. A native port would have to
preserve both mechanisms. The initial independent-customer profile therefore rejects cluster
and weight options; the independent-cluster extension is specified for later qualification and
must name whether customers or clusters define its target GRF contributors (2026c).

This specifies a computation. Asymptotic validity needs an appropriate independent-cluster
